syllabi.outline:
近年來企業為面對市場競爭的挑戰與快速改變，其經營管理活動多以專案方式來執行，以致企業各部門工作皆與專案管理息息相關，如：產品研發、行銷規劃、生產製造、教育訓練及企業經營管理等活動，多以專案方式來執行。 本課程將對於企業內全方位專案管理流程做一概述，並安排企業實例做為案例探討。課程針對研發、採購、行銷及行政專案管理等之五大流程 (起案、規劃、執行、監控、結案)及十大知識領域 (整合、範圍、時間、成本、品質、人資、溝通、風險、採購、關係人) 與各流程中所使用的技能與工具做說明與介紹。此課程之內容包含全面專案管理觀念知識的建立與應用，並著重企業全方位的相關專案實務案例講解。使其瞭解專案管理在產業界重要性，企業研究發展的正確方向，以達產學合一，並分享最新觀念與實務。
Recently, facing the marketing challenges and rapid changes, the company's business management activities are mostly carried out in a project-based manner, all departments are closely related to project management and carried out on a case-by-case basis. This course will provide an overview of the full-scale project management process within the company, and arrange enterprise practice as a case study. The course covers five major processes and ten areas of knowledge (integration, scope, time, cost, quality, human resources, communication, risk, procurement). The content of this course is based on the concept knowledge and focuses on the company's comprehensive (product R&D, marketing planning, manufacturing, and training program) case study. To make attendants understand the importance of project management in the industry to achieve the unity of production and learning, and to share the newest concepts and practices.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹人力資源與組織管理的進階理論與實務，內容包括了(但不限於)人才任用、訓練與發展、績效評估、薪酬管理、組織設計、領導、工作激勵、以及工作團隊運作等等重要議題。課堂上並討論上述理論對於管理實務上的意涵。
description.en: This course introduces many advanced topics of human resource management, organization theory, and organization behavior. Topics include (but not limited to) staffing, training and development, performance appraisal, compensation, organization design, leadership, work motivation, workgroup functioning. Implications for managerial practice will be discussed in this class.

description.zh: 公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。
description.en: The corporate governance had been the enterprise framework adjustment of the main issue of the 21 century. How do the manage the corporate strategy and system of the law to make the profit for the shareholder, government and enterprise. The main purpose of the course to help the learner to understand the law of corporate and the practice of the enterprise.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於建構產業分析之思維架構及洞悉市場發展之研究能力，以因應市場之快速變遷,並介紹學生瞭解市場行銷管理與產業景氣分析,公司經營財務報表分析,投資標的評價與技術分析。透過研究方法之介紹及預測手法之教導並輔以個案實作以達其效。
description.en: The objective of the course is to construct the infrastructure of industry analysis and to build up the research capability for changing market development. The fundamental analysis of marketing management and business cycle, financial statement analysis and investment valuation methods are also studied. By introducing the methodologies and forecasting tools, the case studies are implied in this class.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹領導與組織管理的理論與實務。課程目的有四個：(1)了解組織領導與管理的內涵；(2)討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3)對實務界人士提供具體建議；(4)將領導與管理的技巧應用到生活面。
description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is; (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for business management and (4) to apply the basic ideas of leadership and management in daily life.

description.zh: 本課程教授人工智慧技術的基礎理論與實務技巧，並對於人工智慧在製造業、服務業、金融業的應用，提供啟發性的基本認知與創意，以激發學生在人工智慧領域的創新應用。課程內容包括: 人工智慧基礎、機器學習、大數據技術、深度學習、生成對抗網路、創業家思維、設計思考、商業模式、人工智慧與現代科技、工業 4.0、人工智慧的製造業應用個案、人工智慧的服務業應用個案、人工智慧的金融應用個案。
description.en: This course aims to teach students the basic concepts and practical techniques of artificial intelligence and to introduce its applications on manufacturing, service, and finance industries. The course focuses on inspring students for innovative artificial intelligence applications. The course includes: artificial intelligence basics, machine learn-ing, big data, deep learning, generative adversarial network, entrepreneurial thoughts, design thinking, business models, artificial intelligence and modern technologies, industry 4.0, real case applications on manufacturing, service, finance industries.

description.en: The big data opportunity, extracting insight from an immense volume, variety and velocity of data, in context, beyond what was previously possible, will be addressed in this course. Applications for big data analytics could include smarter healthcare, multi-channel, finance, computer log analysis, homeland security, traffic control, telecom, search quality, manufacturing, trading analytics, fraud and risk, retailing, among others.

syllabi.outline: 隨著雲端運算服務的廣為使用及網際網路服務的發展，我們已經處於大數據時代，如何處理與儲存大數據、如何從大數據中，探勘有用的知識，成為近年來熱門的研究議題。本課程內容尚包括如何處理與分析大數據、如何更進一步從大數據分析發展市場行銷與顧客關係管理策略，大數據各種案例實務探討等。

Week 11-12: 資料探勘之方法介紹 II

Week 14: 大數據行銷實務
Week 15-16: 大數據分析應用與其實務個案討論

description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. description.zh: 金融科技是近年來新興的產業趨勢，影響的層面非常廣泛，不只是金融方面，更牽涉到新興科技與物聯網。本課程將從不同的角度分析金融科技的技術內容、應用領域及商業模式，並藉由國內外重要金融科技公司發展的經驗做一介紹，希望達到了解並運用此新興科技的目的。本課程內容包括:金融科技概論、金融科技商業模式、金融大數據、P2P 借貸、虛擬貨幣、雲端服務、第三方支付、群眾募資、區塊鏈、跨境電商、程式交易、機器人理財等主題。
description.en: FinTech includes two words: Finance and Technology. It is a new trend of industrial field. It has influences on lots of technical fields, not only finance, but also emerging technologies and IoT. This course will analyze FinTech from different angles, such as technology contents, application fields and business models. It also will utilize experiences of leading companies with FinTech to obtain decent knowledge of this new field. The contents of this course include introduction to financial technology, business models of financial technology, finance big data, P2P lending, virtual money, cloud services, third-party payment, crowd funding, blockchain, cross-border e-commerce, program trading, and robotic financial advisory etc.

syllabi.outline:
本課程在使學生了解各種不同的資訊科技(Information Technology)與管理資訊系統間的關連性，並實際應用所教授的IT技術進行學術研究。藉由IT技術的應用演練，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。本課程能夠：
1.	訓練研究生學術期刊論文研讀及講評能力
2.	論文研究計畫大綱撰寫
3.	論文發表口頭練習

description.zh: 專注於戰略和機構的國際層面，並提供了一個框架，在日益複雜的全球經濟裡制定戰略。本課程旨在為學生提供對跨國公司經營裡的文化，政治，競爭，技術，法律和人口環境的理解。然後，它通過在國際背景下獲得成功的全球產業和戰略來探討全球競爭的性質。還涵蓋了跨國公司管理中的組織設計與戰略控制相關問題。
description.en: Focuses on the international dimensions of strategy and organization and provides a framework for formulating strategies in an increasingly complex global economy. The course seeks to provide students with an understanding of the cultural, political, competitive, technological, legal, and demographic environments in which multinational firms operate. It then examines the nature of global competition by exploring the characteristics of global industries and strategies that have been successful in an international context. Also covered are issues related to organizational design and strategic control in the management of multinational enterprises.

description.zh: 該課程強調關鍵的經濟和商業概念（包括對需求和供應，生產，成本和利潤的分析；市場支配力；戰略行為和定價；國際貿易理論）影響決策。
description.en:
The course emphasizes key economic and business concepts
(including analysis of demand and supply, production, cost, and profit; market power, strategic behavior, and pricing; international trade theories) that influence decisions.

name.en: Overseas Management Practice and Cross-border Studies

description.zh: 本課程將安排學生組團由學院教授帶領到境外EMBA專班或國外（含中國大陸）大學交流學習，瞭解該國地域性的產業型態與國家經濟政策，另安排到當地企業廠商做實地觀摩與考察。返校後由領隊教授引導主持，進行綜合討論，學生必須在返台灣後一個月內提交心得報告及建議。
description.en: The course will arrange the student group led by the college professor to the overseas EMBA class or foreign (including mainland China) universities to study and learn about the country's regional industrial type and national economic policy. They will then conduct the tours of local businesses. Upon returning, a seminar, facilitated by the professors, will be held to exchange views and opinions. Students are required to submit a final report with recommendations within one month after their return to Taiwan.

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, and some basic multivariate

description.en: This course introduces the art of leadership to the students helping them to understand how the concept of Chinese traditional culture can enhance the performance of leadership in organizational governance. name.en: Overseas Management Practice and Cross-border Studies

description.zh: 本課程將安排學生組團由學院教授帶領到境外EMBA專班或國外（含中國大陸）大學交流學習，瞭解該國地域性的產業型態與國家經濟政策，另安排到當地企業廠商做實地觀摩與考察。返校後由領隊教授引導主持，進行綜合討論，學生必須在返台灣後一個月內提交心得報告及建議。
description.en: The course will arrange the student group led by the college professor to the overseas EMBA class or foreign (including mainland China) universities to study and learn about the country's regional industrial type and national economic policy. They will then conduct the tours of local businesses. Upon returning, a seminar, facilitated by the professors, will be held to exchange views and opinions. Students are required to submit a final report with recommendations within one month after their return to Taiwan.

description.zh: 本課程教授人工智慧技術的基礎理論與實務技巧，並對於人工智慧在製造業、服務業、金融業的應用，提供啟發性的基本認知與創意，以激發學生在人工智慧領域的創新應用。課程內容包括: 人工智慧基礎、機器學習、大數據技術、深度學習、生成對抗網路、創業家思維、設計思考、商業模式、人工智慧與現代科技、工業 4.0、人工智慧的製造業應用個案、人工智慧的服務業應用個案、人工智慧的金融應用個案。

syllabi.outline:
本課程在使學生了解各種不同的資訊科技(Information Technology)與管理資訊系統間的關連性，並實際應用所教授的IT技術進行學術研究。藉由IT技術的應用演練，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。本課程能夠：

本課程教授人工智慧技術的基礎理論與實務技巧，並對於人工智慧在製造業、服務業、金融業的應用，提供啟發性的基本認知與創意，以激發學生在人工智慧領域的創新應用。課程內容包括: 人工智慧基礎、機器學習、大數據技術、深度學習、生成對抗網路、創業家思維、設計思考、商業模式、人工智慧與現代科技、工業 4.0、人工智慧的製造業應用個案、人工智慧的服務業應用個案、人工智慧的金融應用個案。
This course aims to teach students the basic concepts and practical techniques of artificial intelligence and to introduce its applications on manufacturing, service, and finance industries. The course focuses on inspring students for innovative artificial intelligence applications. The course includes: artificial intelligence basics, machine learn-ing, big data, deep learning, generative adversarial network, entrepreneurial thoughts, design thinking, business models, artificial intelligence and modern technologies, industry 4.0, real case applications on manufacturing, service, finance industries.

description.zh:
本行為經濟專題課程: 
1.	介紹全球總體經濟以及政經情勢探討: 從消費、投資、政府支出、進口、出口、外匯、利率、失業率、政府政策、地理位置等方面來分析經濟行為以及決策行為。
2.	介紹管理者或一般大眾在作決策時，會產生的心理偏誤。另外，也提供管理者或一般大眾如何避心理偏誤，並改善其決策程序，以心理學的角度來探討。
3.	從總體經濟數據中，找出可行投資方向。
4.	運用幾位諾貝爾經濟學獎得主之文章，來介紹公司(個人)行為決策
5.	公司或個人如何利用期貨選擇權來進行公司(個人)理財投資行為之介紹
description.en: The empirical and theoretical evidence for the efficient market hypothesis (EMH) has been challenged over the past two decades. Behavioural Economics starts from the premise that, in the real world, investors do not follow the rational assumptions which underlie the EMH. Behavioural Economics has developed to try to explain financial market anomalies which could effect the functioning of these markets.

description.en: Information Security provides a comprehensive view of information and communication security. This course content includes as follows: information security management international standards, information security policy and organization, human resource security, asset management, access control, cryptography and key management, physical and environmental security, operations and communication management system acquisition, development and maintenance, supplier management, information security incident management, operational sustainability management, information security aspects, systems and regulatory compliance.

description.zh: 本課程只在針對互聯網發展下如何釐清其中關鍵議題如什麼是互聯網、互聯網核心思維、互聯網與物聯網之區別、互聯網影響哪些行業、傳統性企業如何在物聯網時代轉型、及其未來之發展。之後其中之理論及各產業之應用案例之研討亦包含其中。
description.en: This course will focus on the development of the Internet for how to clarify the key issues such as what is the Internet, the Internet core thinking, the difference between the Internet+ and the Internet of Things, the impact of the Internet on which industry, how traditional enterprises in the era of things transition, and its future development. After which the theory and the application of the case study of the industry also includes them.

name.en: The Leadership Philosophy of Senior Manager

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹高階主管的領導理論與實務。課程目的有三個：(1)了解高階主管的領導與管理；(2)討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3)對實務界高階主管提供具體建議。
description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of senior manager’s leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is (especially for the senior managers); (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for senior managers’ leadership.

為因應瞬息萬變的金融投資環境，期許學生具備宏觀的投資管理知識，本課程以深入淺出方式介紹投資決策之基本觀念及理論架構。將財務投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。透過本課程之學習，促使投資人能獲取合理的投資報酬或擊敗大盤，領先各基金之績效，以制訂出正確的長短期投資決策。
In response to the rapidly changing environment of financial investments, expecting that students have knowledge of macro investment management, the major goal of this course is to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. It can give students the skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. Through the learning of this course, prompting investors to be able to obtain a reasonable return on investment or beat the market, ahead of the performance of each Fund, in order to work out the correct short and long term investment decisions.

description.zh: 此課程旨在以人因觀點，探討智慧生活之產品與服務。授課主要以個案探討方式，使學生了解人因相關概念與方法，特別是使用者經驗與人本設計，以及如何將這些概念與方法導入組織中，並應用於相關產品與服務之開發與設計。
description.en: This course focuses on the products and services of smart living from the perspective of human factors. Courses will generally be taught through case studies. Students will learn the concepts and methods related to human factors, especially user experience and user centered design, and how these concepts and methods to be introduced into organizations and applied to the development and design of those products and services.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 瞭解微算機之基本組織架構及應用，內容包含：1.PC之使用，2.微電腦學習機之使用，3.邏輯分析儀之使用，4.組合語言之設計與除錯，5.記憶體設計ROM/RAM，6.輸出入埠設計及程式控制，7.輸出入埠應用(鍵盤介面、LED顯示介面)，8.A/D、D/A介面設計，9.簡單PC介面卡設計(PIO及SIO)介面，單晶片之設計與應用。
description.en:
The experiment covers the basic architecture and application 
of microcomputer.The lab. work includes:
1.The usage of PC
2.The usage of microcomputer training machine
3.Logic analysis
4.The design and debug of assembly language
5.ROM/RAM design
6.I/O design and control 
7.A/D, D/A design
8.PC interfacing design
9.Single-chip microcomputer system design

name.en: System Design Using Hardware Description Language

description.zh: 本課程在訓練學生如何使用硬體描述語言來分析與設計數位積體電路及系統,進而能培養學生具有設計積體電路的能力,課程內容包括： 1.電腦輔助設計積體電路介紹 2.硬體描述語言程式設計與模擬介紹 3.積體電路設計軟體之介紹及使用 (Verilog) 4.FPGA ( Xilinx )的設計 5.專題設計
description.en:
This course is trained the student to use hardware-description language tools for the analysis and simulation of integrated circuits(digital & analysis) .Therefore, the student have the design capability of integrated circuit. The contents of this course: 
1.Introduction to the Computer-aided IC design 
2.System design using hardware description language 
3.Introduction to the computer-aided design of digital integrated circuits (Verilog) and computer-exercise 
4.FPGA(XILINX)design and computer-exercise 
5.Project

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一年級實施普通班體育正課教學。四技二、三年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一年級實施普通班體育正課教學。四技二、三年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class.  This requirement applies to Freshman Sophomore and Junior students while it is an elective for senior students.  For Freshman level, Classes focus on basic physical strength training.  For Sophomore and Junior students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

syllabi.outline: 教導學生閱讀囊括全球議題的文章，並藉由文章的內容作技巧的訓練，字彙的建構，語言的解析，及思維的啟發。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於教導學生能夠以線性代數中所提供之各種方法來求解線性連立方程組，並奠定研習線型規畫，作業研究，等課程之基礎。由於本系分兩組教學，因應之課程內容分別為：管理組：矩陣、方程式之解、行列式、向量、微分方程式及應用問題等。工程組：矩陣方程式之解、行列式、向量及向量空間等。
description.en: The objective of this course is to introduce the linear algebra by using several different methods to solve the linear dependent equations and to build up the fundamental knowledge of linear programming and Operation Research. Two groups instruct the contents of this course. For the engineering group the array, solution of combinatory equations, vectors, differential equations and its implementation are included. For the management group the array, solution of combinatory equations, vectors and vector spaces are included.

description.en: The objective of this course is to cultivate the programming ability for undergraduates. Python is the language used in this course since its simplicity and wideling applicable. The content of this course includes: installation of python, operators and expression, flow control, functions, module, data structure, input/output, class (OOP), and exception. Besdie, this course will introduce the commonly used packages, such as os, numpy, sys, picle, pillow, pyqt, etc.  There will be a terum project to let student experince team-working and system design and management.

description.zh: 本課程在於使同學瞭解管理思想的演進，與管理有關之重要理論，以及未來管理之發展趨勢。課程主要內容包括：組織與管理、管理哲學、管理思想的演進、管理功能（規畫、領導、組織、控制、評估）、溝通、組織成長與改變、未來之管理、個案研討。
description.en: This course will cover the progress of management, the theories of management and the future of management. It consists of 1. Organization and management. 2. Philosophies of management. 3. The function of management. 4. Communication. 5. The future of management. 6. Case studies.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

syllabi.outline:
ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.outline:
包括製作模型所需用之各種機械設備操作、使用工具、紙模型、工業油土等之加工技術。
Training students to operate some basically equipment such as bench work, sheet metal, machining, and welding machines safely and correctly, giving them the primary skills in model making.
syllabi.schedule:
第一階段 （1-5週）
1. 學生進行家具試作預備課程與木工基礎訓練。
2. 實際在教學現場（實習工廠）製作手工木工產品，經由老師現場講解，並經由操作示範後，學生自行操作木工機械：包括鋸切、鉋削、鑽孔與砂光等進行家具製作程序。


第二階段 （6-9週）
藉由口授、講義之影片、圖像與文字等詳述木製家具製程與實務，培養訓練學生對家具製造之程序、生產速度及各種工廠設備與製造系統之整合觀念，並配合教學進度至工廠實務操作與流程走位的方式進行理解加工生產線的環境狀況。


第三階段 （10-18週）
分為兩項考核方式進行
一、以場域實作與測驗的方式進行加工知識面向之考核：
1. 透過家具加工操作任務去測驗學生是否能夠充分理解各生產線流程之加工方式與用途，請學生實際的操演與示範講解。
2. 請學生實際透過分組規劃與討論去對應不同家具類型安排出正確之生產加工步驟與程序。
3. 另出應用題類型之不同家具產品所需的生產加工方式安排為何，請同學規劃並詳述之。
4. 業師的評估與觀察搭配產業實習的經驗回饋。

二、以實際操作機具的方式進行實務操作面向之考核：
操作內容包括：平刨機、裁切機、鑽孔機、砂磨機等，以本系實作工廠之現有機台為主，測驗學生是否能熟練運用木工加工所需之機具與了解生產線之間的關係與相關注意事項。

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh:
先修課程:負責教授同意
物質熱力學特性，改變能量形式之基本原理，熱力學第一及第二定律，可逆性與可用性，動力循環，冷凍循環，混合氣，化學反應。
description.en: Thermodynamic Properties of Substance, Energy Forms, The First Law of Thermodynamics, The Second Law of Thermodynamics, Irreversibility & Availability, Power Cycle, Refrigeration Systems, Mixtures, Chemical Reactions.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程:負責教授同意
物質熱力學特性，改變能量形式之基本原理，熱力學第一及第二定律，可逆性與可用性，動力循環，冷凍循環，混合氣，化學反應。
Thermodynamic Properties of Substance, Energy Forms, The First Law of Thermodynamics, The Second Law of Thermodynamics, Irreversibility & Availability, Power Cycle, Refrigeration Systems, Mixtures, Chemical Reactions.
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：簡介與基礎、熱力系統與控制容積、物質的性質與狀態、熱力學第零定律、純物質之物理行為。
第二週：國訂假日。
第三週：P-v-T 熱力表面、熱力性質表、液態固態與過熱蒸汽狀態、理想氣體狀態、狀態方程式。
第四週：能量方程式、熱力學第一定律、機械能、功、熱、熱傳模式、內能、問題分析與解題。
第五週：焓、等容與等壓比熱、理想氣體之內能、焓與比熱，牽涉功的一般系統及工程應用。
第六週：質量守恆與控制容積、控制容積的能量方程式、穩態過程及實例。
第七週：國訂假日。
第八週：熱交換器、噴嘴、擴散器、節流閥、渦輪機、風扇、壓縮機與泵、熱機與冷凍機熱力系統循環。
第九週：期中考
第十週：多重流道設備、暫態流動過程、流動系統與流動裝置、被動及主動流動裝置與系統、熱效率、性能係數。
第十一週：熱力學第二定律、可逆過程、過程不可逆的因素、卡諾循環及效率的兩個定理、熱力與理想氣體溫標、理想與真實熱機。 
第十二週：克勞休斯不等式、第一類及第二類永動機、熵、理想氣體的熵變化、控制質量不可逆過程的熵變化、熵產生量與熵方程式、熵增原理。
第十三週：以變化率方程式表示的熵、熵與亂度、控制容積之熵方程式、熵增定律。 
第十四週：能量守恆與元件效率、可用能(Exergy)與其平衡方程式、第二定律效率。
第十五週：動力與冷凍系統、朗肯循環、重熱循環、再生循環與給水加熱器、熱電聯產、冷凍系統、壓縮蒸汽冷凍循環。 
第十六週：空氣標準動力循環、布雷頓/燃氣輪機/噴射推進/往復式引擎/奧圖/狄塞爾/史特林循環。
第十七週：動力與冷凍系統之組合循環、氣體與蒸汽混合物、絕熱飽和過程、濕球與乾球溫度以及濕度圖。 
第十八週：期末考。

description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

syllabi.outline:
美學宗師朱光潛《談文學》：「文學是一種與人生最密切相關的藝術」；古希臘哲學家亞里斯多德《詩學》：「人的描寫居於文學的首要地位；而人生，勢必成為文學表現的主要對象，或文學表現的核心問題」。作家透過文字書寫，分享經過歲月積澱的生命經驗，反映時代現實，譜出喜怒哀樂之生命樂章；吾人透過閱讀，徜徉在文學世界當中，與作品中傳達的哲思、情感、人生故事共鳴，開拓視野，增加閱歷，思考生命存在的價值與意義。由此可知，文學與吾人現實人生誠習習相關。
本「國語文實務應用」課程，擬擷選中國古今文學作品，引領修課同學感受文學之美，體悟在塵世的繁華裡，古今情感、哲思的傳遞是有時空隔閡，是可以心心相映。由於是一學年課程，因此上學期課程內容，首先以文字與音樂交會之旅、詩歌的遊戲與創作此二單元，引領修課同學感受文字有何力量，以及詩情、詩意之況味。爾後，將擷選古今文史哲作品，引領同學認識文學中的愛情、文學中的親情。待下學期，接續引領修課同學認識文學中的友情、文學中的家國情、文學中的山水情。由此，再進一步思考如何擁抱幸福美好的人生、如何尋找讓自身幸福的青鳥。課堂中，將以講授與問題討論方式，對上課文本作深度的探討與詮釋。希冀修課同學們能掘發文學作品要義，探討文學與人生的關係，並進一步回歸吾人生命本身意義之探索。此外，並希冀修課同學能藉由閱讀、思考、書寫、討論，內觀自己的生命情境與思路，外觀蒼穹宇宙，自在悠遊於成長之道路。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 
    奠基於大學之前12年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en:
This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life.
 Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本課程可使學生瞭解：貨幣與資金市場、投資問題、如何取得資金與運用資金、使公司價值最大、使股東權益最大化、瞭解代理制度、瞭解公司股票、債務之利用，股利政策等事項。
description.en: This course has provided: money and capital market、Investments 、How to obtaining and using funds、Maximize the value o their firms、How to maximize stockholders' stock、To know agency problem 、To know the price of the firm's stock, use of debt and dividend policy.

syllabi.schedule:
第  一  週 財務管理導論
第  二  週 財務管理的企業角色, 代理問題：起源與解決之道
第  三  週 貨幣的時間價值(I)：終值與現值,應用實例
第  四  週 貨幣的時間價值(II)：年金終值與年金現值
第  五  週 認識財務報表: 主要的財務報表, 財務比率分析, 財務報表分析的限制
第  六  週 風險與報酬的衡量, 風險與報酬的基本關係
第  七  週 多角化的內涵, 資本資產訂價模式
第  八  週 股票評價模式：股利折現模式, 股票評價的衍生課題
第  九  週 期中考
第  十  週 認識債券, 債券評價模式
第十一週 資金成本的內涵, 加權平均資金成本的估計
第十二週 資本預算決策的內涵, 決策方法與實例,互斥型方案的評估
第十三週 常見的資本預算決策, 進行評估之前的準備工作, 資本預算與風險分析
第十四週 企業如何制定資本結構, 公司如何籌措長期資金
第十五週 股利與股利政策, 股利政策理論,實務上的股利政策
第十六週  財務規劃與預測：銷售額預測, 資金需求預測, 外部融資與企業成長的關係
第十七週 營運資金政策, 現金與有價證券管理, 應收帳款管理, 存貨管理
第十八週 期末考
*實際進度將視教學狀況調整*

description.zh:
本課程將討論凝固組織之控制因子，平衡及非平衡狀態下金屬凝固
現象，凝固界面之溶質分佈，單晶成長技術，凝固之過冷界面穩定
理論，共晶型組織之成長，凝固之熱流分析，凝固之成核成長及粗
性及均質處，理凝固理論之應用及鑄造工程簡介。
description.en:
The subject area covers the following topics: Control variable of solidification structure and its application; Single crystal growths from the melt and solid; Heat flow in single crystal growth; Solute distribution in solidification, various cases will be treated in detail; Constitutional 
undercooling and interface stability; Solidification of castings and ingots; Lamellar eutectic growth; Nucleation growth and coarsening; Foundry engineering; Defects analysis in cast construction.

description.en: The aim of the "Energy Storage Material and Application" class is designed for students to get the basic understanding for the energy storage devices and materials. The energy storage devices contain the aqueous electrolyte system battery, non-aqueous electrolyte system battery, lithium battery, super capacitor and hydrogen storage alloy. The reaction mechanism, application, material structure and electrochemical property of energy storage devices are also studied in this class. The class includes :  1.Course troduction,2.Electrochemical Theory and Application,  3.Types and Applications for Aqueous System Battery , 4.Types and Applications for Non-Aqueous System Battery,  5.Theory, Reaction Mechanism, Market, Application, Structure and Process for Lithium Batteries,  6.Material Structure, Synthesis and Application of Various Cathode Materials, 7.Material Structure, Synthesis and Application of Various Anode Materials, 8.Electrolyte Material and Polymer Battery, etc.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹薄膜製作有關的基礎理論與技術。講述內容包括真空技術，薄膜基礎，薄膜製作技術，蝕刻技術，薄膜評估方法以及薄膜技術的應用等。讓學生認識薄膜在高科技產業上的應用與其重要性，製作薄膜的方法與技術以及其未來的發展。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Thin films technology and Thin film materials science. 2. Vacuum science and technology 3. Thin film evaporation processes 4. Discharge, plasma, and ion-surface interaction 5. Plasma and ion beam processing of thin films 6. Chemical vapor deposition 7. Substrate surfaces and thin film nucleation 8. Film structure 9. Characterization of thin films and surface 10. Interdiffusion, reactions, and transformations in thin films 11. Mechanical properties of thin films.

syllabi.outline:
薄膜科技是當今各式高科技製造業最不可或缺的技術之一，相關技術影響範疇包含電子、光電、半導體製造業、表面工程、高硬度高強度、耐磨抗腐蝕、裝飾與保護等等。薄膜技術種類與相關配合技術繁多，隨產業發展各項技術亦不斷進化，本課程涵蓋相關薄膜成長概論與原理，並搭配實作課程，期望讓學生認識薄膜在科技產業上的應用，並了解其重要性及未來的發展。
本課程包含以下主題：
1.	薄膜沉積 (Thin film deposition)
2.	薄膜材料表面能、擴散行為、應力等介紹 (Review of surface energy, diffusion, and stress in thin films)
3.	薄膜的化學能與表面動態行為 (Chemical potentials and surface kinetic processes)
4.	同質磊晶與異質磊晶 (Homogenius epitaxy and heterogenius epitaxy growth)
5.	互擴散 (Interdiffusion)
6.	蕭基能障 (Schottky barrier)
7.	矽化物薄膜形成 (Silicide formation and thin film reaction)
8.	電遷移機制 (Electromigration)
9.     薄膜分析技術 (Thin film characterization)


Thin film science and technology have gone through a thorough development which results in numerous new materials and advanced applications. Thin film research shares the knowledge from multi-disciplines, such as materials science, chemistry, solid state physics, mechanics and etc.. This course is an introductory class for students who are interested in thin film technology. Lab or tour session(s) will be provided to promote teaching and learning.

The topics will cover:
1.	薄膜沉積 (Thin film deposition)
2.	薄膜材料表面能、擴散行為、應力等介紹 (Review of surface energy, diffusion, and stress in thin films)
3.	薄膜的化學能與表面動態行為 (Chemical potentials and surface kinetic processes)
4.	同質磊晶與異質磊晶 (Homogenius epitaxy and heterogenius epitaxy growth)
5.	互擴散 (Interdiffusion)
6.	蕭基能障 (Schottky barrier)
7.	矽化物薄膜形成 (Silicide formation and thin film reaction)
8.	電遷移機制 (Electromigration)
9.     薄膜分析技術 (Thin film characterization)

name.en: Special Topics of Instrumental Analytical Chemistry

description.zh: 由量子化學及結晶化學等理論為基礎，討論一些分析儀器的原理，構造及應用。特別是原子光譜法，電化學分析法及離子層析儀及質譜儀等，針對無機物之分析方法。
description.en: Considering the theories of quantum and crystal chemistry, discuss the theories, structure and applications of some instruments.  Those are used for chemical analysis, especially for inorganic materials: atomic spectroscopy, electrochemical analysis methods, ion-exchange chromatography and mass spectroscopy.

syllabi.outline:
由量子化學及結晶化學等理論為基礎，討論一些分析儀器的原理，構造及應用。特別是原子光譜法，電化學分析法及離子層析儀及質譜儀等，針對無機物之分析方法。
Considering the theories of quantum and crystal chemistry, discuss the theories, structure and applications of some instruments.  Those are used for chemical analysis, especially for inorganic materials: atomic spectroscopy, electrochemical analysis methods, ion-exchange chromatography and mass spectroscopy.
syllabi.schedule:
Material Chemistry
Allotropes of carbon-fullerene (C60), 1D, 2D, and 3D carbon nanostructure, and graphene. Boron materials: borophene, and borospherene, Metals alloys, delafossite material, zeolites, Microporous, and mesoporous materials: Structure, properties, and application. semiconductors, superconductors, insulators, ceramics, and glass. 
Electrochemistry
Voltammetry: Cyclic voltammetry, linear sweep voltammetry, differential pulse voltammetry, amperometry, chronopotentiometry, oxidations, and reductions. Types of electrode and electrode reactions: Standard Electrode Potentials, Standard Hydrogen Electrode, Calomel electrode, Carbon electrodes, Microelectrodes, Ultra-micro electrodes, Ion-selective electrodes, porous electrodes, Semiconductor electrodes, Hydrodynamic/Rotating disk electrodes. Electrolytes, classification of electrolytes, liquid, solid electrolytes. Reversible, quasi-reversible, and Irreversible electrode processes, Characteristics of commonly used working electrodes such as glassy carbon, pyrolytic graphite, platinum, and reference electrodes. Liquid junction potential, salt bridge, conductometric and potentiometric titrations (acid-base).
Modified electrodes and their application, Electrochemical sensor: Fundamentals of electrochemical sensors, Electrochemical sensor for food and water analysis, Electrochemical DNA sensors. Design of third-generation electrochemical sensors. Electroanalytical chemistry in neuroscience. Electrochemistry sensors of biological molecules like glucose, insulin, and cholesterol. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and their application. Electrochemical quartz crystal microbalance and its applications. Electrochemical cell-redox reaction, electrode potential, EMF. Corrosion: Basics, chemical, and electrochemical principles corrosion, and electrodeposition. Electrochemical CO2 reduction, Electrochemical detection of environmental pollutants.
Electrochemical devices and techniques: Fundamental concepts of electrochemical energy conversion and storage, irreversible systems. Supercapacitors and their working principle. Electrochemical energy systems, lithium batteries, photocathode.  Fuel cells: Electrode materials, fuel cell research. Batteries: Principles of operation of cells and batteries; Electrochemical principles and reactions; Factors affecting battery performance; Battery design; Fundamentals of Primary cells and batteries, secondary batteries, Advanced lead-acid, Ni-based and lithium-ion batteries, next-generation batteries, materials for batteries, batteries electrode preparation, cell assembly, electrochemical performance analysis. Fuel cells: Introduction to fuel cells: working principle, direct methanol fuel cells, proton exchange membrane fuel cells, alkaline fuel cells, phosphoric acid, solid oxide, molten carbonate Fuel cells. 
Debye - Huckel - Onsager Equation, Kinetics- over-potential, Butler Volmer equation, Tafel equation, Nernst equation. Electrochemical cells: Galvanic cell, Daniel cell, Half-cell, Overpotential, Oxidation potential, Reduction potential. The rate of charge transfer, Current density, Ionic equilibria, Electro Kinetic Phenomena, Electrical double layer potential, Zeta potential, electro-osmosis, and sedimentation potential.

emphasizes on the subjest of matrix computation(theory) and the

technique of mathematical proving.The outline of the course 

includes the following:

1.Systems of Linear Equations

2.Matrices

  Linear Programming.

This course covers fundamentals of mathematics in matrix theory and linear algebra. Emphasis is given to topics that will be useful in other disciplines, including 
systems of equations, 
vector spaces, 
determinants, 
eigenvalues, 
and similarity.

Week 18: Final

description.en:
This course is designed for graduate students and will provide a solid analytical and practical experience on a variety of aspects in robotics. Topics in the course are as follows.
1.         Spatial descriptions and transformations 
2.         Manipulation kinematics
3.         Inverse manipulator kinematics
4.         Jacobians: velocities and static forces
5.         Manipulator dynamics
6.         Trajectory generation
7.         Control of manipulators
8.         Machine vision
9.         Industrial automation applications
10.      Laboratory work: control of manipulators and mobile robots, automatic manipulation with vision sensors, navigation and control of mobile robots
Senior undergraduate students are allowed to take this course in case they are approved by the instructor.

syllabi.outline:
Advanced Robotics and Automation Applications (ARAA) course is offered only for up to 28 graduate students with programming experience. In addition to lectures on robotic manipulation, ARAA requires oral presentations and reports on robotics papers also focuses on projects with mobile robots and manipulators in the topics of interest related to:

1. Spatial descriptions and transformations  2. Manipulator kinematics  3. Manipulator inverse kinematics  4. Paper presentation and report  5. Project topics: manipulator and mobile robot control, and robot control system based on visual sensing

Course handouts will be available via iStudy web. In addition to homework assignments, a number of quizzes will be taken weekly during lectures. The quiz questions are based on problem sets in the textbook. Each student is required to make an oral presentation and submit a report based on a technical paper preferably related to proposed final project in related topics. All projects must be completed and evaluated in class under supervision of Professor and TA with particular attention to equipment operation safety.

description.en: The data mining (DM), which involves in Statistics, Database and Artificial Intelligence fields, prospects to seek Useful information from a great deal of data. The topic includes the concept of DM, the function of DM, the step of DM, data warehouse, Decision Trees Analysis, Clustering Analysis, Association Rule and Basket Analyzes, etc.

“Necessity is the mother of invention”—Data mining—Automated analysis of massive data sets.
Data mining (knowledge discovery from data) : Extraction of interesting (non-trivial, implicit, previously unknown and potentially useful) patterns or knowledge from huge amount of data.

description.zh: 電源轉換器(Power Converter)設計須滿足高效率及高功率密度的要求，因應此需求需搭配轉換器架構的選用、新型寬能隙元件的應用、高頻磁性元件的設計、柔性切換技術(Soft Switching Techniques)。在本次課程將會介紹這些技術的原理及設計方法及高效能轉換器的技術核心：變壓器(Transformer)與磁性元件的設計要領及寬能隙元件應用的介紹。藉由理論探討與模擬實作，加強學生的理論知識與實作能力。
description.en: The design of power converters is being pushed to meet the requirements of high efficiency and high power density. In response to this demand, the selection of converter architecture, the application of new wide bandgap devices, the design of high-frequency magnetic components, and soft switching techniques are needed. This course introduces the principles and design methods of these technologies and the core technical aspects of high-efficiency converters, including the design of transformers and magnetic components, and the application of wide bandgap devices. This course is aimed at graduate students. Students can strengthen their theoretical knowledge and practical ability through theoretical discussion and simulation practice from this course.

name.zh: 數位電源控制與電路設計
name.en: Digital Power Supply Control and Circuit Design

description.zh: 數位電源為目前各大電源轉換電路公司研究的議題。本課程將介紹數位電源轉換器的動作模式、控制與實作考量，配合模擬軟體驗證理論，最後以數位電源設計實例進行探討。本課程藉由理論探討與模擬實作，加強學生的理論知識與實作能力。
description.en: Digital power supply design is a major industrial topic. This course introduces the operation and control of digital power converters, and discusses the design principles and their implementation considerations. Simulation is used to validate the theory learned in this course. Also, digital power supply design examples are discussed in detail. Students can strengthen their theoretical knowledge and practical ability through theoretical discussion and simulation practice from this course.

description.zh: 本課程將探討錯誤診斷系統理論與相關控制系統工程知識，將以馬達與鋰電池為例，實際應用錯誤診斷理論，並學習錯誤診斷的實現與應用技巧。本課程藉由理論推導與程式模擬實作，協助學生專精控制工程領域知識，並透過期刊文章研讀與討論，進一步加強學生創新思考與簡報專業論文之能力。
description.en: This course investigates fault diagnosis system algorithms and their relevant control system engineering knowledges. This course takes motors and lithium-ion batteries as examples to implement the fault diagnosis algorithms and to learn the implementation skills of fault diagnosis algorithms. The goal of this course is to improve students’ control engineering domain knowledge though algorithm derivation, coding and simulations; also, to enhance students’ innovative thinking capabilities and presentation skills through journal paper reviewing and discussions.

description.en: Objective of this course is to improve oral presentation ability.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目標為增進研究生之英文表達能力。包含:
1. 此課程主要分成三大部分：(1) 簡報前準備工作和簡報注意要點；(2) 簡報開場、結尾、內容表達技巧；(3) 個人簡歷報告和表達技巧。 2. 課堂中引導學生於課程中探討與分析簡報技巧，比較不同說法的優缺點，同時找出適合自己的表達方式。 3. 除了解說中規中矩的開場簡報說法外，同時分享吸引聽眾注意的開場簡報技巧。 4. 本課程強調「實用性」與「創造性」，為了加強學習過程和效率，將以引導方式讓學生在課堂中有充分練習機會，加深學習印象。

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作，包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧，正確組織文章的各個片段，避免口語用字寫字的陋習，使所作之文章能掌握其涵意，亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Thesis Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

syllabi.outline: 本課程有系統的教授英文寫作技巧，藉由課堂活動及回家作業等給予學生們實際去練習備忘錄、信件以及論文寫法並試著報告。
syllabi.schedule:
Instructions and procedures are documents that help either developers or end users operate or configure a device or program.
 
Proposals. Most projects begin with a proposal—a document that describes the purpose of a project, the tasks that will be performed in the project, the methods used to complete the project, and finally the cost of the project.

Emails, letters, and memoranda are some of the most frequently written documents in a business.
 
Press releases. When a company wants to publicly reveal a new product or service, they will have a technical writer author a press release, a document that describes the product's functions and value to the public.
 
Specifications are design outlines that describe the structure, parts, packaging, and delivery of an object or process in enough detail that another party can reconstruct it
. 
Descriptions are shorter explanations of procedures and processes that help readers understand how something works.
 
Rsums and job applications are another example of technical documents. 
Technical reports are written to provide readers with information, instructions, and analysis on tasks. 

Case study is a published report about a person, group, or situation that has been studied over time; also : a situation in real life that can be looked at or studied to learn about something.
 
White papers are documents that are written for experts in a field and typically describe a solution to a technological or business challenge or problem.

name.zh: 鐵道車輛系統與維修基地
name.en: Railway Vehicle System and Maintenance Depot

description.zh: 「鐵道車輛系統與維修基地」課程，乃為培養具有鐵路車輛分析設計及檢修技術操作能力之人員，掌握鐵道裝備設計製造、檢修的基礎知識與應用能力，具有鐵道車輛製造、檢修、運用、管理等綜合職業能力和創新精神的高素質技能型專門人才。本課程將從鐵道車輛基本結構開始介紹，並探討鐵道車輛與鐵道基礎之互制關係。而後導入各式特殊鐵道車輛設計之原理與用途，如：高速客車、傾斜式列車、自導向系統….等，並研討各種車型之行駛穩定性與脫軌風險計算方式。最後介紹鐵道車輛維修之概念與實務，並介紹維修基地之設計與配置，再導入先進預兆健康預防檢修法與AR技術於檢修之應用與發展。
description.en: This course of "Railway Vehicle System and Maintenance Depot" will cover the basic design criteria of the railway vehicle, its sub-systems and integration. We will discuss factors that affect the design, sizing, manufacturing and maintenance of the sub-systems of the railway vehicle, including their integration with other sub-systems to work as one complete train. Various factors affecting reliability, accessibility and maintainability will be addressed. Then several types of vehicle (high-speed-vehicle, tilting train, self-guide bogie will be introduced to determine the dynamic stability and derailment risk. Finally, the design of maintenance depot will be studied and the latest technologies (PHM, AR) on railway vehicle maintenance will be introduced.

syllabi.outline:
Heat and Mass Transfer is a vital subject for mechanical, chemical, production, aeronautical 
and metallurgical engineering disciplines. As a result of its multidisciplinary nature, it has 
many engineering applications. This course will introduce to students basic understanding of 
heat and mass transfer processes and their application to engineering problems. T
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1.  INTRODUCTION – Typical heat transfer situations, Modes of heat transfer Introduction to laws, some heat transfer parameters 
Week 2.  CONDUCTION – Fourier’s law and thermal conductivity 1 hour 
Differential equation of heat conduction, boundary conditions and initial conditions 
Week 3.  Simple one dimensional steady state situations – plane wall, cylinder, sphere (simple and compex situations), concept of thermal resistance, concept of U, critical radius. variable thermal conductivity (exercise) 3 hours 
Week 4.  Special one dimensional steady state situations – heat generation, pin fins Other fin configurations (exercise) 
Week 5.  Two dimensional steady state situations 
Transient conduction Lumped capacitance model One dimensional transient problems – analytical solutions One dimensional Heisler charts Product solution 
Week 6.  Numerical methods in conduction Steady state one dimensional and two dimensional problems One dimensional transient problems – Explicit and implicit 
Week 7.  RADIATION Basic ideas, spectrum, basic definitions 1 hour 
Laws of radiation, black body radiation, Planck’s law, Stefan Boltzman law, Wien’s Displacement law, Lambert cosine law 
Week 8.  Convection heat transfer
FORCED CONVECTION Concepts of fluid mechanics  
Differential equation of heat convection  
Week 9. Mid term
Week 10.  Laminar flow heat transfer in circular pipe – constant heat flux and constant wall temperature, thermal entrance region, Turbulent flow heat transfer in circular pipe, pipes of other cross sections  
Week 11.  Heat transfer in laminar flow and turbulent flow over a flat plate, Reynolds analogy, Flow across a cylinder and sphere, flow across banks of tubes, impinging jets 
Week 12.  NATURAL CONVECTION Introduction, governing equations,Vertical plate – Pohlhausen solution, horizontal cylinder, horizontal plate, enclosed spaces  
Week 13.  HEAT EXCHANGERS Types of heat exchangers, LMTD approach – parallel, counter-flow, multi-pass and cross flow heat exchanger, NTU approach – parallel, counterflow, shell and tube, cross flow heat exchanger 
Week 14.  Condensation and Boiling Dimensionless parameters, boiling modes, correlations, 
Week 15.  Forced convection boiling, laminar film condensation on a vertical plate, turbulent film condensation  
Week 16.  Mass Transfer Analogy between heat and mass transfer, mass diffusion, Fick’s law of diffusion, boundary conditions, 
week 17.  steady mass diffusion through a wall, transient mass diffusion, mass convection, limitations of heat and mass transfer analogy. 
Week 18 final term

description.zh: 介紹各種潔淨且高效率的先進車輛動力系統的型式及其工作原理並分析技巧。項目包含車輛能源所面臨的一些問題及可能的解決方案、優良動力源的特性、電動系統、複合電動系統、複合氣動系統、氫燃料電池動力系統、金屬燃料電池動力系統、各種替代性燃料的特性及優缺點、太陽光電輔助動力系統等。
description.en: This course introduces various kinds of clean and high-efficiency vehicular power systems, their operation principles, and analytical skills.  Topics include: problems and possible solutions the vehicular power system faces, characteristics of a good vehicular power system, electric power system, hybrid electric power system, hybrid pneumatic power system, fuel cell power system, metallic fuel-cell power system, substitutive fuels, and solar-energy auxiliary power system.

description.en: This course presents fundamentals of Hybrid Electric Vehicles: HEV concepts and design, energy analysis, unified modeling approach, optimization and control.  The power consumption side of vehicles. Conventional power generation: IC engine overview, concepts of hybridization, general model of energy form and energy flows, on-board energy storage (fuels and batteries). Overview of electrochemical converters: motors, transmissions for HEVs, principles of fuel cells, HEV application. Principles of energy optimization in HEVs.

description.zh: 介紹各種潔淨且高效率的先進車輛動力系統的型式及其工作原理並分析技巧。項目包含車輛能源所面臨的一些問題及可能的解決方案、優良動力源的特性、電動系統、複合電動系統、複合氣動系統、氫燃料電池動力系統、金屬燃料電池動力系統、各種替代性燃料的特性及優缺點、太陽光電輔助動力系統等。
description.en: This course introduces various kinds of clean and high-efficiency vehicular power systems, their operation principles, and analytical skills. description.en: The course begins with a lot of figure sketching. You have to care about all walks of life, and actively observe and record their figures. Try to master both the charm and the form of the model.  Next focusing on static mono-figure sketching, you have to demonstrate your techniques in presenting either the static or the dynamic, the state of tension or looseness. You also have to be precise in proportion when you do your sketch. Stress definitely on the practice of speediness, simplicity, accuracy, and preciseness. Also work on static twin-figure and multi-figure sketching. description.zh: Brundtland報告在1987年將永續發展定義為「在不損害後代子孫滿足其自身需求的能力的前提下滿足當前需求的發展。」17個永續發展目標依循千禧年共同訂定發展目標的成功基礎上延展，其中包括諸如氣候變化，經濟不平等，創新，可持續消費，和平與正義等新領域。17個永續發展目標更於2016年1月成為聯合國致力發展推動政策及生效直至2030年。本課程旨在探討研究「永續發展」新概念和理論基礎。課程論述著重於工業化國家（尤其是台灣地區）的永續性問題，例如人口老齡化，可持續消費等。課程中透過創新產品設計與開發方法來系統化引導學生探索有關可持續性，經濟和技術層面以及相關知識社會學，並嘗試帶領學生提出具可行性的新產品、系統及服務概念，為當前狀態下提供更好的友善環境解決方案。課程期待學生透過修習該課程，應可以掌握跨學科永續發展的設計原理，並教導如何藉由創新產品設計和開發方法來引導不同永續相關背景和設計背景的專業人員合作以瞭解開發市場上成功之環境友善產品之關鍵課題，針對環境需求，提出創新友善環境解決方案並進而產生創新環境友善產品。

Sustainable development is defined by Brundtland Report (1987) as “development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.” There are 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) built on the successes of the Millennium Development Goals, including new areas such as climate change, economic inequality, innovation, sustainable consumption, peace and justice, among other priorities. The 17 SDGs came into effect in January 2016, and they will continue to guide UNDP policy and funding until 2030. This course aims to explore alternative conceptions and theoretical underpinnings of the notion of “sustainable development.” It intends to use the IPDD approach systematically to explore the sociology of knowledge around sustainability, the economic and technological dimensions and institutional imperatives along with implications for the political constitution of economic performance and design the feasibility of new products, systems, or services for better solutions in current status. To enable students to master the principles of interdisciplinary sustainable development, and teach them how to use innovative product design and development approaches to guide professionals in sustainability backgrounds and design backgrounds to understand the key issues in developing successful sustainable products in the market and address the needs of consumer services, propose innovative solutions for the environment, and develop innovative sustainable products.

description.zh: 本科目主旨在於加強學生使用語言的表達能力、並促使學生更加容易瞭解學術論文。每週的課程是由一系列連貫性的論文來引導學生去學習即分析論文，並能以口語、寫作正確地表達出所分析論文的含義。這些所提供的研究論文都具備可精闢分析的要素。這些文章的內容有包含習慣的不同、事件的相對面、意見的分歧、喜好的差異、演繹法即歸納法得的結論等等。
description.en: This course aims to enhance oral and written communication skills and in the process provide a greater understanding of the philosophy underlying academic discourse. Weekly units are oriented around a progressive series of tasks which consider academic texts in context and require learners to understand, analyse and produce spoken and written texts appropriate to the context of academic English. The contextualisation of these tasks is the philosophical aspects of critical analysis. Themes, such as the difference between convention, fact, opinion and preference; deductive and inductive proof; validity and truth; evidence; and the ethics of persuasion, are the basis on which the skills are taught.

description.zh: 藉由國內外設計競賽主題與產學合作設計案進行實際演練，著重於資料蒐集、商品分析、創新構想與成果表達之進階能力養成，期讓學生在國內外設計競賽舞台上展現光芒，在產學合作中習得實務經驗並獲致產業界肯定。因此本課程旨在以實際演練達成兼具創新性與商品化專業設計能力養成。
description.en: Advanced Integrated Design educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment. Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas. Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues. There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

syllabi.outline: 透過資料搜集及分析並探討現今社會的各種現象及問題，藉以了解設計在其所能扮演的角色。透過設計企劃提案討論出解決問題之對策。

description.en: Advanced Integrated Design educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment. Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas. Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues. There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

syllabi.outline: 透過資料搜集及分析並探討現今社會的各種現象及問題，藉以了解設計在其所能扮演的角色。透過設計企劃提案討論出解決問題之對策。

name.en: The Acquisition and Application of Advanced English Lexical Use

description.zh:
此課程旨在協助學生建立相當於美國大學入學測驗的高階字彙，亦即相當於接受高等教育之英語系國家人士所具備的用字能力。此課程將通過故事方式介紹此類字彙，其中也包括字形學之解析。學生修習此課程後應能將高階字彙使用於正確的上下文中，因此可達成下列諸目的：
"	提昇高階字彙數量
"	加強英文閱讀能力
"	習得重要字源解析
"	避免上下文中的用字錯誤
"	提高英語表達能力
"	加強英文寫作能力
"	精進英語文溝通技巧
description.en:
This course aims to help students build a more powerful vocabulary on the SAT (the qualifying exam for US college admission) level, i.e. the level of proficiency of an educated native speaker's. Students will be introduced to the lexical use through story scenes. Morphological analysis of the words will be included in the course. At the exit of this course, students are expected to use them in their proper contexts and hence reach the following goals:
"	Develop a powerful vocabulary
"	Improve reading skills
"	Learn important word roots
"	Avoid word usage error in context
"	Become a better speaker
"	Strengthen his/her writing ability
"	Improve communication skills

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to create a context for our students to clearly express themselves in English and to effectively communicate with others on current issues most relatable to them as young adults.
syllabi.schedule:
I.	Syllabus:
Week 1: Introduction
Why do you think there are less high school students choose English as their major? Why do you think there are more and more high school students choose other Asian languages, especially Korean and Japanese, as their major? 
.
Theme One: The second semester into university
Week 2: 
How to balance yourself between school course work and extra-curriculum activities?

Week 3: Are there too many required courses for freshman students? Shall a university student just focus on the courses that interests him/her?

Week 4: 
Do you still have the habit of procrastination? How do you tackle this problem?

Week 5: 
How to cover all the expenses for a university student studying in Taipei city? Will you try to live within your budget? Are you looking for a part-time job?
Week 6: Have you used social apps to make friends? What are the advantages and disadvantages of making friends on social apps?

Week 7: 
Are you interested in cultivating a second and even a third specialization? 
Do you know your potential and goal(s) in life?

Week 8:
Are you planning to study abroad (or work overseas) in the near future?
Or, you would like to stay in Taiwan?
What motivates you to do so? What do you plan to achieve?

Week 9 (Mid-term exam week): midterm group presentations
.
Theme Two: Let's observe the cross-cultural differences in daily conversation
Week 10:
How do people in different area/languages express love?
Week 11: 
How do people in different area/languages express refusal?
Week 12: 
How do people in different area/languages express embarrassment?
Week 13: 
How do people in different area/languages express jealousy?
.
Theme Three: Let's observe the voice of a character
Week 14: 
The voice of Emma Thompson
Week 15: 
The voices of Tom Hiddleston
Week 16: 
The voices of Benedict Cumberbatch
Week 17: 
The voice of Sir David Attenborough

Week 18 (Final examination week): Final group presentations

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生熟稔運用基本重要文法以寫出正確自然, 表達清晰之句子.  內容包括語法結構和錯誤分析, 例如不完整句、誤置修飾語、不連結修飾語、散漫句、錯誤平行結構、易混淆字、贅詞等常見問題。
description.en: This course is intended to provide a review of essential grammar skills as a background for students to construct sentences that convey ideas effectively and clearly.  The main content includes the correction of sentence fragments, run-on sentences, misplaced modifiers, dangling modifiers, and faulty parallelism.  Further focus is placed on varying syntactical structure, and on avoiding errors related to commonly confused words, slang, pretentious wording, cliches, and wordiness.

description.zh: 本課程目的在啟發學生英語聽力，分析及思辨能力。本課程自報紙，雜誌及電視選取豐富的新聞及媒體教材, 以訓練聽力及筆記的技巧。 此外，在課堂上將討論一些有爭議性的或者有趣的議題，以培養學生獨立思辨能力。
description.en: The course aims to develop the student's techniques of listening, analyzing and critical thinking in English. A variety of journalistic and media texts will be selected from newspapers, magazines and T.V. to reinforce listening training and note-taking skills. Besides, some controversial or interesting issues will be discussed in class to encourage the student's independent and critical thinking.

syllabi.outline: This is an introductory course aiming to familiarize students with basic concepts of translation, including qualifications of good translators, the procedure of translation, use of references & electronic tools and the idea of translation equivalence. Also, the relevance of contrastive studies between English and Chinese to translation will be introduced. A guided application of the linguistic knowledge to practical work will be provided, in the interest of assisting students in formulating suitable and appropriate translation strategies and techniques. This course is intended to prepare students for more specialized translation training.

description.zh: 為什麼要閱讀或研究莎士比亞? Catherine Belsey 回答道：是為了莎翁的獨特性。如她所言：「莎士比亞不僅是英語世界上流社會文化的精華，亦為其整體文化的精髓。」因為莎劇的辭彙，迄今仍通用於英語世界，並已融入日常生活之結構中。這現象不僅發生在現在的英國，自莎翁的時代開始，莎翁的語彙在全世界就從未停止流通過。何況，莎翁震撼人心的詩歌和劇場藝術，無人出其右的人性掌握，以及非凡的人生哲學思維與洞見，向來受到世人的珍愛。如世人常謂：莎士比亞的語言可觸發我們的想像力，為我們在人生的各個層面(包括職業層面)提升溝通效率。為了這些重要的理由，本課程將引導學生欣賞莎士比亞的若干劇作。
description.en: Why Shakespeare? Catherine Belsey answers that it is because of his singularity. As she observes, "Shakespeare is part and parcel of English-speaking culture, and not only high culture." For "phrases from the plays are still current, woven into the fabric of everyday life" in Britain now and have, in fact, been circulated in the world since the early modern era. Besides, Shakespeare has been cherished for his powerful poetry and stagecraft, his nonpareil grasp of human nature, and his remarkable philosophical insights into life. As people often observe, Shakespeare may trigger our imagination with his language and promote effective communication in every aspect of our life, including that of our careers. For these important reasons, this course aims to guide students to appreciate Shakespeare by focusing on a number of his plays.

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生具備國際新聞編譯之相關知識，並透過實務演練培養新聞編譯之能力。課程內容主要含括(一)國際新聞編譯之介紹（如新聞編譯現況、製作流程、專業條件與譯者相關知能）；（二）新聞編譯之策略與技巧（如刪除、重組、整合新聞訊息）；（三）新聞編譯之模擬與實務練習。
description.en: This course aims to help students build up the basic knowledge of news trans-editing and develop students’ trans-editing skills through practical training. The course covers the following areas: (1) an introduction to news trans-editing (e.g. the current state of the news trans-editing field, the production workflow, professional qualifications and personal traits of news translators); (2) strategies and skills of news trans-editing (e.g. the strategies of deletion, restructuring, abridgement and synthesis); (3) practical training of news trans-editing in a simulated or real environment.

description.zh: 本課程介紹機器視覺之基本概念、原理及衍生應用，同時輔助以開放的影像函式庫來實作訓練；課程中由基礎的基本影像分析入門，並逐步導入機器視覺理論與方法，二維影像校正與立體視覺等內容；課程中將介紹機器視覺系統的相關資源與實作能力的培養，並進一步延伸至影像量測、機器學習與機器人領域的範例應用。
description.en: The field of machine vision has been growing at a fast pace. As in most developing fields, not all aspects of machine vision that are of interest to active researchers are useful to the designers and users of a vision system for a specific application. This course is intended to provide a balanced introduction to machine vision. Basic concepts are introduced with only essential mathematical elements. The details to allow implementation and use of vision algorithms in practical applications are provided, and engineering aspects of techniques are emphasized.

As in most developing fields, not all aspects of machine vision that are of interest to active researchers are useful to the designers and users of a vision system for a specific application. syllabi.schedule:
Introduction: Machine Vision, Image Geometry, Sampling and Quantization, Image Definitions, Levels of Computation	(Week 1)

Contours: Geometry of Curves, Digital Curves, Curve Fitting, Polynomial Representation, Circular Arcs, Conic Sections, Spline Curves (Weeks 12, 13)

Color: Color Physics, Terminology, Perception, Processing, Constancy (Week 16)
Curves and Surfaces: Geometry of Curves and Surfaces, Curve and Surface Representation, Surface Interpolation, Approximation, Segmentation	(Weeks 17, 18)

description.zh: 在各種應用領域中，非結構化的文件相當普遍。如何精確有效地從文件中擷取出重要資訊並分析語意，將有助於彙整不同想法。本課程介紹基本的自然語言處理技術，包括: 語彙組成、語法分析、語意分析等，以及常見的文件探勘方法。除了介紹詞性標註 (POS tagging)、關鍵詞擷取 (keyterm extraction)、中文斷詞 (word segmentation)之外，也將探討不同的字詞與文件表達方式，並應用深度學習方法進行有效的語意分析，如: 情緒分析、意見探勘等。
description.en: Unstructured text docuemnts are very common in various applicaton domains. How to extract important information from texts and analyze their meanings is very helpful to aggregate various ideas. In this course, we are going to introduce the basic techniques in Natural Language Processing including: lexical, syntactic, and semantic anlaysis, and common text mining methods. In addition to POS tagging, keyterm extraction, and word segmentation, we are going to discuss different word and document representations, and apply deep learning methods in effective semantic analysis such as sentiment analysis and opinion mining.

Open-source software is extremely important to the development of the information world, especially system software and middleware. GNU/Linux developed rapidly in the 1990s and entered the Internet era in the late 1990s. The open-source web server Apache HTTP Server, which is used by the most servers in the world, came into being, and then the legendary open-source Apache Project was born. So far, various open-source communities have continued to improve and optimize existing software, and continue to develop new projects with great influence, including OpenStack, Hadoop and Spark, which are widely used to build cloud services and massive data computing. The most widely used Android work environment on smartphones and tablets. Open-source system software and intermediary software have become an important foundation in the era of Internet of Things and massive data analysis. High efficiency, immediacy, and good communication and cooperation between machines are the keys to application development in this era. In addition to high efficiency, In addition to a stable and secure operating system, more high-quality, highly optimized system software and middleware are needed.
