description.zh: 本課程藉由跨領域合作，配合設計思考課程、及在地產業、藝師等產業接軌協作，引導學生發掘與分析產業與市場需求，進行產品開發與服務活動設計，培育大學生社會責任。
description.en: In this course, students will develop their ability to identify and analyze industry/market requirements, product development and service design skills, and sense of university social responsibility. Methods employed include interdisciplinary cooperation, design-thinking training, and collaborations with local industries and craft professionals.

description.zh:
Apple推出iPhone以及iPhone SDK 後，造成了一股不可擋的智慧型手機革命，由於相較於桌上型和筆記型電腦，手機是人們日常生活中更容易貼近使用的行動裝置，因此，手機中的App 更可以幫助人們解決生活中的問題。
本課程將由最基本的入門點切入，前段會先帶領同學針對Objective-C 語法，委派設計(Delegate)模式等iOS入門的幾大難題上課，接著利用Storyboard建構出常見的iOS app 使用者介面，最後再教導同學用OpenGL es 實作有趣的3D 應用程式。
本課程大致如下：
1. 導論
2. Objective-C
3. iOS系統架構
4.Xcode開發工具安裝與使用
5.基礎UI設計與多國語言
6. 核心應用程式設計
7. 感應器應用
8. 多媒體與相機功能
9. OpenGL ES
10. 擴增實境
11. 專題實作及評鑑
description.en:
In this course, you will get hands-on with the Apple SDK and learn how to use Objective-C to build the apps from scratch; You will be equipped to develop iOS apps, including 3D Apps through an understanding of the following course materials:
˙Introduction to iOS
˙How to program in Objective-C
˙Using X-Code 
˙The basics UI design of an iPhone/iPad application
˙iOS MVC structure
˙Use of sensors, the GPS, and cameras
˙Multimedia functions – how to play audio and video files
˙OpenGL ES for 3D/AR application
˙Project Demo and Review
˙How to publish an iPhone/iPad application

description.zh: 本課程將深入介紹檔案系統與儲存系統之作用原理，課程主軸將涵蓋 1. 輸出/輸入設備 2. 磁碟陣列與資料可靠性 3. 檔案系統基礎與設計原理 4. 分散式檔案系統 5. 新興儲存裝置 與 6. 鍵值儲存系統。修習本課程之學生將須要具備下列基礎知識，包含作業系統、C 語言以及基礎 Linux 指令。同時，本課程也將依照課程進展介紹最新的新興儲存裝置、檔案系統與儲存系統之相關研究以及大數據管理等議題。
description.en: This course will detail the working principles and design philosophy of file and storage systems and with prime focus on (1) I/O Devices, (2) RAID and Data Integrity, (3) File system Basics and Designs, (4) Distributed File System, (5) Emerging Storage Devices, (6) Key Value Stores. Please be noted that the knowledge of Operating System, C language, and the use of basic Linux command are required before taking this course. Depending on the current research trends, the course also discusses the latest applied storage topics, especially related to scalable and dependable big data management.

name.zh: 資料科學原理與教育數據應用
name.en: Data Science Principles with Applications on Educational Data

description.zh: 資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
description.en: Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce the valuable knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The topics include data processing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. The course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with fundamental related knowledge and the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation-collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The course training is toward equipping students with the mindset and the ability to solve problems with the learned techniques on educational data. In addition, students need to practice the presentation for the findings of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually.

syllabi.outline:
資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce or create the valuable information and knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The related topics include data processing and computing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. This course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with the fundamental related knowledge as well as the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation- collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The training of this course is toward equipping students with the general mindset and the ability to solve problems practically with the learned techniques on educational data with project groups. In addition, the students also need to practice the presentation for the findings and results of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually. The major objective of this course is to cultivate talents in data science.

description.zh: 區塊鏈技術(作為比特幣等數位貨幣的核心)已重塑了金融交易與分散式交互方式之未來。同時它也被期待帶給我們一個更自組與可提供事實證明的數位化世界。抽象化區塊鏈構造是非常精巧的，它倚賴輕量化密碼學工具搭配分散式系統概念，完成了開放、安全且有效率的系統(如比特幣)。本課程為區塊鏈技術與應用上之概念介紹，包含：比特幣與區塊鏈設計、相關基礎密碼學工具、分散式網路與共識、區塊鏈應用。
description.en: Blockchain techniques (the core of cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin) have reshaped the future of financial transactions and decentralized interactions. They are also expected to bring us a more self-organizing and dependent digital world. The abstraction of blockchain is very delicate. It relies on cryptography tools and decentralized system concepts to achieve an open, secure, and efficient system (such as Bitcoin). This course aims to introduce the concepts of blockchain techniques and applications, including Bitcoin and blockchain design, basic cryptography tools, decentralized networks and consensus, and blockchain applications.

description.zh:
本課程旨在教授學生瞭解雲端環境及物聯網系統架構並進一步教授雲端環境及物聯網安全需求，課程內容除介紹雲端環境及物聯網系統的基本概念外，亦將由OWASP的雲端安全及物聯網安全重點進行說明，培養學生有能力分析雲端及物聯網環境中的各式潛在安全威脅，並具備設計與實作具安全防護能力的雲端及物聯網系統。課程內容包含：
●雲服務技術簡介
●雲服務安全
●雲服務資安標準
●物聯網技術簡介
●工業物聯網潛在威脅
●工控資安
●物聯網資安檢測
●物聯網資安標準
●資安安全與隱私保護
description.en:
This course aims to guide students understanding cloud environments and IoT systems and their corresponding security requirements. In addition to introducing basic concepts of cloud environment and IoT system, the course contents will focus on OWASP's cloud security and IoT security. All practical techniques will be explained. Students are able to analyze various potential security threats in the cloud and Internet of Things environments, and to learn security protection capabilities for cloud and IoT systems. Course contents including:

●Introduction to cloud technologies
●Introduction to cloud security
●Security standards for cloud services 
●Introduction to IoT technologies
●Potential threats of industrial IoT systems
●Industrial Cyber Security introduction
●IoT security detection
●IoT security standards

description.zh:
安全程式設計是資訊安全領域中的關鍵技術。不良的「程式設計習慣」和「不考慮安全保護的程式設計」很容易導致可有心人士所利用。
本課程除了建立安全程式設計的基礎知識外，特別著重於同學的實務能力、漏洞測試、與安全程式開發能力。同時，透過分享最新的論文研究與相關技術報告，協助研究生在研究階段獲取最新的領域知識。
description.en:
Security programming is a key technology in the field of information security. “Bad programming habits” and “programming without security consideration” can easily lead to the use of malicious people. Four major themes will be explored.
In addition to establishing the basic knowledge of security programming, this course focuses on student's practical ability, vulnerability testing, and security programming development ability. At the same time, by sharing novel research papers and related technical reports, the students can obtain the newest and complete domain knowledge in their research stage.

description.zh: 區塊鏈技術(作為比特幣等數位貨幣的核心)已重塑了金融交易與分散式交互方式之未來。同時它也被期待帶給我們一個更自組與可提供事實證明的數位化世界。抽象化區塊鏈構造是非常精巧的，它倚賴輕量化密碼學工具搭配分散式系統概念，完成了開放、安全且有效率的系統(如比特幣)。本課程為區塊鏈技術與應用上之概念介紹，包含：比特幣與區塊鏈設計、相關基礎密碼學工具、分散式網路與共識、區塊鏈應用。
description.en: Blockchain techniques (the core of cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin) have reshaped the future of financial transactions and decentralized interactions. They are also expected to bring us a more self-organizing and dependent digital world. The abstraction of blockchain is very delicate. It relies on cryptography tools and decentralized system concepts to achieve an open, secure, and efficient system (such as Bitcoin). This course aims to introduce the concepts of blockchain techniques and applications, including Bitcoin and blockchain design, basic cryptography tools, decentralized networks and consensus, and blockchain applications.

name.en: Children's Literature and English Language Teaching

description.zh: 本課程針對幼稚園、國小、與國中階段的英語師資而設計，在教材與教法的搭配上提供學理的引介與實務上的訓練。本課程設計考量這些階段學生之身心發展程度與興趣，將屬於兒童與青少年文學範疇的文本（例如：希臘神話、哈利波特系列、波西傑克森系列等等）作創意運用，幫助老師們擷取並改編合宜的教材，經由活潑的教學活動（包括：改編戲劇演出、繪本製作、歌唱舞蹈等等），提高學生的英語能力，也在培養他們體察文化差異的深層素養。
description.en: Designed for kindergarten, elementary school, and junior high school English teacher, this course aims to provide practical training and theories in teaching materials and pedagogy. Students of this course will also learn to adapt children and teenager literary works such as Greek mythology, the Harry Potter series, and the Posey Jackson series into materials suitable for students at the above-specified age groups. Possible learning activities such as role-play, picture books, dancing/singing will also be explored as methods to both develop students' English proficiency and cultural awareness.

syllabi.outline:
While this course is designed for kindergarten, elementary school, junior high, and high school English teachers, non-teachers are also very welcome to join. If you like reading children’s literature and wish to improve your cultural knowledge and public speaking skills, this will be a useful course for you. Students will read engaging children’s and young adult literature, including picture books, classics, popular fiction, and multicultural stories, and learn to adapt these stories into materials suitable for students of a particular age group (or, for non-teachers, into materials suitable for office book clubs or volunteer activities). Creative learning activities will also be explored as methods to develop students' English proficiency and cultural awareness.

Each week, students will read a portion of a children's chapter book or YA novel. Texts chosen may include the following (though I will adapt the week-by-week syllabus over the break and may cut or add a text--contact me with any concerns):

Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (Lewis Carroll)
Dumpling Days (Grace Lin)
The Voyage of the Dawn Treader (C. S. Lewis)
Project Mulberry (Linda Sue Park) 
Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone (or another Harry Potter text)
Percy Jackson and the Sea of Monsters (Rick Riordan)

Every week we will additionally explore one or more picture books (pre-K to grade 2--though, in foreign language classes, picture books are appropriate at any level). Some of the picture books we may explore include Hair Love, Trombone Shorty, the Poppleton series, the Frog and Toad series, The Name Jar, Elephant and Piggie, If the S in Moose gets Loose, and Llamaphones. We will also read some children's poetry, including Edward Lear poems, Ogden Nash poetry, and Hillaire Belloc. (Picture books will be read in class and will not usually require advance preparation.)

Students may also read short, useful articles on pedagogy and teaching methods.
syllabi.assessment:
Students will be evaluated based on reading quizzes, informal lesson plan ideas, presentations/teaching demonstrations, and a final paper in which the students describe their hypothetical literature curriculum for an English club or class. 

Again, while this course is especially designed for teachers, you certainly do not have to be a teacher to take this course, and non-teachers are very welcome.

name.zh: 語音學和英語發音教學

description.zh: 傳統發音教學大多根據教師直覺認為語音是該如何產製的、或發音課本中教條式的規則。在這堂課，學生將透過具體的聲學和構音資料、來學習重要語音學原則，並學習將原則正確地應用在發音教學當中。學生也將探討如何將這些知識轉化成不同年齡層和語言程度之學生可以接受的內容。
description.en: Traditionally, pronunciation teaching has been based on "armchair data" (e.g., the instructor's intuition on how a sound should be articulated) or prescriptive statements in pronunciation textbooks. In this course, students will learn fundamental principles of phonetics through experimental acoustic and articulatory data and learn how to apply them to pronunciation teaching. Students will be challenged to translate what they have learned to digestible pronunciation instructions for students of different ages and proficiency levels.

name.zh: 中英對比分析應用研究

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討英語與漢語在結構與功能上的主要異同，涵蓋語意、語音、音韻、詞法、句法、語用與社會文化等特徵，同時類比與對比這兩個語言使用何種語言策略達到溝通的目的。本課程之本質在訓練學生往後如何解決語言對比分析的問題，在學期結束時，學生需要針對英語與漢語某一特定語言現象獨立完成對比分析。
description.en: This course aims at investigating the major structural and functional differences and similarities of Chinese and English. The differences and similarities identified include semantic, phonetic, phonological, morphological, syntactic, pragmatic, and sociocultural features. We will also compare and contrast linguistic strategies the two languages employ to achieve communicative purposes. This course is exploratory in itself, directed toward providing students with keys to tackling linguistic issues they may encounter in their future careers. Students will be required to present an ultimate Chinese-English contrastive analysis in a certain aspect at the end of this course.

description.zh: 西方文化的交流是建立在故事上的。即使這些故事相當久遠，但每個人卻都非常熟悉，又或者是因為這些故事相當久遠，所以每個人都非常熟悉。本課程將探討近代主要西方作家—喬瑟及莎士比亞—作品中的核心主題及文化的意象。研讀這些近代西方主要作家的作品是發展西方文學素養及思想的基石，同時，也為任何概括了以西方文化為主體的研究提供了不可或缺的背景知識。
description.en: Conversation in Western culture is built on stories. Everybody knows the stories even though the stories are very old, or rather everybody knows them because they are very old stories. This course introduces students to some of the stories that have been most influential in the English-speaking world. Knowing these stories provides essential background knowledge for understanding Western culture in general.

name.en: Studies in English and American Fiction

description.zh: 本課程旨在引導學生如何以批評的角度閱讀小說。課程討論有兩個重點：（一）小說的技巧：如情節、結構、人物塑造、敘事者與敘事策略、背景鋪陳、象徵與意象等。（二）小說與文學理論的關係：如何將文學理論運用到小說的閱讀與分析。
description.en: This course will introduce students to critical approaches and principles in the study of fiction.  We will discuss such features as plot, structure, characterization, narrator, narrative strategy, setting, symbol, image, etc..  We will also examine various theoretical approaches that can be brought to bear on the study of fiction.  There will be a particular emphasis on the application of theories to hone students' critical reading skills.

name.en: Theories and Practice in English for Professional Purposes

description.zh: 本課程旨在研討專業英文研究及應用, 課程包括專業領域英語文之語域分析, 探討各領域中的語法及詞彙特點,並進一步分析不同領域中之修辭及言語萹章使用,進而研討語言溝通目標功能分析並結合策略研究,以將理論應用於專業實務及研究中。
description.en: This course is intended for graduate students who are pre-experienced in working in specific fields of professions. For other students who are inexperienced in the workplace are required to have consolidated knowledge and observations of the world industries. It aims to address the applicability of theories in EPP and the plethora of situations raised from such applications. The course will provide theoretical studies for applications in respect to register analysis, rhetorical and discourse analysis, functionality analysis and skills and strategies. It is also expected that the course will describe other models in EPP studies.

description.zh: 本課程通過理論與實際案例介紹3D創作與空間設計軟體：3DS MAX的概念與應用範圍，接續將3D環境建構的方法導入實務案例練習操作，最後透過專題設定進行學生自己的內容創作。課程目的是訓練學生在運用3DS MAX軟體進行3D模型、空間和相關物件的建構能力，並接續應用在空間展示的動畫效果和表現。
description.en: This course is about 3D creation and space design software through theoretical and practical cases: 3DS MAX - the concept and application scope, and then the teacher introduces the methods of 3D environment construction into practical case practice operations, and finally creates students' creative projects. The purpose is to train students to use the 3DS MAX software to construct 3D models, character modeling, space, and related objects, and use the result and performance in space animation.

a. 提升工業設計系學生對於工廠實作設計課程學習的效果
b. 提升工業設計系學生對於工廠實作設計課程課後複習的效果

e. 提升工業設計系學生應用工廠設備解決真實問題的能力

syllabi.outline:
本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文章導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。 
3. 了解其他學術單位的成就及最新學術發展方向。

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供所有修課博士生共同參與學術研究討論並發掘具設計研究價值探討主題，進而透過系統性文獻探討，師生討論的形式引導學生形塑設計研究主題及進行設計專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論，並嘗試撰寫論文並投稿至具嚴謹審查機制期刊。

This course aims to provide PhD students with opportunities to participate in academic research discussions and explore core themes of design research through systematic literature reviews, and effective student-teacher discussions to guide students to shape their design research themes, conduct their design research and have capabilities to give a guest lecture, and conduct group meeting. In the end, all students taking this course have been requested to write a manuscript and submit it to a refereed journal with a rigorous review mechanism.

description.zh: 車輛的應用中包含許多的化學反應，例如噴漆和塗料的使用，要了解車用塗料的操作原理、和研發特用的功能，需要具備基礎化學、有機化學、高分子化學和塗料的知識。本課程針對漆的化學概念，介紹車輛中所使用化學品相關的化學理論，進一步連結到學生在現場時會遇到的實際案例，解釋所觀察到的化學反應現象。
description.en: The applications of vehicles include many chemical reactions, such as the use of paint spraying and coatings. To understand the operation principle and to develop special chemical function, it is necessary to have knowledge of general chemistry, organic chemistry, polymer chemistry and coatings. This course aims at teaching key chemical concepts, introduces chemical theories related to chemicals used in vehicles, further links to actual cases that students will encounter on the scene, and explains the chemical reaction phenomena observed.

description.zh: 機器學習軟體可用於設計和訓練豐富且靈活的機器學習系統，具備數學基礎以理解機器學習的基本原理將是重要的，掌握這些原理可了解目前使用的方法的固有假設和局限性，有助於促進創建新的機器學習解決方案。課程將分兩部分來進行，第一部分主要闡述相關的數學基礎包含線性代數、解析幾何、矩陣分解、機率與最佳化等學理，第二部分則將第一部分中的概念應用於基本機器學習包含回歸、維度減少、密度估計和分類等應用。
description.en:
While machine learning software is available to design and train rich and flexible machine learning systems, the mathematical foundations of machine learning are important in order to understand fundamental principles for creating new machine learning solutions, and learn about the inherent assumptions and limitations of the methodologies.
This course will contain two parts, where Part I lays the mathematical
foundations in linear algebra、analytic geometry、matrix decomposition、probability theory and optimization , and Part II applies the concepts from Part I to a set of fundamental machine learning problems including regression, dimensionality reduction, density estimation, and classification.

syllabi.outline:
理解機器學習(Machine Learning)的原理與應用是相對重要的，掌握機器學習相關之數學基礎將有助於理解機器學習使用方法之假設和局限性，輔以對機器學習較具經典代表性應用案例的深入探討，將有助於在面對新的問題時，能有效與快速地提出以機器學習為基礎的新興解決方案。課程將以兩部份來進行，第一部份介紹機器學習相關的數學基礎理論包含線性代數、幾何解析、矩陣分解、機率與最佳化等；第二部份則以第一部份之理論為基礎，探討機器學習相關的衍生應用如線性回歸、維度降低、密度估計和分類等應用。
While machine learning software is available to design and train rich and flexible machine learning systems, the mathematical foundations of machine learning are important in order to understand fundamental principles for creating new machine learning solutions, and learn about the inherent assumptions and limitations of the methodologies. This course will contain two parts, where Part I lays the mathematical foundations in Linear Algebra, Analytic Geometry, Matrix Decomposition, and Probability theory and Optimization. Part II applies the concepts from Part I to a set of fundamental machine learning problems including Regression, Dimensionality Reduction, Density Estimation, and Classification.
syllabi.schedule:
*** Linear Algebra ***
Week1-2: Course overview and Chapter 2 Linear Algebra, Linear Equation, Matrics, Vector Space
Week3-4: Chapter 3 Analytic Geometry, Inner Product, length & Angle, Orthonormal Basis, Orthogonal Projection
Week5-6: Chapter 4 Matrix Decomposition, Determine, Eigenvalues, Eigenvectors, Eigendecomposition and Diagonalization
Week7-8: Least Square Solution and Chapter 10 Dimension Reduction with PCA (Principal Component Analysis)
Week9: Midterm Exam. 

*** Probability ***
Week10-11: Chapter 5 Vector Calculus, Partial Differentiation and Gradients
Week12-13: Chapter 6 Probability & Distributions, Probability Space, Discrete and Continuous Probability
Week14-15: Chapter 9 Linear Regression, Parameter Estimation, Bayesian Linear Regression 

*** Optimization ***
Week16-17: Chapter 7 Continuous Optimization, Gradient Descent, Convex Optimization
Week18 Final Exam.

description.zh: 本課程以落地產業應用技術主題，導入德國工業大學任務導向學習模式，課程教導學生從建置雲端資料庫伺服器到撰寫三機一體網頁控制程式進行工廠CPS產銷戰情資訊管理系統，串聯工廠人機物料及生產線與品管，並實務教導開發AI瑕疵檢測模型，再利用人機操控PLC達到機聯網，進行工廠整廠資訊連線。
description.en: The theme of this course is industrial application technology, and it introduces the task-oriented learning model of the German University of Technology. The course teaches students from building a cloud database server to writing a three-in-one web control program for factory CPS production and sales information management system, connecting factories Human-machine material, production line and quality control, and practical teaching and development of AI defect detection model, and then use human-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, and conduct factory-wide information connection.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將企業教育訓練的專精、實務、效益特質融入學校實務課程。企業教育訓練講究課程要專精、內容要具體針對需求、以實務技術做講解、要能有具體成效、講求時間效率。本課程以落地產業應用技術主題，導入德國工業大學任務導向學習模式，課程教導學生從建置雲端資料庫伺服器到撰寫三機一體網頁控制程式進行工廠CPS產銷戰情資訊管理系統，串聯工廠人機物料及生產線與品管，並實務教導開發AI瑕疵檢測模型，再利用人機操控PLC達到機聯網，進行工廠整廠資訊連線。另外，本課程特別加強AI瑕疵檢測技術與應用，導入產業AI技術搭配教學。
This course integrates the specialization, practice, and benefit characteristics of corporate education and training into the school's practical courses. Enterprise education and training emphasizes that the curriculum should be specialized, the content should be specific to the needs, the explanation should be based on practical skills, it should be able to have specific results, and it should pay attention to time efficiency. This course is based on the theme of landing industrial application technology, and introduces the task-oriented learning model of the German Technical University. The course teaches students from building a cloud database server to writing a three-in-one webpage control program to implement a factory CPS production and marketing war situation information management system, and connect factories in series. Man-machine material and production line and quality control, and practical teaching to develop AI defect detection model, and then use man-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, and carry out information connection of the whole factory. In addition, this course especially strengthens AI defect detection technology and application, and introduces industrial AI technology for teaching.

description.zh: 先修課程: 負責教授同意。本課程目的在介紹蓬勃發展中的微機電系統(micro-electro-mechanical systems, MEMS)工程與最新應用。其內容包括 : MEMS之概念與特性、微觀設計原則、跨領域模擬分析、加工材料分類、主要製程技術介紹、CMOS-MEMS整合製造、封裝與測試技術、微感測器與微致動器、智慧型元件與SOC、工程應用實例介紹

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹綠色科技及其在二十一世紀對人類生活的影響，內容包括現今幾個最重要的「潔能」與「節能」科技，以及一些「環保」相關科技。「潔能科技」包括風力能、太陽能、水力能、地球內部能源、生質能、路面能、聲音能、燃料電池、電動車等；「節能科技」包括節能住宅、變頻空調等；「環保科技」則包括碳回收主題。介紹內容包括各項技術原理介紹及其發展概況。
description.en: This course aims to introduce green technologies and their influences on human life in the 21st century. The contents consist of the most important topics about the clean energy and energy conservation technologies. The clean energy technology consists of wind energy, solar energy, hydraulic energy, earth interior energy, bioenergy, roadway energy, sound energy, fuel cell, electric vehicles, and so on. The energy conservation technology consists energy save buildings, variable frequency air-condition, etc.. The environmental protesting technology includes carbon recapture etc.. This course will talk the technical principles and their general developing situations.

name.en: The theory and practice of 3D Printing

description.zh: 3D列印（英語：3D printing），又稱加法製造、積層製造（Additive Manufacturing，AM），可指任何列印三維物體的過程。3D列印主要是一個不斷添加的過程，在電腦控制下層疊原材料。3D列印的內容可以來源於三維模型或其他電子資料，其列印出的三維物體可以擁有任何形狀和幾何特徵。本課程將介紹其原理及配合實機操作，使學生能對3D列印技術有正確的認識。(本課程鼓勵學生參加經濟部iPas的3D列印工程師考試)
description.en: 3D printing, also known as additive manufacturing (AM), refers to processes used to create a three-dimensional object in which successive layers of material are formed under computer control to create an object. Objects can be of almost any shape or geometry and are produced using digital model data from a 3D model or another electronic data. This course will introduce the principle knowledge of 3D printing and giving the opportunity to practice the use of 3D Printing.

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意
瞭解原子結構乃是起碼的科技素養，本課程主要的目的是建立學生將來可以以X光作為研究工具的能力。本課程主要可分成四部份：一是結晶學原理、二是X光繞射的原理、三是X光繞射的基本應用、四是材料的結構分析。除此之外，並將進行一小部份實驗以驗證學理，同學可從實驗中學習檢驗製程中材料所發生問題，從而解決製造的問題。
description.en: Topics covered include properties of X-rays, geometry of crystals, directions of diffracted Beams, intensity of diffracted beams, orientation and quality of single crystals, structure of polycrystalline aggregates, determinations of crystal structure, phase diagram determination, and Experiments.

1. 結晶學原理
2. X光繞射的原理

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹奈米結構材料之合成及其製程技術。內容大綱包括三部分：第一、奈米材料基本物理與化學特性，第二、奈米粉末和薄膜結構材料之化學合成，物理合成製程原理與特性，奈米塊體材料的性能與製備，第三、奈米結構材料應用。
description.en: This course is divided into three sections. The first four chapters deal with those chapters which are the principles of nanostructured Material. The next two chapters describe the engineering options currently available for the synthesis, processing and fabrication of nanostructured materials. The last two chapters deal with different application of nanostructured materials.

description.en:
The contents of this course can be categorized as followings: 
1. fundamental metallographic concepts.
2. The effects of alloying elements in steel.
3. Hardenability 
4. General heat treatment processes: annealing, hardening, tempering, and normalizing. 
5. Special heat treatment process : tool steels hardening and tempering. Quenching and tempering of constructional steels, case hardening, nitriding, carbonitriding, induction hardening, and flame hardening.

name.en: Design and Practice of  Control System

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。使學生瞭解如何由自動控制理論與概念,轉化成控制系統的實務設計與實踐。課程內容包括: 機構、致動器、感測器、與控制器等元件及其整合技術介紹, 配合LabView + myRIO及周邊設備進行控制系統實務設計與測試,使同學由實驗中體會與培養控制系統的實務設計能力。
description.en: The object of the course is to let students understand how to transform the theory and concept of automatic control into a design and practice for a control system. Course contents include: introduction to mechanism, sensors actuator and controller elements, as well as the needed integration technique. LabView + myRIO and peripheral devices are used in the course to design a practically useful controller and to verify its effectiveness. Students therefore can gain the practical controller design experience via this learning by doing approach。

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要說明如何應用自動控制理論與概念於機電一體化控制系統的實務設計；課程內容包括：傳動機構、致動器、感測器、控制器等機電一體化控制系統的關鍵部份與整合方式。本課程並且使用LabVIEW進行控制系統實務設計與模擬，使得同學們可體會控制系統的實務設計與應用，培養與建立機電一體化控制系統分析與設計之基礎能力。

name.zh: 人工智慧與工程應用實作
name.en: Artificial Intelligence for Engineering Applications in Practice

description.zh: 本課程探討人工智慧(AI)與工程應用相關議題，並討論其解決方案與技術發展趨勢。內容由淺入深，包含基礎python程式設計、資料預處理、資料探索、機器學習、深度學習、AI工程應用介紹(分子性質預測、設備預測性維護、混凝土強度預測，PM2.5預測、房價預測等案例應用分析)及專題製作。在本課程中，學生可了解AI之基本原理及AI在工程上的應用，本課程也藉由AI程式撰寫的實作實習，提昇工程背景學生撰寫與理解AI應用程式設計的技能，以幫助學生將人工智慧導入產業應用實務中。
description.en: This course will introduce artificial intelligence (AI) and its applications in engineering fields. Topics covered include basic python programming, data prepossessing, data exploration, machine learning, deep learning, AI applications in engineering fields (e.g. predicting molecular properties, predictive maintenance predicting compressive strength of concrete, prediction of PM2.5, and prediction of house price, etc.) and final project. Students can learn about the basic principles and engineering applications of AI. Coding will be required to improve their programming competence in AI. The course intends to help the students implement AI concepts in their industrial practices.

syllabi.outline:
本課程探討人工智慧(AI)與工程應用相關議題，並討論其解決方案與技術發展趨勢。內容由淺入深，包含基礎Python程式設計、資料處理、機器學習、深度學習、AI相關應用及專題製作。在本課程中，學生可了解AI的基本原理及工程上的應用，本課程也藉由撰寫AI程式與使用相關工具，提昇工程背景學生實做AI應用的技能，以幫助學生將AI導入產業應用實務中。

This course will introduce artificial intelligence (AI) and its applications in engineering fields. Topics covered include basic Python programming, data possessing, machine learning, deep learning, AI applications in engineering fields and final project. Students can learn about the basic principles and engineering applications of AI. Coding and related tools will be required to improve their programming competence in AI. The course intends to help the students implement AI techniques in their industrial practices.
syllabi.schedule:
課程以基礎概念出發，搭配大量的實做練習，分成幾個大主題：
- 導論：人工智慧發展與應用簡介、機器學習及深度學習概念與技術簡介
- Python基礎練習：開發環境、Python語法、相關套件的簡介與實做練習
- 機器學習基礎：基礎概念、Regression(迴歸)與Classification (分類)的應用練習
- 影像辨識應用：OpenCV、CNN(卷積神經網路)、影像分類、物件偵測、OCR (光學字元辨識)、影像生成的介紹與練習
- 自然語言處理應用：RNN(循環神經網路)、Transformer、簡易聊天機器人、自然語言理解、自然語言生成等(內容依實際上課進度而定)
- 期末專題：分組、題目發想、資料蒐集與實做、上台分享
syllabi.assessment:
- 程式題作業：預計 5 ~ 6 次（60%）
- 期末專題（40%）

- 少年Py的大冒險－成為Python AI深度學習達人的第一門課（作者： 蔡炎龍、林澤佑、黃瑜萍、焉然）
- 強者用PyTorch：實作史上最經典AI範例（作者： 集智俱樂部）

name.zh: 高等電腦輔助工程分析

description.zh:
讓學生了解並熟悉工程軟體於工程問題分析之應用，培養解決實務及研發問題的能力。
課程概述：在具備固體、熱流等力學及有限元素分析理論的基礎上，利用3D繪圖與高階有限元素分析整合軟體，將工程實務問題作實體建模，並進行物理行為模擬分析與理論驗證，包括靜態、動態、落下測試、穩定性、疲勞、熱傳、非線性、多重物理參數耦合及最佳化等問題之實例演練。最後以實際研發專題作為本課程學習之體驗。
description.en: On the basis of applied mechanics such as the solid, thermal fluid and finite element analysis theory, utilize the computer engineering software, which the 3D computer aided drawing is integrated with finite element analysis, to simulate the practical engineering problem. The physical behaviors such as static, dynamic, dropping testing, stability, fatigue, heat transfer, nonlinearity, coupled multi-physics and optimization, etc. can be verified and predicted through the simulating analysis for several practical model. The course will give both comprehensive experience and knowledge of a special researching topic finally.

syllabi.outline:
讓學生了解並熟悉工程軟體於工程問題分析之應用，培養解決實務及研發問題的能力。
課程概述：在具備固體、熱流等力學及有限元素分析理論的基礎上，利用3D繪圖與高階有限元素分析整合軟體，將工程實務問題作實體建模，並進行物理行為模擬分析與理論驗證，包括靜態、動態、落下測試、穩定性、疲勞、熱傳、非線性、多重物理參數耦合及最佳化等問題之實例演練。最後以實際研發專題作為本課程學習之體驗。
syllabi.schedule:
第1週:1.電腦輔助工程分析(CAE)介紹
2.固體力學及熱流基本理論
第2週:1. 有限元素法概論
2. 有限元素套裝軟體(ANSYS, COSMOSWorks, COMSOL)介紹
以下均於電腦教室CAD 與CAE軟體實機操作
第3週:3D基礎實體模型及組合件繪製
第4週:軸向負載結構分析-桁架建模與CAE與理論驗證
第5週:含扭轉負載結構分析-扭力桿或螺旋彈簧建模與CAE與理論驗證
第6週:含彎曲負載結構分析-樑及3維構架建模、CAE與理論驗證
第7週:2維平面應力結構分析-線性與非線性之CAE
第8週:2維軸對稱結構分析-中空圓柱或柱受內外壓之CAE
第9週:期中考(綜合問題實機測驗)
第10週:壓縮配合應力分析-軸孔干涉配合及傳動之CAE
第11週:兩曲面接觸分析-圓柱、球面及平面間相互接觸之CAE與理論驗證
第12週:不規則曲面接觸分析
第13週:3C產品中各種小型扣件之應力、變形及疲勞CAE分析
第14週:組件含發熱元件之熱傳CAE
第15週:組件含發熱元件之熱應力CAE
第16週:機械元件動態(振動與落下測試)之CAE
第17週:機械元件之最佳化CAE
第18週:期末考(綜合問題檢討及實機測驗)

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位化工廠。數位化製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位化製造概論、數位化製造實例說明、商業模型分析、知識管理、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站、工作流程管理、最新數位化相關技術介紹。
description.en: Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." This course covers different issues related to e-Manufacturing, such as Concept of e-Manufacturing, Case Study, Business Model Analysis, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Knowledge Portal (EKP), Product Data Management (PDM), Concept of Trading Systems, Concept of Data Warehousing, Enterprise Information Portal (EIP), Workflow Management, State of the Art Technologies, etc.

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位工廠。數位製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位製造概論、數位製造實例說明、商業模型分析、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站。

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的進階基礎課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由先進智慧鐵道系統的介紹，使修課學生能夠清楚瞭解鐵道產業的未來發展方向，並引領學生積極投入各種先進智慧鐵道應用系統之研究。本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請智慧鐵道系統相關、學有專精的技術研發人員、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時進行實作系統的展示，並邀請鐵道產業專家擔任評審。修習本課程前，不同學系之學生須先修習的課程清單另訂定之。
description.en: This course is one of the advanced core courses for the Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The aim of this course is, via the introduction of advanced intelligent rail system, to have the students realize thoroughly the development trend of futuristic rail industry, and subsequently, to encourage the students into the research and development of various application systems for intelligent railway. This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include R&D experts from relevant fields in intelligent rail industry. In their term reports, the students will have to demonstrate the prototypes of their projects and to be reviewed by the invited senior professionals from rail industry. The prerequisites for taking this course will be determined based on the background of students with different majors.

name.en: Taguchi Method on the Quality Design

description.zh:
(1)「田口方法」介紹
(2)完整的「田口方法」，包含以下三個主題：
(a) S/N比之理論基礎及進階應用；
(b)直交表之理論基礎及進階應用；
(c)變異分析。
(3)應用「田口方法」進行專案研究，並繳交專案主題與報告。
description.en:
(1) The course gives step-by-step to explaining the "Taguchi Method" for the students.
     (2) The course gives the fully "Taguchi Method" for the students during a short time, which including three topical subjects:
  (a) The basic theory of S/N ratio and its advanced applications.
  (b) The basic theory of Orthogonal Arrays and its advanced applications.
  (c) Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)
  (3) Students will use the "Taguchi Method" to proceeding a project study, and hand over their theme and report of project.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的學習目標是要讓學生學習「田口方法」的基本觀念，並且以實際案例做說明，讓學生學習專有名詞的定義及應用。課程內容包含：直交表實驗、品質計量方法(品質損失、S/N比之理論基礎及應用)、變異分析、案例說明。在學期結束時，應用「田口方法」進行專案主題研究，並繳交期末報告。
The learning goal of this course is to enable students to learn the basic concepts of the Taguchi Method. In addition, actual cases are used to explain, so that students can learn the definition and application of proper nouns. The course content includes: experiment with orthogonal arrays, quality measurement methods (theoretical basis and application of quality loss, S/N ratio), analysis of variance, and case description. At the end of the semester, apply the "Taguchi Method" to conduct project thematic research and submit the final report.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
通過每週閱讀和課堂討論，本課程將幫助培養學生的英語會話和閱讀技能。 在練習這些技能的過程中，我們將專注於理解西方語言和文化的核心思想，以及理解西方文化中的人（他們的價值觀、動機、原則）的核心思想。 [本課程過去的主題包括：怪物與人類； 喜劇和幽默； 善惡的本質； 西部英雄； 棒球與社會； 美的理念和重要性； 探索與發現]。 檢查圍繞此類主題的文章和電影，我們將考慮重要的想法告訴我們關於西方社會及其人民的什麼。
Through weekly readings and class discussion, this course will help develop students’ English conversation and reading skills.  In the course of practicing such skills, we will focus on an idea central to understanding the language and the culture of the West, and thus an idea central to understanding the people (their values, motivations, principles) of Western culture.   [Past topics for this course include: Monsters and the Human; Comedy and Humor; The Nature of Good and Evil; The Hero in the West; Baseball and Society; The Idea and the Importance of Beauty; Exploration and Discovery].   Examining essays and films centered around such a topic, we will consider what the significant idea tells us about Western society and its people.

name.en: Course in English language Proficiency Tests

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

name.en: Course in English language Proficiency Tests

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

syllabi.outline: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。

name.en: Emerging Market Series: Getting to know Malaysia

description.zh: 課程藉由傳授馬來西亞語言以協助學生拓展東南亞的就業版圖，旨在培養學生的馬來西亞語基本溝通能力，運用馬來語與當地母語者打招呼、了解馬來文化、建立人際關係、購物、敘述事物等，以此來協助學生前往馬來西亞就業，作為兩國的經濟橋樑。
description.en: In order to embrace economic development of globalization, especially in Asian and Southeast Asian countries, there is a need to introduce and equip our students not only with the basic local language but also to understand the local culture so as to strengthen the economic tie between Taiwan and the Asian countries and to enhance the employment opportunities of our students in these Asian countries. This course aims to help students to understand and develop basic communication skills by utilizing Bahasa Malaysia (Malaysian language) to communicate with Malaysian in terms of greeting, business contact establishment, interpersonal communication, etc. Historical and geographical backgrounds of Malaysia and their local cultures will also be introduced.

name.zh: 國際觀培養:印尼文化與語言
name.en: Development of global perspective:Indonesian culture and language

description.zh: 為了迎接全球化的亞洲國家與東南亞國家之間的經濟發展,藉由傳授印尼語言,讓學生掌握印尼語同時也了解印尼文化作為兩國的經濟橋樑，以此來協助學生前往印尼就業。本課程是培養學生的溝通能力，以運用印尼語來跟印尼母語者打招呼、建立人際關係、購物、敘述事物…等。
description.en: In order to embrace economic development of globalization, especially in Asian and Southeast Asian countries, there is a need to teach Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) and equip students not only with the language but also to understand the culture as an economic bridge between the two countries. And, it is hoped that assisting students in employment in Indonesia. This course will aim to help students to develop communication skills by utilizing Indonesian language to speak to native speakers in terms of greeting, business contact establishment, interpersonal communication, and descriptive usage…etc.

name.zh: 國際觀培養:泰國文化與語言(一)
name.en: Development of global perspective: Thai culture and language I

description.zh: 1. 在臺灣與東南亞交流日益增加的情況下，東南亞語言的學習需求也會隨之提高。而「泰國」所擁有的社會經濟條件優勢，以及泰國政府有意推動的文化創意產業，相信也將為臺灣帶來一陣「泰語學習風潮」。 2. 課程以培養基礎泰語溝通能力、激發學習泰語興趣，以及跨文化理解為宗旨。課程架構包括泰國語言教學及元化議題討論，使其在具備泰語溝通基本實力之外，更能對泰國各方面情勢與文化、思想、禮節、風俗習慣、宗教禁忌等，都具有深度認識。 3. 泰語教學方面，秉持聽、說、讀、寫同時並進的教學理念，由字母的發音、寫法、唸法、聲調、順序及拼字系統的學習開始，奠定良好的泰語基礎，搭配最常用的單字、句型、文法與日常實用會話，使學生可以拼寫、閱讀泰文短文，並能以泰語進行日常對話。 4. 泰國文化方面，以專題的方式，講述政治、經濟、社會、地理、歷史與文化等各個層面的泰國，呈現出不同於一般刻板印象中的泰國，培養學生對泰國的正確認識及態度。本學期先針對泰國目前的經濟與文化面進行概說；下學期則探討泰國歷史、地理、政治與社會。
description.en: 1. With the interaction between Taiwan and Southeast Asia getting more and more frequent, the need for learning Southeast Asian languages has been highly increasing. Thailand owns the advantages of social economy; moreover, Thailand government intends to promote cultural creativity industries. Hence, learning Thai definitely becomes a new trend in Taiwan. 2. This course aims to help students build the foundation of speaking basic Thai, and arouse students’ interests in learning Thai. Also, it helps students get to know cross-cultural differences. In addition to learning Thai, students have to discuss the issues related to Thai culture. Accordingly, students are not only able to make conversations, but have further understanding of Thai culture, thinking, manners, customs and religious taboos etc. 3. In terms of learning Thai, listening, speaking, reading and writing, these four skills are equally important. Student will be trained to learn all these four skills together.

name.zh: 國際觀培養:日語與文化(一)

description.zh: 本課程提供學生養成基本日語聽說讀寫技能，並能夠面對在各種情境下，表達出適當的日語，足以應付日常生活簡單狀況。此外，並運用多媒體等工具，介紹日本文化，歷史，人文等多種面向，讓學生能更多元地了解日本，有效提升學習興趣及效率。
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive approach to developing the four basic language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) in order to cultivate your overall Japanese language ability to a level sufficient for various occasions and everyday life.In addition , using multimedia to introduce a variety of Japanese culture, history , and humanities. The students can learn more about Japan in many different perspectives, and effectively enhance interest in the learning process.

syllabi.outline:
我國與日本在經濟、學術、文化上之交流早已是不爭的事實。因此，
專業領域之外，如能再習得第二外國語文必定能擁有更大的競爭力。
從入門開始來了解日本的產業、經濟和文化，並探討日本在國際商場
上致勝的關鍵。並且藉由課程學習來加強日語的聽、說、讀、
寫之能力也是本課程追尋的目標。

共有2項作業
作業一:
每課之日語語法、發音發聲、句型應用講解後請學生利用相同句形做1對1或1對2、3之會話練習。

作業二:為加深印象與訓練日文書寫能力，每課內容必須做筆記。

name.en: English for Academic Speaking and Writing

description.zh: 本課程目的在增進學生英文學術寫作與口語簡報及討論能力，以適應全英語授課環境，內容包括多元化的學術寫作與口說練習活動，並由各類文本中分析並熟練英文句型結構及段落結構；亦包含簡報製作、內容架構以及實用線上資源應用等內容，以增強學生學術英文表達技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium courses. Students will be engaged with active participation in a variety of academic writing and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments. Students will also learn the structure, vocabulary, as well as strategies of delivering a successful presentation for academic purposes.

syllabi.outline: This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium courses. Students will be engaged with active participation in a variety of academic writing and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments. Students will also learn the structure, vocabulary, as well as strategies of delivering a successful presentation for academic purposes. Students are required to express themselves in English during the class so as to improve their English speaking and writing ability.

description.zh: 先修課程：3002014或負責教授同意。一維及多維穩定態熱傳導及非穩定態熱傳導、對流原理、強迫對流及自然對流經驗和實驗關係式、輻射熱傳遞、凝結與沸騰、熱交換器、熱傳遞中的特殊論題。
description.en: Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction-Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程：3002014或負責教授同意。一維及多維穩定態熱傳導及非穩定態熱傳導、對流原理、強迫對流及自然對流經驗和實驗關係式、輻射熱傳遞、凝結與沸騰、熱交換器、熱傳遞中的特殊論題。
Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction-Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.
syllabi.schedule:
week 1	Heat transfer mechanisms, conservation of energy 	
week 2	Introduction to conduction: Fourier’s Law, general heat conduction equation, boundary and initial conditions 	
week 3	1D, steady-state conduction, heat generation in a solid, variable heat conductivity 	
week 4	Thermal resistance network: multilayer plane walls, thermal contact resistance, cylinders and spheres, finned surfaces, conduction shape factor 	
week 5	Transient conduction: lumped system analysis, large plane walls, spatial effects, semi-infinite solids, multidimensional systems 	
week 6	Numerical methods: finite difference scheme, boundary nodes	
week 7	Convection: boundary layers, laminar and turbulent flow 	
week 8	Nondimensionalized convection equations, similarity, friction and convection coefficients, analogies between momentum and heat transfer 	
week 9	Midterm	
week 10	External forced convection: flat plate, cylinders, spheres, tube bundle 	
week 11	Internal forced convection: general thermal analysis, laminar and turbulent flow in tubes 	
week 12	Natural convection: governing equations, Grashof number, plane and finned surfaces, enclosures 	
week 13	Boiling and condensation: boiling modes, pool boiling and flow boiling, film and dropwise condensation	
week 15	Heat exchangers: types, log mean temperature difference method 	
week 16	Thermal Radiation: radiation intensity, blackbody radiation, emissivity, absorptivity, reflectivity, transmissivity 	
week 17	View factor, diffuse and gray surfaces 	
week 18	final
syllabi.assessment:
Flipped classroom: 30%
Midterm: 35%
Final: 35%

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

name.en: Development of Simulation Tools  for Engineering

description.zh:
電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。

課程訓練分兩階段進行：
第一階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。
第二階段將模擬工具開發的能力應用在各科系的專業上。在進行短暫的文獻回顧後，與修課學生討論其專業領域中可用模擬解決或加速的學術研究及產業問題。針對主題制定計畫內容後，以選定的程式語言撰寫相關的應用程式，並以開發成開源軟體為最終目標。
註一、課程函授上以 GNU Fortran 和 Python3 為主要程式語言選擇，但學生可自由選擇所熟悉的語言作為工具。
註二、修課基本條件為修畢工程學院各系一年級程式設計相關之基礎課程，且具基本撰寫程式的能力。
description.en:
This course aims to provide complete training for developing modeling and simulation tools in engineering applications. Students will obtain the ability to analyze problems, formulate algorithms, write code, and implement the developed 
open-source programs in their fields of study. 
The first part of the training focuses on task-oriented coding experiences. Students will get familiar with the Linux platform and open-source programs. They will perform simple, particle-based simulations. The collected data will be analyzed, visualized, and interpreted based on the programs written by students.
The second part of the training applies the coding knowledge to students’ fields of study. After the literature survey, students will select the topic based on theirexpertise, where research or industrial problems can be accelerated by computer modeling. The final goal is to create software based on the course project.

description.zh: 本課程介紹近代電化學的分析方法。 介紹內容包含電位法、循環伏安法、安培法、光譜電化學法、旋轉環碟電極法、及其他近代電化學的分析方法。
description.en: Introduction the principles and applications of modern electroanalytical methods. Introduction the theory and application of polarography, potentiometry, cyclic voltammetry, Amperometry, spectroelectrochemistry, RRDE, and other modern electroanalytical techniques.

name.en: Soft Electronic Materials and Device applications

description.zh: 本課程目的在於建立學生有關於軟性半導體與元件應用之相關技術與知識，並在學期中讓學生實際動手製備與量測有機半導體元件，以對於有機半導體應用有更深入的認識。課程主題主要(1)有機半導體物理介紹；(2) 有機半導體元件製程與封裝技術；(3)有機發光二極體(OLED)元件應用；(4) 有機場效應電晶體應用；(5)有機太陽能電池；(6)有機記憶體元件應用；(7)有機感測器應用；(8) 奈米碳材元件。
description.en: The goal of this class is to build basic knowledge about organic semiconductors and device applications. Students will also learn how to fabricate organic electronics and have further understanding. The main topics of this class include (1) physics of organic semiconductors; (2) device fabrications and processes; (3) organic light-emitting diodes; (4) organic field-effect transistors; (5) organic solar cells; (6) organic memory; (7) organic sensors; (8) carbon nanomaterial devices.

syllabi.outline: 軟性電子元件 (Soft Electronics)隨著智慧型手機與穿戴電子元件等消費者電子產品的帶動，受到極大的矚目，因為此類元件可以實現彎曲變形之特性，目前可應用的範圍十分廣泛，包含有OLED、太陽能電池，感測器與有機場效應電晶體等等。因此，本課程將介紹各種軟性電子元件相關原理與應用，並對於半導體物理、基本電子電路學有基本介紹，再將以介紹各種軟性光電元件應用，並結合Arduino電路板，讓同學對於軟性電子科技的效應與應用有著更深入的認識。
syllabi.schedule:
第一周 軟性電子導論
第二周 軟性半導體物理
第三周 電子電路學I
第四周 電子電路學II
第五周 電子電路學III

name.zh: 藥用及化妝用高分子材料

description.zh: 本課程在教授學生藥用及化妝用高分子材料之相關產業製程及配方技術的實務知識，課程設計將首先介紹高分子材料的基本合成方法、物理化學性能、界面活性劑、乳化膠體及生物分解安全性。並教授高分子材料之應用區分為兩大類：其一是指在製藥之劑型加工時所用的和為改善藥物傳輸性能而採用的輔助材料(Excipients)，例如稀釋劑、潤滑劑、黏合劑、崩解劑、助流劑、緩和劑、穩定劑、保濕劑、膜包衣及膠囊殼等。藥用及化妝用輔助材料本身並不具有藥理作用，只是在藥品及化妝品的製造和使用中起從屬或輔助的作用。另一類高分子藥物則不同於前一類，它依靠連接在聚合物分子鏈上的藥理活性基團或高分子本身的藥理作用，進入人體後，能與機體組織發生生理反應，從而產生醫療美容或預防性效果。
description.en: The course is to provide the core knowledge for the development of pharmaceutical and cosmetic technology. It aims to educate and train students with the fundamental principles and applications of biodegradable polymers, surfactants, colloids, emulsions and their related physico-chemical properties. Then potential prospects of pharmaceutical and cosmetic polymers will be taught in two parts to help students understand the future frontiers in polymer science and technology. The first part of lectures will cover the wide range of polymer excipients such as diluents, lubricants, binders, disintegrants, glidants, demulcents, stabilizers, humercants, coatings, and capsules etc, which are inactive pharmaceutical ingredients used for assisting drug delivery. The second part will focus on polymer drugs, which are active pharmaceutical ingredients conjugated to polymer matrices such as polymeric micelles, liposomes, colloidosomes, and solid phase nanoparticle

description.zh: 本課程目的在於建立學生有關於軟性半導體與元件應用之相關技術與知識，並在學期中讓學生實際動手製備與量測有機半導體元件，以對於有機半導體應用有更深入的認識。課程主題主要(1)有機半導體物理介紹；(2) 有機半導體元件製程與封裝技術；(3)有機發光二極體(OLED)元件應用；(4) 有機場效應電晶體應用；(5)有機太陽能電池；(6)有機記憶體元件應用；(7)有機感測器應用；(8) 奈米碳材元件。
description.en: The goal of this class is to build basic knowledge about organic semiconductors and device applications. Students will also learn how to fabricate organic electronics and have further understanding. The main topics of this class include (1) physics of organic semiconductors; (2) device fabrications and processes; (3) organic light-emitting diodes; (4) organic field-effect transistors; (5) organic solar cells; (6) organic memory; (7) organic sensors; (8) carbon nanomaterial devices.

syllabi.outline: 軟性電子元件 (Soft Electronics)隨著智慧型手機與穿戴電子元件等消費者電子產品的帶動，受到極大的矚目，因為此類元件可以實現彎曲變形之特性，目前可應用的範圍十分廣泛，包含有OLED、太陽能電池，感測器與有機場效應電晶體等等。因此，本課程將介紹各種軟性電子元件相關原理與應用，並對於半導體物理、基本電子電路學有基本介紹，再將以介紹各種軟性光電元件應用，並結合Arduino電路板，讓同學對於軟性電子科技的效應與應用有著更深入的認識。

description.zh: 製造聯網整合技術配合感測器、控制器、網路系統等，讓人、機器人、原物料、零組件、重要物品或設備，取得人、機、料、法、環的訊息，透過大數據分析與人工智慧，執行各種事前診斷預防、維護、事發處置及事後重建與改善的動作。本課程著重於製造聯網整合技術與實施方法，特別在智能工廠技術包含IoT、感測器設計與選擇、機電整合、數據分析、預防診斷與維修、智慧適應控制等。
description.en: Integration technology for networking manufacturing systems integrates sensor, controller, networking system, etc.. This technology uses big data analysis and artificial intelligence to communicate among human, robot, raw material, parts, important article or equipment, which can do prediction, protection, and improvement, etc.. This course focuses on integration technology for networking manufacturing systems and its practical implementation. description.zh: 課程介紹雲端資訊計算與運用相關技術，使學生對雲端平台、架構、服務、程式設計有一全面性瞭解。課程內容包括： 1. 雲端儲存系統架構、儲存網路與虛擬化技術， 2. 業務持續運作儲存技術，3. 儲存架構安全與管理 ，4. 雲端排程技術、效能與安全，5.虛擬化資料中心建置-虛擬計算、儲存、網路、桌面與應用，6.雲端服務與管理，7.雲端運算發展概論與企業應用，8.大量資料運算及案例分析，9.Hadoop 與 Mapreduce，10.雲端運算之SaaS架構，11.實習課程與專題計畫。

description.en: This course aims to engage English major students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title:		Global Issues and Trends
Credit Hours:		2
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw
Term Offered:		Spring 2023
Course Description: 	This course aims to prepare students for collaborative participation in global activities by exploring global topics, issues and critical agenda of actions. In the process of cultivating engaged global citizens, the utmost task is to advance students’ understanding and critical evaluation of compelling evidence to apprehend the nature as well as complexity of issues and trend. With panoramic views of global agendas, comprehensive reviews of research studies, and social, cultural, political and economic assessments, global learning underscores collective awareness and brings in an analytical approach with emphasis on individuals’ global accountability, interconnectedness, and rigorous actions. More importantly, this current course provides the opportunity for students to be familiarized with the narrative / discourse style, language use and data description that will support their future pursuit for a global career. Reports adopted are available at major news outlets, research institutions and organizations.

(1)	Attending class regularly and to arrive on time (See Grading Policy)
(2)	Presentations and discussions 
i.	Students (w/ or w/o partners) can volunteer and/or will be conveniently selected to present on issues and topics through the infographics provided in reports with fully-elaborated explanations and analyses on data / concept exhibits. 
ii.	Students who prepare to give a presentation need to post handouts / study notes on Google Classroom a day before the scheduled presentation. 
iii.	Students are obligated to participate in class discussion by Q&A.
(3)	Quizzes will be administered at the instructor’s discretion, and will not necessarily be announced in advance. 
(4)	All student panelists videotape their sessions for further revisions. A complete portfolio (preferably on compact disc) including all recordings will be considered for extra credit bonus at the end of the semester.
Grading Policy: 	(1) Academic honesty is prioritized in this class. Plagiarism will not be tolerated. Students will fail the course without contention once an incident of plagiarism is identified in their work. 
(2) Final grades will be determined by a point system (X out of 100 total points). Students will be evaluated by their panel discussions, submitted materials and debates. (Adjustments will be made if necessary.) 

Presentations (voluntary and/or assigned)
(study notes and interactive feedbacks)	10% X 2 /3 = 20% / 30%
Quizzes 	20%
Midterm Oral and Final Written Exams 	20% X 2 = 40%
Attendance 	20% 
*Students are obligated to attend all class sessions on time. Each absence / lateness will generate 10% / 5% deduction of the semester grades on the 100% scale. A university approved leave of document is accepted as one absence penalty waiver in the entire semester. AWOLs will be marked and entered into the penalty calculation if not corrected in two weeks of time, and lateness upon class dismissal. 
*This syllabus is subject to change at the instructor’s sole discretion. Changes made to the grading policy will be discussed in class. 
Scoring Criteria
1.	Research & analysis: understanding information introduced in the report and seeking additional support or discovering alternative or opposing studies; selection of important information from the report, with coherent and accurate presentation of such information in relation to other information /ideas in the reading and/or concerning issues in question; highly intelligible with exhibition of a sustained discourse 
2.	Content and structure: presenting a clear progression of ideas and conveying the relevant information required by task by providing and explaining substantive ideas and arguments in the reading; making necessary clarifications on facts and data introduced and critical analyses 
3.	Language use: demonstrating good control of basic and complex grammatical structures to allow coherent, efficient expression of ideas; using advanced and domain-specific and topic appropriate registers // Delivery and session management: speech being clear, concise, fluid and sustaining; maintaining the flow of discussions, stating and explaining ideas, arguments, facts and data as planned, asking and answering questions
4.	Study notes: clear and concise outline of content in the reading (report); language support, definitions of terms, and other useful information to enhance comprehension for ensuing discussion

description.zh: 本課程將透過閱讀各種文本（包括新聞文章、社論、報告和研究論文）來檢視當代文化中之社會和政治動態。 透過引導學生觀察、分析和理解當代/流行文化的複雜性和模糊性是如何與文化傳統同步或是超出文化傳承。本課程將介紹及討論引人入勝的文化故事、事件、議題和趨勢，旨在培養學生的批判性分析能力和文化素養。
description.en: This course examines the social and political dynamics of contemporary culture by reading a variety of texts, including news articles, editorials, reports, and research papers. Students will be guided to observe, analyze and understand the complexity and ambiguity of how contemporary / popular cultural phenomena may move in lockstep with the cultural traditions or fall out of sync in the cultural continuity. The course introduces plenty of fascinating culture stories, event, issues and trends to be studied, aiming to develop students’ critical analysis ability and cultural literacy.

syllabi.outline: As an all-encompassing term, the word culture has multiple meanings. Anything involving human activity can be included in the domain of culture. Most importantly, culture is deeply connected with our sense of identity; our culture defines who we are. Culturally-determined identification can be a blessing that empowers our subjectivity, but it can also be a confinement that we strive to be free from. In this course, we will approach important topics in cultural studies from the perspectives of gender, race, and violence, the three issues that most intrinsically connected to identity, by reading theoretical texts and critical essays and viewing related films. Ideally, the course will familiarize students with key concepts in cultural studies and cultivate their critical thinking. Furthermore, the instructor hopes that the course can help students identify potential topics of their senior projects and establish valid approaches.

Applications for big data analytics could include smarter healthcare, multi-channel, finance, computer log analysis, homeland security, traffic control, telecom, search quality, manufacturing, trading analytics, fraud and risk, retailing, among others.

description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行"突破創新"以增加競爭力之唯一生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地徹底執行它。不僅工程或服務技術要創新，管理思維更要突破創新，以有效迅速解?錯綜複雜的研發、工程與管理之諸多矛盾問題。本課程以創新構思問題解?法(TRIZ)為基礎，詳細介紹工程技術如何落實創新與管理實務創新如何執行。本課程適用於自有品牌業者、ODM或OEM製造業者、服務業者與學術單位教學研究，特點如下:完整詳實闡述TRIZ理論並輔以大量簡單案例說明TRIZ概念、工程TRIZ實務案例10餘個與TRIZ工程與管理之參數與創新原則說明簡例約800餘個，管理實務案例20餘個，包含研發管理、服務業管理、專案管理與生產管理等。案例與簡例最多，創新執行力可快速上手與實施應用。本課程TRIZ研發、工程與管理兼顧，製造業與服務業高層、中層與基層員工皆符合讀者條件，使"突破創新"輕易實務執行並成為企業文化，亦適用於大學與研究所之工管、企管(經營管理)、工商管與工程相關科系，可自行按需求選擇性深入教授講解某些章節，也替產業界事先磨練一群創新思維之活力新血，可長久伴隨您在職場(或未來進入職場)解決研發、工程與管理之困難矛盾問題。

description.zh: 本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識。
description.en: The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. It provides necessary knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value.

description.zh: 透過自駕車理論與實務的課程講述，以及搭配業師實作經驗分享，除可以使修課同學對自駕車研究有基本概念之外，也可以藉本堂課引發對新興車輛技術研究領域與其實際應用之興趣。本課程涵蓋內容為自駕車軌跡規劃與控制、先進駕駛輔助控制設計、自駕車感知資料處理及物件偵測演算法、及AI技術應用於自駕車相關功能設計。本課程根據授課主題搭配實驗單元與期末專題，配合使用Matlab/Simulink、CarSim、Python、AI ToolBox等工具軟體，讓修課同學可應用課堂所學來進行自駕車演算法與技術開發，及透過模擬結果分析與驗證。
description.en: This course aims to teach the lessons of autonomous vehicle (AV) theory and practical applications. Moreover, with the experience sharing and cooperative lecturing from industrial experts, students can gain more knowledge about the fundamental concepts of AV research. The course introduces major contents including path planning and tracking control design, advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), perception data processing and detection algorithms, and AI-based technologies in the applications of AV. The course will arrange some labs and the term project to provide students, through conducted simulation analysis and verification, with an in-depth understanding of the emerging technology of AV.

name.zh: 鐵道車輛技術與跨領域設計
name.en: Engineering Technology and Interdisciplinary Design for Railway Vehicle

description.zh: 本課程開授之目標，在讓修習之學生能將鐵道車輛之工程技術與跨領域設計相互融合，在工程分析面能配合跨領域人文設計之需求，並在人文設計面瞭解工程之規範與要求。本課程內容包括鐵道車輛之系統基本架構、鐵道車輛結構及動態之基本工程分析技術、鐵道車輛車廂之功能性設計、及鐵道人文文化；本課程並配合軌道單位之校外參訪，讓課堂所學能與實務技術融合。本課程是以跨院合授的方式，由鐵道車輛技術研發中心、車輛系、文化事業發展系之師資共同參與授課。
description.en: This course aims to provide students the knowledge of engineering technology and interdisciplinary design for railway vehicles.  Design of railway vehicles should consider both the engineering and interdisciplinary cultural design at the same time.  A designer should consider not only engineering regulations and requirements, but also concepts of cultural design.  This course covers basic introduction of railway vehicle system, basic analysis of vehicle structures and dynamics, vehicle interior and exterior functional design, and railway culture.  The industrial tour in this course helps students to realize the theoretical and practical parts of railway vehicles.  This course is a joint lecture instructed by professional faculties from Railway Vehicle Research Center, Department of Vehicle Engineering, and Department of Cultural Vocation Development.

name.zh: 鐵道車輛技術與跨領域設計
name.en: Engineering Technology and Interdisciplinary Design for Railway Vehicle

description.zh: 本課程開授之目標，在讓修習之學生能將鐵道車輛之工程技術與跨領域設計相互融合，在工程分析面能配合跨領域人文設計之需求，並在人文設計面瞭解工程之規範與要求。本課程內容包括鐵道車輛之系統基本架構、鐵道車輛結構及動態之基本工程分析技術、鐵道車輛車廂之功能性設計、及鐵道人文文化；本課程並配合軌道單位之校外參訪，讓課堂所學能與實務技術融合。本課程是以跨院合授的方式，由鐵道車輛技術研發中心、車輛系、文化事業發展系之師資共同參與授課。
description.en: This course aims to provide students the knowledge of engineering technology and interdisciplinary design for railway vehicles.  Design of railway vehicles should consider both the engineering and interdisciplinary cultural design at the same time.  A designer should consider not only engineering regulations and requirements, but also concepts of cultural design.  This course covers basic introduction of railway vehicle system, basic analysis of vehicle structures and dynamics, vehicle interior and exterior functional design, and railway culture.  The industrial tour in this course helps students to realize the theoretical and practical parts of railway vehicles.  This course is a joint lecture instructed by professional faculties from Railway Vehicle Research Center, Department of Vehicle Engineering, and Department of Cultural Vocation Development.

description.zh: 這門課除了教授傳統企業環境管理及相關實務之外，特別將著重在企業提升如何透過綠色創新來提升綠色競爭力的策略與做法；此外，課程另一重點將會是企業如何透過協助聯合國永續發展目標(UN SDGs)的達成，來創造企業的永續競爭力。學生將會深入探究金字塔底層(BOP)與創造共享價值(Creating Shared Value, CSV)之理論及實務做法，以及成為一個真正永續企業的策略。
description.en: In this course, traditional corporate environmental management and the strategies for improving green competitiveness will be taught. In addition, the strategies of corporate sustainability- how the corporate to create sustainable competitiveness by coping with the 17 goals of UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs) will also be taught. Theories and practices of Bottom of the Pyramid (BOP) and Creating Shared Value (CSV), as well as the strategies of being a true sustainable enterprise will be emphasized in the class.

description.zh: 本課程之主旨在於加強學生對薄膜處理程序之深入了解，以作為進一步對水質管理應用之基礎。薄膜的種類介紹包括薄膜逆滲透、奈米薄膜、超過濾、微過濾、前驅滲透、電透析以及薄膜生物處理。基本理論包括薄膜前處理、質量傳輸、積垢、結構、薄膜阻塞及清理、後處理及實務應用。

description.zh: 能源在日常生活中以很多型態呈現，大量的能源使用於汽車動力、食物與用水加熱、產品製造、發電及其他不同事務。使用傳統能源會排放空氣污染物，因而引起鄰近地區、區域、跨國境空氣污染問題，甚至是全球的環境衝擊效應。本課程將檢視能源使用現況及其衍生的環境議題，並且探討能源使用之趨勢。傳統能源(如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等)、及再生能源(如太陽能、水力、風能、地熱能等)及能源效率等內容，都將於課程中介紹
description.en: Energy enters our everyday lives in many ways. Prodigious amounts of energy are used to power automobiles, heat food and water, manufacture products, generate electricity, and perform various other tasks. The use of traditional energy will emit air pollutants that may result in regional air pollution problem as well as global effects. In this course we will look at the current energy situation, its environmental implications, and try to determine the patterns of energy use. We will look at energy use as coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear energy, and renewable energy, such as solar energy, hydroelectric

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹各種再生能源的原理與發展現況，包括太陽能、風能、波浪能、潮汐能、海流能、海洋熱能、鹽差能、生物能、水力能、地熱能、氫與燃料電池等，其有關的主要技術和成本、對環境造成的衝擊、來源的規模潛力及其未來前景。並檢視各種傳統能源如煤、石油、天然氣、核能等之使用現況及其衍生的環境議題。
Knowing the principle and development of each renewable energy, including solar energy, wind energy, ocean energy (wave energy, tide energy, ocean thermal energy, ocean salinity gradient energy), hydro energy, geothermal energy, biomass energy, and fuel cell. Realizing their potential, impact on the environment, and future perspective.

description.zh: 本課程以深入淺出之方式，介紹與機器學習之相關技術及演算法，目標是修習本課程之學生具有閱讀機器學習相關文獻之基本知識，並能從事相關之實務或電腦模擬實驗之工作，因此本課程著重在廣泛介紹各類之演算法之應用，而非深究少數演算法之深奧數學原理．本課程涵蓋之演算法，包含：最佳化基本知識，隨機最佳化演算法，隨機搜尋，決策樹，隨機森林，類神經網路及深度學習相關演算法，基因演算法，貝氏定理及應用，高斯混合模型，隱藏式馬可夫鍊(及訓練演算法)，支援向量機，線性及邏輯回歸，分群方法，降維方法，提升方法，決策融合技巧，及增強式學習等。
description.en: This course covers most of the techniques and algorithms related to the current trend in the machine learning field. The goal of the course is that students complete this course can read and understand the literature in the machine learning field, and can conduct computer simulations for experiments or apply the techniques to practical problems. Therefore, the course intends to cover a broad range of algorithms with emphasis on applications, rather than to cover only a few algorithms with extensive mathematical treatments. The algorithms covered in this course include: foundations of optimizations, random search, decision tree, random decision forests, neural networks and deep learning, genetic algorithm, Bayes' theorem and its applications, Gauss mixture model, hidden Markov model, support vector machine, linear and logistic regressions, clustering algorithms, dimension reduction techniques, boosting methods, decision level fusion techniques, and reinforcement learning.

syllabi.outline:
This course covers a broad classes of machine learning algorithms. After taking this course, students should be able to conduct research in this field. The emphasis of this course is not in the theoretical development (math), but in the understanding level. Therefore, many examples will be given in the lecture to show how to apply the equations to real problems. The detailed contents are given in the course schedule field.

Prerequisite: Calculus (partial derivatives), undergrad linear algebra (eigenvalues & eigenvectors), undergrad probability (random variable, joint density, Gaussian distribution), and programming skills (Python)

Week 1: Class announcement and introduction to machine learning
Week 2: Holiday & introduction to machine learning
Week 3: Basics of supervised learning (classification and regression), VC dimension, Bayesian decision theory, and Naive Bayes classifiers 
Week 4: ML and MAP estimation, Sample mean and sample covariance, multivariate Gaussian,  Bias vs variance dilemma, Dimension reduction techniques: PCA, FA
Week 5: Dimension reduction techniques: LDA and ICA, Unsupervised learning: Clustering algorithm (k-means)
Week 6: Decision trees: ID3, C4.5, and bagging algorithm (random forest)
Week 7: Holiday
Week 8: Basics of optimization
Week 9: MT
Week 10: MT sol. Gradient search and linear discrimination
Week 11: Feedforward neural networks with examples: multi-layer perceptrons, Back propagation, and Regularization methods
Week 12: Deep learning and convolutional neural networks
Week 13, 14: More on deep neural networks: YOLO, Autoencoder, LSTM, and advanced topics, such as Bayesian networks, confidence of classification, and self-supervised learning (if time permitted)
Week 15: SVM 
Week 16: Adaboost and Ensemble learning
Week 17: Design and analysis of experiments 
Week 18: Final exam

name.en: Data Science Principles with Applications on Educational Data

description.zh: 資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
description.en: Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce the valuable knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The topics include data processing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. The course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with fundamental related knowledge and the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation-collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The course training is toward equipping students with the mindset and the ability to solve problems with the learned techniques on educational data. In addition, students need to practice the presentation for the findings of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually.

Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce or create the valuable information and knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The related topics include data processing and computing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. This course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with the fundamental related knowledge as well as the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation- collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The training of this course is toward equipping students with the general mindset and the ability to solve problems practically with the learned techniques on educational data with project groups. In addition, the students also need to practice the presentation for the findings and results of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually. The major objective of this course is to cultivate talents in data science.

description.zh: 本課程將深入介紹檔案系統與儲存系統之作用原理，課程主軸將涵蓋 1. 輸出/輸入設備 2. 磁碟陣列與資料可靠性 3. 檔案系統基礎與設計原理 4. 分散式檔案系統 5. 新興儲存裝置 與 6. 鍵值儲存系統。修習本課程之學生將須要具備下列基礎知識，包含作業系統、C 語言以及基礎 Linux 指令。同時，本課程也將依照課程進展介紹最新的新興儲存裝置、檔案系統與儲存系統之相關研究以及大數據管理等議題。
description.en: This course will detail the working principles and design philosophy of file and storage systems and with prime focus on (1) I/O Devices, (2) RAID and Data Integrity, (3) File system Basics and Designs, (4) Distributed File System, (5) Emerging Storage Devices, (6) Key Value Stores. Please be noted that the knowledge of Operating System, C language, and the use of basic Linux command are required before taking this course. Depending on the current research trends, the course also discusses the latest applied storage topics, especially related to scalable and dependable big data management.

description.zh: 實現計算已從傳統地本地端機器獨立完成，進而委託上雲端等服務提供者協力完成。然而隨著資料或應用的授權，相關的計算安全性必須重新被探討。本課程將會從資料的隱密性出發，探討如何使用同態加密法輕鬆完成一個安全的授權計算，進而利用其他輕量化元件(混淆電路、私密分享)來取代同態加密並重新設計授權計算協定。接著會轉往定義資料的隱私性，並介紹k匿名等去識別化技術，最終帶入現今最嚴謹的差分隱私。透過上述之保有隱私與安全方法，將著名的人工智慧與機器學習演算法導入授權計算之中，重構不同情境的新型態安全計算框架。
description.en: The implementation of computation has been completed independently from the local machine, and then outsourced to the cloud (or some service providers) to complete it. However, with the delegation of data or applications, accordingly the security of such computation must be revisited. This course will start from the data confidentiality, discuss how to use homomorphic encryption to easily complete a secure outsourced computation, and then use other lightweight components (garbled circuit, secret sharing) to replace homomorphic encryption and redesign the secure protocols. Then it will move to define the privacy of data, introduce de-identification techniques such as k-anonymity, and finally bring the most rigorous notion of differential privacy. Through the above-mentioned methods of preserving privacy and security, artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms are introduced into the outsourced computation to reconstruct a new type of the framework for different scenarios.

syllabi.outline:
實現計算已從傳統地本地端機器獨立完成，進而委託上雲端等服務提供者協力完成。然而隨著資料或應用的授權，相關的計算安全性必須重新被探討。本課程將會從資料的隱密性出發，探討如何使用同態加密法輕鬆完成一個安全的授權計算，進而利用其他輕量化元件(混淆電路、私密分享)來取代同態加密並重新設計授權計算協定。接著會轉往定義資料的隱私性，並介紹k匿名等去識別化技術，最終帶入現今最嚴謹的差分隱私。透過上述之保有隱私與安全方法，將著名的人工智慧與機器學習演算法導入授權計算之中，重構不同情境的新型態安全計算框架。
The implementation of computation has been completed independently from the local machine, and then outsourced to the cloud (or some service providers) to complete it. However, with the delegation of data or applications, accordingly the security of such computation must be revisited. This course will start from the data confidentiality, discuss how to use homomorphic encryption to easily complete a secure outsourced computation, and then use other lightweight components (garbled circuit, secret sharing) to replace homomorphic encryption and redesign the secure protocols. Then it will move to define the privacy of data, introduce de-identification techniques such as k-anonymity, and finally bring the most rigorous notion of differential privacy. Through the above-mentioned methods of preserving privacy and security, artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms are introduced into the outsourced computation to reconstruct a new type of the framework for different scenarios.

Within the broad category of biomedical engineering, our focus will be on the field of medical electrical engineering, particularly in laser medicine. This specialization aims to offer information that aids in diagnosis and assists in the treatment and prevention of diseases.

description.en: To ensure the sustainable development of environment, economy and society, effective measures are gradually adopted by internationals. Low-Carbonization and Net-Zero Emission obviously becomes a global common tendency. This course will be introduced the international tendencies of “energy saving & carbon reduction” and “low-carbon society”. It will also be introduced with related regulations of international greenhouse gases reduction, energy security, Taiwan GHG reduction, energy saving. The above concepts and latter concepts of carbon footprints and carbon neutral will be introduced with international practical cases to refer to challenges as well as chances toward a low-carbon Economy and society in Taiwan.

本課程為第二階段之系列課程，其內容包括：一、疫學：探討關於病態建築症候群的因素與特定外來的致病物質與疫之關聯。二、家政事務：探討生活習慣、飲食生活的變化對環境、人體健康之影響。三、醫療領域：探討病態建築症候群與化學物質過敏症的差異與因應對策。四、日常領域：探討日常生活用品、居住行為對環境、人體健康之影響。
