name.en: Disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage

description.zh:
我國古蹟與歷史建築之文化遺產防災計畫實施現況，至今因欠缺有系統之調查研究，因此難以了解問題點所在。此外台灣現有之古蹟與歷史建築多為日治時期所遺留下來，而日本至今已有相當多具有良好防災計畫之古蹟與歷史建築案例，應可作為我國相關研究參考，但國內對此課題亦缺少有系統之調查。
本課程的授課內容如下：1.概論 2.文化遺產防災之重要性3.文化遺產防災之基本策略4. 文化遺產防災之進行方式5.文化遺產之災害種類與對策。
description.en:
Due to the lack of systematic research work carried out in Taiwan, it is difficult to find out the problems of the current disaster prevention plans for the cultural heritage. Taiwan has many existing vestiges and relics from Japanese colonial period at the moment. Despite the fact that there are numerous excellent examples of disaster prevention plans in Japan for us to consult and to research, little systematic work regarded the subject can be found in the literature in our own country. 
The course content about followings: 
1. Introduction
2. Importance of disaster prevention of cultural heritage
3. Disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage 
4. Approach of disaster prevention plans of cultural heritage
5. Type of cultural heritage disaster and guideline

name.zh: 都市土地使用計畫與成長管理
name.en: Urban Land Use Planning and Growth Management

description.zh: 本課程主要目的在強化有關都市土地使用規劃與成長管理的理論與經驗，以及增進對都市整體建成環境未來的瞭解。因此，本課程將藉由對都市土地使用規劃與成長管理經驗特有與一般課題、對策及創新作法的基礎瞭解，以培養理論與實務的知能。故本課程主要內容包括： 一、都市成長對土地的需求。 二、土地使用管制與倫理。三、都市變遷與規劃。四、都市成長管理與政府的角色。 五、達到都市成長管理的可能途徑。 六、都市成長管理體系內的必要措施：例如環境、交通運輸、住宅、財政、風險、信託、組織等。 七、結論。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to further our knowledge about current theories and experiences with urban land use planning and growth management, and the struggle to define the collective future of our built environment. By identifying unique as well as common issues, problems, and innovations in urban growth management experiences, our hope is to improve planning practice. To examine these concerns, the course includes: 1. Land needs for urban growth. 2. Land use control and ethics. 3. Urban change and planning. 4.Growth management and the role of government. 5. Alternative approaches to growth management. 6. Balancing planning needs in growth management systems: environmental, transportation, housing, financing, risk, trust and organization concerns. 7. Conclusions

description.zh: 本課程以都市再生理念為中心，講述推動都市再生過程中面對相關文化資產保存議題之理論與實際操作架構。第一部份探討歷史文化保存相關理念手法。第二部份探討各國文化保存再生案例實踐之相關課題與借鏡，第三部份針對台灣本土都市更新過程中面臨歷史文化保存議題深入研討。
description.en:
This course regards urban revitalization as the central concept to discuss about the theory & implementation of history & culture conservation issues of urban revitalization. This course consisted of three parts. 
The first part is considered of relevant concepts & strategies of history and culture conservation. The second part is to survey different implemented examples of history and culture conservation of different country. The third part involves the regional issues by local-oriented issues of Taiwan. A few of cultural conservation topics are introduced to be further interpreted.

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

name.zh: 建築與景觀都市主義研究
name.en: Studies in Architecture and Landscape Urbanism

description.zh: 都市主義(Urbanism)最早可追溯於十九世紀末建築工程師對於空間組織與城市關係的討論，其真正的崛起始於二十世紀初對於集中生產，空間組織網絡與政治經濟市民等都市中新興現象的討論。因日趨複雜化的都市發展與環境巨變的挑戰，九十年代開始陸續出現一系列以都市主義為基盤的跨學科整合性討論，而景觀都市主義(Landscape Urbanism, 1997)則在其中扮演相當關鍵的角色。不論是庫哈斯早期在S, M, L, XL (1995)中的批判，或瓦爾德海姆在《都市景觀主義讀本》(2006)中的宣言，皆引指建築、景觀建築、都市設計與都市計畫學門，已逐漸形成一種彼此跨越亦彼此更新的領域狀態。這般跨都市主義架構，使各學門在理論發展與專業實踐上具有更開展性的方法，介入當代與未來的都市環境與城市生活。然而此跨都市主義的學理多在景觀學門的教學範疇內，但在建築專業教育中卻鮮有足夠的涉及與含括。
description.en: The term "urbanism" originated in the late nineteenth century with a focus on spatial organization of the city. The emergence of urbanism in the early twentieth century was associated with the rise of industrial distribution, spatial networks and citizenship etc. in the city. After 90’s, there were a series of new academic terms referring to this idea which created a base for interdisciplinary studies amongst related spatial terrains. Landscape Urbanism is regarded as one of the significant design and planning ethos especially in the twenty-first century.  In Koolhaas’ early work S,M,L,XL(1995)and Waldheim’s representative collection The Landscape Urbanism Reader(2006), they both shared account that architecture, landscape architecture, urban design and planning are moving toward shared form of emerging ‘practice. The body of knowledge about Landscape Urbanism has been largely developed within landscape discipline, yet merely in the architectural discourse especially in Taiwan.

syllabi.outline:

The term "urbanism" originated in the late nineteenth century with a focus on
spatial organization of the city. The emergence of urbanism in the early twentieth century was associated with the rise of industrial distribution, spatial networks and citizenship etc. in the city. After 90’s, there were a series of new academic terms referring to this idea which created a base for interdisciplinary studies amongst related spatial terrains. Landscape Urbanism is regarded as one of the significant design and planning ethos especially in the twenty-first century. In Koolhaas’ early work S/M/L/XL and Waldheim’s representative collection The Landscape Urbanism Reader, they both shared account that architecture, landscape architecture, urban design and planning are moving toward shared form of ?emerging ‘practice. description.zh: 目前建築工程營建產業多賴以圖文資料溝通，文件易有失誤，會提高成本、工期延長、甚至於爭議之狀況。BIM 工具之運用，可有效提升營建產業生產力。各國政府已紛紛推出 BIM 的審照制度，我國近年來於公共工程招標已要求BIM技術之整合運用。本課程針對BIM運用於建築生命週期中各產業間的介紹及效益、實例分享，並於課程中指導同學針對BIM軟體基礎工具使用。
description.en:
Architectural engineering construction industry on which 2D graphic data communication, the file is easy to form mistakes, will increase the cost of the extension of time, even controversial situation. The use of Building Information Modeling (BIM) software tools, which can effectively enhance the productivity of the construction industry. Governments around the world have now launched the BIM audit system.
In recent years, Taiwan has asked the public works bidding integrate and use of BIM technology. This course focuses on the introduction and effective life cycle of BIM for architectural industry, examples of sharing.  Guidance to students in courses based tool for BIM software.

description.zh: 建立節能車輛模擬平台，用以評估主系統與次系統之性能與響應關係，並以行車型態為例，分析能量管理系統、引擎、馬達、燃料電池、變速箱與不同儲能電池彼此之特性影響，進一步完成整車調校與控制策略之修正；介紹節能車輛中所使用數學模型與相關理論，進一步連結到學生在實務時會遇到的實際案例，解釋所觀察到的物理反應現象。
description.en: Establish the energy-saving vehicle simulation platforms are developed in this study to evaluate performance and response between main system and subsystems. The driving cycles are adopted as an example and characteristics among energy management system (EMS), engine, motor, fuel cell, automated manual transmission (AMT) and Energy storage batteries are analyzed for further calibration and modification of control strategy. This course aims at teaching key mathematical models and related theories used in energy-saving vehicles, further links to actual cases that students will encounter on the scene, and explains the physical reaction phenomena observed.

description.zh: 「仿生工程」是生物學到工程技術的觀念轉移，生物系統在上億年的演化驗證後已經達到高效且永續的精緻成果，本課程將介紹仿生工程之最新發展，師法自然將其應用於工程上將帶來革命性的突破。課程內容包含四大主題: (1)仿生概述、(2)生物製造技術、(3)生物高分子與(4)生物材料於仿生技術上的應用。
description.en: “Biomimetic Engineering” is a kind of knowledge transferring from biology to engineering technology. After billions of years of evolution, it has been proven that the biological system is highly efficient and sustainable. In this course, the latest progress in Biomimetic Engineering will be introduced. It will bring us revolutionary breakthroughs if we learn from nature and apply it to technology. The topics covered in this course will include (1) an introduction to bioinspiration, (2) biofabrication, (3) biomacromolecules, and (4) biomaterials and their application in bioinspired engineering.

先修課程：科技日文I或具備日文基礎。
本課程學習理工科系領域中常用之科學.工程用語以及圖、表、器具、裝置等日文。在暸解文法同時，學習以日文表達科學.工程領域中之特定文體敘述。本課程學習內容約在日本語檢定三級左右。
description.en: Prerequisites: Scientific and technical Japanese I or fundamental Japanese reading ability. Fundamental terminology of science and engineering are explained in Japanese together with expressions of charts, tables, equipment, devices and others. By learning the fundamental Japanese grammar, this lecture provides the framework for understanding the expression of scientific and technical matters in Japanese. The context of this lecture is about level 3 of JLPT.

syllabi.outline:
內容概述：
基礎日本語文法解說，個人專業領域的自我介紹。
科技日語閱讀技巧解說，日文技術資料查尋及研讀，科技外來用語與英文技術用語比較說明。專業工程領域說明書講解與日文技術報告書文法解說。
* Basic HIRAGANA and KATAKANA writing and reading ability.
* Basic Japanese grammar explanation and self-introduction of the personal professional field by Japanese.
* How to explain the scientific and technical by Japanese.
* Search and study of Japanese technical materials, comparative explanation of technical KATAKANA language and English technical language. 
* Explanation of professional engineering field manual and Japanese technical report grammar explanation.

name.zh: 材料與結構非破壞檢測
name.en: Non-Destructive Testing of Materials and Structures

description.zh: 課程內容包括：原理探討:超音波,磁場與磁性,電磁感應與渦電流,輻射線,液體表面現象,材料微結構；方法介紹:磁場檢測法,超音波檢測法,渦電流檢測法,X光檢測法,液滲法,微奈米檢測(各種顯微鏡)等；材料非破壞檢測實驗:導電性材料、磁性材料、陶瓷材料、複合材料之缺陷檢測；結構非破壞檢測實驗：機械零件、以及特定結構之檢測；非破壞檢測影像：電腦數據擷取、數據分析、與影像處理
description.en: Introduce the concepts of following topics, Fundamentals: ultrasonic waves, magnetic field and magnetism, electromagnetic induction and eddy currents, X-rays, penetrants. NDT methods: ultrasonic testing, magnetoscopic inspections, eddy current testing, radiographic technique, penetrants method. NDT of materials: conductive materials, magnetic materials, ceramics, composite materials. NDT of structures: mechanical components, specific structures. NDT images: PC-based data acquisition, data analysis and image process.

name.zh: 植入物與矯具生物力學

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
生物力學是一門整合醫學與工學的學科。本課程介紹並討論十大主題：(1)脊椎生物力學、(2)關節生物力學、(3)骨折生物力學、(4)復健生物力學、(5)運動生物力學、(6)心血管生物力學、(7)植入物設計原理、(8)手術器械設計原理、(9)矯具設計原理與(10)病床與輪椅設計原理。
description.en: Biomechanics is a multi-discipline branch incorporating medicine and mechanics. Ten topics are introduced and discussed in this class: (1) spinal biomechanics, (2) joint biomechanics, (3) trauma biomechanics, (4) rehabilitation biomechanics, (5) sport biomechanics, (6) cardiovascular biomechanics, (7) implant design, (8) instrument design, (9) orthotice design, and (10) sickbed and wheelchair design.

syllabi.outline:
生物力學是一門整合生物醫學與力學的學科。本課程涵蓋生物力學基礎概念與理論之介紹，並分別討論以下各主題：(1)生物力學概論、(2)植入物與矯具、(3) 骨骼生物力學、(4) 髖關節生物力學、(5) 膝關節生物力學、(6)足部生物力學、(7) 脊椎生物力學、(8) 牙科生物力學、(9) 人體動作分析、(10)電腦輔助工程分析在生物力學之應用。各主題中亦將介紹各式植入物與輔具於臨床醫學上之應用。

Biomechanics is a multi-disciplinary science which integrates biomedical and mechanical subjects. This course covers the basic principles of biomechanics and its applications in the following topics: (1) Introduction to biomechanics; (2) Prosthetics and orthotics; (3) Bone mechanics; (4) Hip joint biomechanics; (5) Knee joint biomechanics; (6) Biomechanics of foot and footwear; (7) Spine biomechanics; (8) Dental biomechanics; (9) Human motion analysis; (10) Applications of CAE in biomechanics. The related prothetic and orthotic devices will also be introduced in selected topics.

description.zh: 先修課程：統計學基礎統計介紹、一因子、二因子、多因子實驗、完全隨機化法、隨機化區集法、拉丁方格法、及直交表、田口式品質工程。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide students with methods of promoting experimental efficiency. It may include introduction to basic statistical concepts, one-factor, two-factor, multi-factor experiments, completely randomized design, randomized block design, Latin square, and orthogonal array, Taguchi technique for quality engineering.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程：統計學基礎統計介紹、一因子、二因子、多因子實驗、完全隨機化法、隨機化區集法、拉丁方格法、及直交表、田口式品質工程。 

一、先修課程：具一般基本統計觀念
二、簡介：此課程將介紹各種實驗之設計及統計分析法，並應用至實務例題上。方法包括：單因子實驗，完全區集設計，多因子實驗，2k 因子實驗，部份因子實驗，變異數分析，迴歸分析，最佳化及田口的實驗設計。  
三、教學目的與目標：本課程主要目的是以統計設計之實驗，提供解決工程問題的正確方法，同時也藉有效率地實驗規劃、執行與分析、決策，以建立一有效的系統模型。因此，本課程提供學生具有「自行建構有效的實驗模型與分析」能力之學習目標

description.zh: 本課程主要在教導學生對西方(歐洲及西亞)認識歷史建築之演進過程與思考涵構，並使學生具備西方文化歷史與思想的相關知識，其主要授課內容如下：1.在範圍上--自古埃及、西亞、而收至古典建築、基督教建築、中世紀的大教堂時代以至文藝復興及17、18世紀的建築歷史。2.在思想上--自希臘的文化與哲學思想談起，以至各時代之政治、宗教與社會文明之演進，瞭解歷史涵構及其對建築的表現。3.在建築上─針對每一時期的建築表現，瞭解其構造方法、材料應用及相關細部特徵。
description.en: This course is mainly to teach students the evolution process and connotation of historical buildings in the West (Europe and West Asia), and to equip students with relevant knowledge of Western culture, history and thought. The main teaching contents are as follows: 1. In terms of scope-- From ancient Egypt, West Asia, and the collection to classical architecture, Christian architecture, medieval cathedral era, Renaissance and the architectural history of the 17th and 18th centuries. 2. In terms of ideology-from the Greek culture and philosophical thought, to the evolution of politics, religion and social civilization in various eras, understand the historical connotation and its expression on architecture. 3. In architecture—according to the architectural performance of each period, understand its construction method, material application and related detail features.

description.zh: 本課程之主要目的在於教授都市設計的基本分析理論與方法，除透過課堂案例的介紹與討論外，學生還將以分組方式進行觀察研究與運算分析。案例介紹與討論之重點在於認識影響都市空間環境品質的關鍵要素，而分組研究之目的則在於讓學生藉由各種現場觀察與數位分析工具的應用，進一步探索這些關鍵要素在都市空間形構過程的交互影響過程。
description.en: This course aims to introduce students to key theoretical and methodological approaches in urban design. The main content will be delivered through a series of case study discussion and project-based research practice. In specific, the case study is to review and identify key factors shaping the physical environment of cities; while through collaborative research projects, students are expected to engage in a step-by-step process of on-site observation and computational analysis, examining how the factors are interacting with each other.

description.zh: 當 Lumiere 兄弟於 1895 年末在巴黎一家咖啡館,舉辦第一場售票的電影放映會時,也正是全球第二次工業革命如火如荼影響人們的生產方式與都市生活之際,透過紀錄當代都市活動與工業化機械美學的短片,他們讓電影技術與城市發展從最初就密不可分,共同作為歌頌現代性的重要媒介。然而,學術界要遲到約莫百年之後,從 1990 年代開始才逐漸形成專門探討電影與城市互動關係的跨學門領域。來自電影研究、都市研究、地理學、歷史學、比較文學、區域研究??等等領域的學者們,於過去三十數年間替電影城市研究貢獻心力。他們不只是藉由電影分析與相關史料爬梳來重新理解現代性、現代主義與當代都市的發展,也同時關注於二次大戰後流行的黑色電影(film noir)如何將當時的都市議題作為其創作主題,後續於 1970 年代起流行的各種近未來反烏托邦電影,又是怎麼進一步藉由預測人類都市的發展來反思當下,創造電影與城市間更為複雜的互文關係。千禧年之後,隨著電影工業與市場的全球化,電影逐漸成為具有都市行銷潛力的大眾媒體,電影場景更逐步發展成一個重要的觀光類型。同時因為電影技術門檻降低與社群媒體的發展,電影也不再只是電影公司或具有天份的獨立電影工作者的遊戲,更多難以分類的影像對都市空間進
description.en: While cinema has been invented over a hundred years and getting influential in shaping people’s perspectives to our environments, the studies of cinematic urbanism have only initiated since 1990s. During the past decades, this interdisciplinary field has developed upon the scholarships of various disciplines, including film and media studies, cultural studies, history, geography, urban studies, etc. This course intends to introduce this still young field through chronologically examining the relationships between cinema and cities, from both being used to celebrate and mediate the modern feelings,to film noir playing a crucial role to criticize and depict urban problems, and to cinematic urban imaginaries boosting tourism and intervening in urban process. Students will learn the theories and methodologies of cinematic urbanism studies, comprehending cinema and different urban spaces as powerful medium that could be manipulated to create, transmit, and perceive certain ideologies.

name.zh: 傳統與未來的建築構法

description.zh: 本課程從建築物構築方法和材料特性出發，介紹構法的歷史以及創新應用。內容包括現行工法的運用，以及先進工法的突破。藉由課程引導和案例介紹，培養學生構法知識與應用能力，提升學理與實務上的知能。
description.en: This course starts from building construction methods, introduces the technical history, innovative applications of construction methods. The content includes the application of current construction methods, as well as the breakthrough of advanced construction. Through course guidance and case study, students will cultivate their knowledge of construction method, and enhance their ability in academic theory and practice.

description.zh:
本課程主要在教導學生探討基本室內環境品質與人體健康間的關係，使學生具備創造健康室內環境的相關知識及操作能力，主要授課要點如下：
1.以各種類型的建築室內環境為主題；
2.探討人為環境與人體健康之關係；
3.探討建築材料、構造與設備對室內環境各項因子之影響；
4.學習室內環境品質量測儀器之操作與判讀能力；
5.具備診斷與改善一般室內環境議題之相關專業知識及操作能力。
description.en:
The purpose of this course is to discuss the relationship between Indoor Environment Quality and human healthy, and make sure our students can realize the knowledge of healthy environment and manage it.
Contents：
1. The indoor environment of different types of building.
2. The relationship between the artificial environment and human health.
3. Discuss the influence of the building material, construction and equipment on indoor environment.
4. Learn to use the instrument to measure indoor environment quality.
5. Learn to diagnose and improve indoor environment quality.

syllabi.outline: 為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。本課程為第一階段之系列課程，其內容包括： 一.健康環境概念：說明何謂「病態建築」，探討室內空氣與健康之關係。 二.建築物污染源：探討來自各建築材料的化學物質逸散及其對人體健康之影響，並提出室內污染物質濃度減低對策。 三.生物性污染源：探討黴菌、蹣、白蟻及寵物等帶來的室內空氣污染。 四.診斷技術：說明室內空氣品質診斷方法及病態建築改善之專業技術，配合案例介紹探討新、舊建築物室內環境品質的設計預防、診斷改善技術。

description.zh: 培養正確的英語發音與腔調，並訓練學生熟悉如何使用音標記錄發音以及辨認學習者在英語發音中經常發生的問題。  課程中也介紹英語語音系統的主要規則。
description.en: This course will be concerned with English speech sounds and stress patterns, the use of phonetic symbols for transcribing pronunciation and identifying pronunciation problems. The general principles of English phonology will be introduced.

syllabi.outline: The course provides an introduction to English phonetics. We will focus on the basic acoustic and articulatory properties of English vowels and consonants and learn to transcribe these speech sounds using the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA). This course also covers the general prosodic patterns in English, such as stress, intonation, and rhythm. Upon completion of this course, students will be able to identify their own pronunciation problems and apply this practical experience to English pronunciation teaching.

name.zh: 節能車輛模擬與嵌入式系統
name.en: Energy-saving vehicle simulation and embedded system

description.zh: 建立節能車輛模擬平台，用以評估主系統與次系統之性能與響應關係，並以行車型態為例，分析能量管理系統、引擎、馬達、燃料電池、變速箱與不同儲能電池彼此之特性影響，進一步完成整車調校與控制策略之修正；介紹節能車輛中所使用數學模型與相關理論，進一步連結到學生在實務時會遇到的實際案例，解釋所觀察到的物理反應現象。
description.en: Establish the energy-saving vehicle simulation platforms are developed in this study to evaluate performance and response between main system and subsystems. The driving cycles are adopted as an example and characteristics among energy management system (EMS), engine, motor, fuel cell, automated manual transmission (AMT) and Energy storage batteries are analyzed for further calibration and modification of control strategy. This course aims at teaching key mathematical models and related theories used in energy-saving vehicles, further links to actual cases that students will encounter on the scene, and explains the physical reaction phenomena observed.

syllabi.outline:
建立節能車輛模擬平台，用以評估主系統與次系統之性能與響應關係，並以行車型態為例，分析能量管理系統、引擎、馬達、燃料電池、變速箱與不同儲能電池彼此之特性影響，進一步完成整車調校與控制策略之修正；介紹節能車輛中所使用數學模型與相關理論，進一步連結到學生在實務時會遇到的實際案例，解釋所觀察到的物理反應現象。

The driving cycles are adopted as an example and characteristics among energy management system (EMS), engine, motor, fuel cell, automated manual transmission (AMT) and Energy storage batteries are analyzed for further calibration and modification of control strategy. This course aims at teaching key mathematical models and related theories used in energy-saving vehicles, further links to actual cases that students will encounter on the scene, and explains the physical reaction phenomena observed.

description.en: General theory for dynamic response of systems having one or several degrees of freedom. Emphasis on the application of dynamic response theory to structural design.

syllabi.outline: This course bridges the learning subjects in the undergraduate courses and the future subjects in graduate courses. The content is focused on an SDOF system's governing equation. Students will review what they’ve already learned in their first three years and learn two approaches to dynamic analysis. The main content includes reviews of solutions to 2nd order differential equations, problem statements, free vibration, response to harmonic and periodic excitations, response to arbitrary, step, and pulse excitations, numerical evaluation of dynamic response, and estimation of earthquake responses of a linear system.

description.zh: 本課程講授內容兼顧理論與實務。促使學習土木工程學生瞭解施工安全及衛生的重要性，如何規劃推動各項安全管理實務工作。確認施工觀念，發揮全面防災功能，確保施工安全與衛生。
description.en: The objective of this course is to introduce the protection of fire engineering， It will cover: Safety and disaster preclusion of opencast ground、foundation construction、hypothesis engineering、structure engineering、fitment engineering etc.

syllabi.outline: 本課程的目標在使學生了解施工安全衛生的重要，熟悉有關知識及緊急措施，從而增加處變之因應能力。內容包括施工安全衛生組織，事故調查分析，風險評估與安全管理，施工安全和衛生設備，安全經費編列與執行，新穎的風險評估及安全管理方法與研究等。

description.zh: 給水及污水工程介紹自來水及汙水工程及其操作系統所需之原理、設計工具。其主要應用到流體力學、水文學、水處理及相關之設計及計算。主要的議題包含水質參數、地表水及地下水處理、自來水處理過程、汙染物移除、管網設計、汙水處理、生物處理、下水道建設、自來水及下水道操作及維護。
description.en: The Water Supply and Sewerage provides students with engineering principles and tools for designing and operating water and sewerage systems. It facilitates application of knowledge acquired in fluid mechanics, hydrology, water quality, design and computing. Key topics include water quality parameters; groundwater and surface water treatment; water treatment process technologies; nutrient removal; simplified sewerage; decentralised water and sanitation systems; biosolids management; and operation and maintenance of water supply and sanitation infrastructure.

syllabi.outline:
給水與污水工程是土木與環境工程中重要的基礎工程課程。給水工程為自來水工程，從水源取水、導水、淨水到配水，包含一連串的工程技術與方法。污水工程則是將廢污水淨化處理，至符合國家放流水標準後排出的過程。兩者處理對象與目的不同，但其中淨水處理有相似的技術與方法。本課程著重在淨水工程部分，也是兩者的核心技術。而給水工程中的取水與輸配水屬於水利工程，本課程僅簡要介紹。淨水處理包含物理、化學、生物處理技術，根據廢污水特性以及處理目的可選擇不同的淨水方法，或者相互搭配使用以達到效率與成本等要求。本課程將說明各種處理技術的核心理論以及計算，使學生未來具有污水處理設計之能力。
Water supply and wastewater treatment engineering is the core course in the civil and environmental engineering. Water supply engineering includes series technologies from water intake to allocate water to citizens. To determine the place to intake water, to transport water, to purify water and to allocate the clean water are the missions of water supply engineers. Wastewater treatment engineering is to treat wastewater to the required concentration standard. The two engineering have different subjects and different goals. However, the water purification and wastewater treatment has the similar methods, which is the core technology in the two engineering and also the core content in this course. The methods about water withdraw and transportation belong to hydraulic engineering and is briefly introduced in this course. The wastewater treatment methods can be divided to physical, chemical, and biological methods. The use of these methods to achieve legal requirement and minimum cost and high efficiency is the mission of engineers. In this course, the theorem of the treatment methods and the associated calculations will be explained, in order to equip the student to capable of designing wastewater treatment.

description.zh: 研究生在第一年必須選定指導教授，以決定設計創作或論文寫作的方向，從事設計創作的研究生必須發展創作理念、創作過程與實作說明，最後彙整創作報告形同於研究論文；從事論文寫作的研究生針對互動媒體設計的相關主題進行研究，並將研究成果撰寫成為論文，其內容包含緒論、文獻探討、研究設計與實施、研究結果與討論、結論與建議等。本課程目的旨在培養獨立企劃研究能力，建構研究設計與研究寫作的能力，對設計創作組而言，過程中培養協同合作的能力是必須具備的要項。
description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and practical work. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

description.zh:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

未來思考與趨勢前瞻，有助於讓每一位同學思索未來社會可能轉變得新趨勢和新的需求。無論同學希望學習或專精的技能為何，如何應用 該技能，提前 選擇一個在未來對社會或個人更可能有所助益的方向練習、實作，不斷繼續前進，才能夠將個人的意義進一步投射至未來的社會價值中；如此一來，未 來社會也將會給給予你應有的報酬。

未來思考的課程，將師承奇點大學客座教授，同時也是美國史丹佛大學設計學院特聘助理教授 Paul Saffo 的 Forecasting 課程，內容將有 - 現況觀察、趨勢分析、未來事件辯論、未來趨勢矩陣圖、前瞻思考經典賞析（包含文章與電影） 等。
description.en:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

Future Studies & Forecasting will be more and more important skill for every young generation students. What will the future look alike? What is the driving forces pushing us from current to the future? How many pace layers of future arrivals?

In this class, we will discuss Stanford consulting prof. Paul Saffo’s Future Studies & Forecasting methods, by – Observing current trends, future event debate, Matrices and Axes of Uncertainty, future mindset developing, etc.

syllabi.outline:
「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo

Future Studies & Forecasting will be more and more important skill for every young generation students. What will the future look alike? What is the driving forces pushing us from current to the future? How many pace layers of future arrivals?
In this class, we will discuss Stanford consulting prof. Paul Saffo’s Future Studies & Forecasting methods, by – Observing current trends, future event debate, Matrices and Axes of Uncertainty, future mindset developing, etc.

Overview
Futures Research is a survey course about the methods and tools that professional futurists use to help people anticipate and influence the future. It is a core course in the Futures Studies program. It covers methods and tools used by forecasters in general as well as by professional futurists. It also covers the techniques that futurists use more than others to forecast the future, particularly creating scenarios of the future, and the techniques used by futurists and consultants alike to help people influence the future, particularly visions, strategic plans, and change management programs.
Objectives

The student will understand and become familiar with: 
•	the framework approach to forecasting
•	critical thinking and other approaches to challenging assumptions
•	leading creativity tools and approaches and how they apply to futures
•	how to develop and evaluate scenarios
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 Introduction 
•	Become familiar with course objectives, expectations, and procedures
•	Become familiar with the learning platform. 
•	Introduce yourself to your classmates. 
•	State of the Art in Strategic Foresight

UNIT 1 FRAMEWORK FORECASTING: (Weeks 2 –5) 

Week 2 Environmental Scanning
•	Understand an approach to environmental scanning
•	Practice that approaches and assess how well each we and others are using it

Week 3 Research
•	Understand the futures forecasting process, including frameworks, monitoring, and scanning 
•	Present futures information in a logical order for forecasting alternative futures using the framework process 

Week 4 Interviews & Questionnaires 
•	List how people find out about other people's information, attitudes, expectations, and preferences for the future. 
•	Understand the differences among those ways, including the advantages and disadvantages of each. 
•	Practice the skills of preparing, administering, analyzing, and drawing inferences from an open-ended interview. 
•	Learn about questionnaire design and construction 
•	Learn about related topics, such as measurement, sampling, and the Delphi survey technique 
•	Practice the skills of preparing, administering, analyzing, and drawing inferences from a structured questionnaire. 

Week 2 Forecasting
•	Understand the nature of forecasting, its assumptions, its utility, and its difficulties

UNIT 2 CHALLENGING ASSUMPTIONS: (Weeks 6 –7) 

Week 6 Causal Layered Analysis
•	Understand and apply the causal layered analysis method
•	Become familiar with the concept of "depth" in futures work

Week 7 Critical Thinking
•	Learn a process for investigating the support for an inference, such as a forecast 
•	Conduct a critical analysis of a forecast in the published literature 
UNIT 3 CREATIVITY: (Weeks 8 –9) 
Week 8  Creativity Approaches
•	Become acquainted with key concepts, terms, and approaches to creativity
Week 9 Creativity Tools
•	Learn a standard approach to creative problem solving
•	Become familiar with a variety of creativity techniques
•	Practice applications of two principal creativity tools
UNIT 4 SCENARIOS: (Weeks 10 –12) 
Week 10  Scenario Theory
•	Become acquainted with key concepts, terms, and criteria of scenarios 

Week 11  Scenario Methods
•	Compare the strengths and weaknesses of various scenario approaches
•	Learn how to analyze and evaluate scenarios

Week 12 Scenario Cases 
•	Acquire an in-depth understanding of a leading practitioners approach to scenarios

UNIT 5 CONCLUSION: (Weeks 13 –15) 
Week 13 Draft Portfolio
•	Prepare draft portfolio for instructor feedback

Week 15 - 18 Final Portfolio
•	Submit the final portfolio

description.zh:
以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。
教學目標為：
1.介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。
2.訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。
3.熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en:
This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.
The objectives are:
1.Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2.Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3.Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

syllabi.outline:
Seeing is a creative process that involves our eyes and mind to transform what we see into what we know, but sometimes the process is reversed—we rely on what we know to interpret what we are seeing. To draw what we see can, therefore, be a process of the interaction of seeing and understanding. The goal of this course will focus on this seeing, thinking, and drawing interaction while drawing architecture on location. This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.

1. Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2. Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3. Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

description.en: This course will use Problem-based Learning (PBL) method to teach the five kernel steps of design thinking including the following: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test. It will also help students in knowing the interdisciplinary innovation methods of interaction design by case studies and real case operation. The main course goals include the following: gain an understanding of the methods and steps of interaction design; explore the methods and operation models for the interdisciplinary innovation of interaction design; and gain the experiences of interaction design by real cases analysis and operation.

syllabi.outline:
Design thinking is a powerful approach to new product development that begins with understanding unmet customer needs. It’s a human-centered design process that approaches problem-solving with understanding the user needs. Design thinking encompasses concept development, applied creativity, prototyping, and experimentation. When design thinking approaches are applied to business, the success rate for innovation has been seen to improve substantially.

Design-driven companies such as Apple, Coca-Cola, IBM, Nike, Procter & Gamble, and Whirlpool have outperformed the S&P 500 over the past 10 years by an accumulated 211% in what's called the Design Value Index—a portfolio of 16 publicly traded companies that integrate design thinking into corporate strategy. According to a 2016 report from the Design Management Institute, this marks the third consecutive year the index has shown an excess of 200% over the S&P 500.

The Design Thinking course will lead participants through a step by step, design thinking process. To be considered successful, innovations have to solve the three key dimensions of Desirability, Feasibility, and Viability.

Desirability: Is this product or service addressing a real customer need?
Feasibility: Can we develop a solution that is technically feasible and better than competitors?
Viability: Is there a viable business model around this product or service?

This course will use Problem-based Learning (PBL) method to teach the five kernel steps of design thinking including the following: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test. It will also help students in knowing the interdisciplinary innovation methods of interaction design by case studies and real case operation. The main course goals include the following: gain an understanding of the methods and steps of interaction design; explore the methods and operation models for the interdisciplinary innovation of interaction design; and gain the experiences of interaction design by real cases analysis and operation.

syllabi.outline:
Data structures play an important role in computer science and can make the program or systems work efficiently in terms of time and space. This course introduces the fundamental structures and some advanced ones, including arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, maps and dictionaries, hash tables, trees and graphs, as well as priority queues. In addition, the analysis tools and design issues for data structures will be discussed.

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生建立足夠的知識與技能在企業研究方法上。課程內容主要分為兩部分， 第一部分將首先介紹論文架構開始，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、資料收集、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in business research methods. The content of the course can be divided by two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, data collection, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin from the introduction of different quantity methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision making tools through lectures, discussion, assignment, term-projects and in class practices. description.zh: 機器學習探討如何能由觀測到的資料中自我學習，自我進化，而能自動增進其處理效能。例如進行預測，特徵擷取，分類，模式辨認，決策，各種訊號處理，甚至建立人工智慧等等。本課程將介紹機器學習的基礎演算法、理論及工具。並讓學生嘗試在各種領域中實際實踐這些技術。課程內容包括：(a) 監督式學習（例如參數和非參數演算法、支持向量機和類神經網路等），(b) 無監督學習（例如群聚、降維和深度學習等）與 (c) 機器學習應用實例（例如語音信號處理，影像訊號處理，音訊訊號處理與自然語言處理，資訊擷取與資料搜尋等）。
description.en: Machine learning studies how to automatically learn from observed data to improve the performance of prediction, information extraction, clustering, pattern recognition, decision making, signal processing and even artificial intelligence. This course will introduce fundamental algorithms, theories and their practical applications. The content will cover (a) supervised learning, such as parametric and non-parametric algorithms, super vector machines and neural networks, (b) unsupervised learning, for example, data clustering, dimension reduction and deep learning and (c) practical applications on speech, image, audio signal and natural language processing or information retrieval and search, etc.

description.zh:
在過去的60年裡，生物醫學工程學科發展已成為明確的，多樣化的，內容無所不包的領域；包括生物電現象、生物信息學、生物材料、生物力學、生物儀器、生物傳感器、生物信號處理等領域，以及生物技術、計算生物學和複雜多樣性、基因組學、醫學影像學、光學和雷射激光、輻射影像、組織工程等。
本課程主要將適用於工程學門學生，且已完成物理、化學或生物學基礎課程為佳。此基礎在大二或大三的學生應該已可做好充分的準備。本課程將學習人體解剖學、生理學、生物物理學和生物醫學工程。整合了一系列知識，以幫助修課同學瞭解生物訊息和醫學儀器，並可以用來監測這些生物醫學現象。課程的學習主要是將這些生物醫學現象，運用其基礎於電力、壓力和流量的物理現象加以說明，並將這些生物醫學現象經由電子及工程的特殊條件和應用系統而呈現。在這種學習中，課程涵蓋了相關醫學和生物學領域、化學、物理、工程的知識和方法，期使將其成功及適當應用於多種生物醫學儀器。本課程將主要研習人體結構（解剖）及其功能系統（生理學），但這些原則同樣也可能適用於其它所有生命系統。
經由醫學背景引導進入此領域，結合工程及材料師長的經驗及參與，將可含括主要生醫工程及組織工程領域的基礎

syllabi.outline:
什麼是人體生物學及生物物理學？
    人體生物學及生物物理學是一門非必修主要課程，旨在探索人體形式和功能之間的基本關係。解剖學和生理學是生命科學中兩個最基本的術語和研究領域。解剖學是指身體的內部和外部結構及其物理關係，而生理學是指研究這些結構的功能。本課程旨在定義瞭解剖學和生理學，並解釋了為什麼它們對生物醫學工程很重要。主要器官系統的解剖學和生理學將在正常和疾病狀態的背景下進行研究。學生將學習關鍵的生物過程，如中心教條，膜擴散和運輸，細胞信號傳導，氣體交換，血流，營養吸收，血液pH平衡以及動作電位的產生和傳播。然後，學生將應用這些知識來瞭解器官如何對維持體內平衡的各種輸入做出反應。課程將納入實踐演示，為課程中提供的資訊提供實用框架:  
1.	根據位置，功能，關鍵成分和解剖命名法確定主要的人體系統。  
2.	展示對代謝功能和每個主要器官系統的生理控制的理解。
3.	認識並綜合體內平衡的原理，即主要器官系統在生理上如何相互關聯以維持人類健康。
在學期階段，學生將廣泛瞭解身體系統如何在細胞，組織和器官系統水平上發揮作用，並能夠將簡單的生理過程聯繫起來，以更好地了解社會中高度流行的疾病和對生物醫學工程重要實用框架。
人體生物學及生物物理學的課程目標：
1.	人體是一個實用的結構，它由四種主要類型的數十億個較小的結構組成：細胞，組織，器官和系統。
2.	器官是幾種不同種類的組織，如此排列，以至於它們可以一起執行特殊功能。
3.	系統是一個由不同數量和種類的器官組成的組織，它們如此排列，以至於它們可以一起為身體執行複雜的功能。
4.	十個主要系統包括骨骼，肌肉，神經，內分泌，心血管，淋巴，呼吸，消化，泌尿和生殖系統。
5.	身體功能是身體系統的生理或心理功能。身體的生存取決於身體維持或恢復其內部環境的體內平衡，這是一種相對恆定的狀態。
6.	人類的生命過程包括組織、新陳代謝、反應性、運動、繁殖、生長、分化、呼吸、消化和排泄。所有這些過程在微調的平衡中協同工作，以維護個人的健康和維持生活。 
7.	生命依賴於環境中的某些物理因素，包括水，氧氣，營養物質，熱量和壓力。
人體生物學及生物物理學課程的學習評估: 基於出勤以及課堂互動，每周提供一個帶回家的研究案例以突出所涵蓋系統的人體解剖學和生理學，每周測驗以及一個期中和期末測驗。  
人體生物學及生物物理學的課程實踐體驗 
如果人體解剖學和生理學的想法看起來很可怕，請不要擔心。本課程將通過以平易近人且相關的格式涵蓋這些主題來減輕您可能有的任何恐懼。本課程將使您對人體所有複雜的功能和系統如何協同工作更加自信，並將您從解剖學和生理學方面學到的知識與您已經瞭解的身體聯繫起來。將此視為人體使用者指南。有些人可能會說你不能沒有它！
本課程還將涵蓋身體的主要系統，並解釋它們是如何工作的，為什麼它們有時不起作用。此外，它還將檢查不同的疾病和紊亂，醫學的最新進展以及照顧身體的方法。課程包括現實生活中的例子和互動練習，讓你批判性地思考自己的經歷，並與課程建立聯繫。在整個課程中都使用全面綜合知識和理解，為您提供必要的學習材料，以便在您繼續接受教育或職業生涯時保留本課程及以後的內容。在本課程結束時，你將對人體的奇妙複雜性有更大的欣賞和理解。

syllabi.outline:
Engineering problems always involve complicated mathematics. Traditionally, solving mathematical equations requires elaborating process of derivation and induction of formula which require students to spend a long time to learn and master the skills and still not every student can achieve the level of expertise to solve these complicated equations. Moreover, many of these equations are not able to solve analytically. With the advance of computing technologies, an ordinary student, when helped by suitable software, can solve those equations which only gifted students could solve before. Not only that, those equations not solvable analytically can be solved today numerically. The purpose of this course is to train undergraduate students to solve engineering problems by using computers. Students will learn not only the theoretical background of numerical methods but also the popular engineering software MATLAB in this class. The choice of MATLAB instead of programming language like FORTRAN, C, or C++ is because MATLAB not only provides an abundant repertoire of programs for solving all kinds of engineering problems but also is a programming language that students use to create his own programs. This will equip students with a powerful tool no matter for higher study or an engineering career in the future. The contents include the following topics.
1.	Introduction to numerical method and MATLAB: give introductory examples, useful background material, identification of some basic issues and an introduction of computation and programming with MATLAB.
2.	Roots of Equations: deals with finding the zeros of a nonlinear function of one variable, as well as methods for minimization of such a function.
3.	Linear Algebra and Matrices: treat topics from numerical linear algebra. Include solving systems of linear equations, factorization of matrices and matrix inversion.
4.	Curve Fitting: deals with finding an equation that fits a set of points by linear least-square and nonlinear regression. Include polynomial regression, multiple linear regression, general linear least-square regression, QR factorization and the backslash operator, and nonlinear regression.
5.	Interpolation: include Newton interpolation, Lagrange interpolation and splines.
6.	Numerical Integration: give the formula for integrating a function that can not be analytically integrated. Include Newton-Cotes formula, the trapezoidal rule, Simpson’s rule, Romberg integration and Gauss quadrature.
7.	Ordinary Differential Equations: many engineering problems are solved in ODE form. This is always the most difficult parts of numerical methods. This chapter gives the technique for solving ODE. Include Euler’s method, Runge-Kutta method, multi-step method. 
8.	Eigenvalues: gives the technique for finding eigenvalues. Include polynomial method and power method.

description.zh: 近年來許多關於人工智慧、網路應用、甚至於嵌入式系統等等的場域皆使用Python來做為開發之程式語言。有鑑於多數的Python開發者皆將Python作為一般的直譯式程式語言，卻沒有善用到Python物件導向之特性，因此本門課將主要以Python物件導向程式撰寫為出發，輔以要求學生開發各類型之應用來熟悉Python物件導向程式之特點，並且教導學生使用各類型之應用函式庫來讓學生更加熟悉Python之特性，期末亦會要求學生利用所學習到之技巧來開發網路前後端程式。
description.en: Recently, many artificial intelligence (AI), network, and embedded system application developers use Python programming language to implement their systems. However, many developers only take Python as a script language instead of using Python’s object oriented characteristics. This class will mainly start from programming Python by the object-oriented way. Students will be required to implement various kinds of assignments to learn the characteristics of Python objects. Besides, students can learn how to apply all kinds of Python application programming interfaces to understand the Python more. In the end of this class, students will be required to develop a network application containing a frond-end client and back-end server to show their achievements.

Object-oriented programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm based on the concept of "objects", which usually defined as “class” in programming language like C++ and Java. In this class we will introduce the basic concepts of OOP, such as object, class, encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Java is the primary language used in the class, but we will also cover OOP in C++. We hope this class will help you understand OOP concepts as well as be ready for developing high-quality software.

syllabi.outline: This course offers a broad introduction to computer programming and object-oriented programming. The major programming language focused will be C++, one of the "big 3" programming languages according to the TIOBE survey in Dec. 2017. We shall also cover essential data structures, e.g., linked list and binary search trees, modern development tools, e.g., Make, Subversion, Git, and unit testing tools, object-oriented programing paradigms, design patterns, and refactoring. How to plan a real-world-level project shall also be discussed. From this course, students can expect to be equipped with essential know-hows for computer programming and object-oriented programming, both of which are indispensable in the foreseeable future.

description.zh: 本課程為線性代數的深化與廣化。以理論的深化而言，本課程由高斯消去法談起，解釋四個向量空間，進而說明矩陣的正交性與投影。接著，本課程闡述行列式、特徵值與特徵向量、矩陣的乘冪與指數、頻譜分解，最終收尾於奇異值分解，以此定理統整這一學期的所有內容。以應用的廣化而言，本課程在上述理論說明之外，還會特別介紹科學、工程的應用實例，例如迴歸分析、線性規劃、圖論與網路、主成份分析。

syllabi.outline: This course is the deepening and broadening of linear algebra. In terms of deepening the theory, this course starts with the Gaussian elimination method, explaining the four vector spaces. Next, it explains the orthogonality and projection of matrices. In addition, this course explains the determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, powers and exponents of matrices, and spectral decomposition, finally concluding with singular value decomposition, which is the theorem that unifies all the contents in this semester. In terms of broadening applications, this course introduces scientific and engineering applications, such as regression analysis, linear programming, graph theory and networks, and principal component analysis.

description.zh:

本課程主要將適用於工程學門學生，且已完成物理、化學或生物學基礎課程為佳。此基礎在大二或大三的學生應該已可做好充分的準備。本課程將學習人體解剖學、生理學、生物物理學和生物醫學工程。整合了一系列知識，以幫助修課同學瞭解生物訊息和醫學儀器，並可以用來監測這些生物醫學現象。課程的學習主要是將這些生物醫學現象，運用其基礎於電力、壓力和流量的物理現象加以說明，並將這些生物醫學現象經由電子及工程的特殊條件和應用系統而呈現。在這種學習中，課程涵蓋了相關醫學和生物學領域、化學、物理、工程的知識和方法，期使將其成功及適當應用於多種生物醫學儀器。本課程將主要研習人體結構（解剖）及其功能系統（生理學），但這些原則同樣也可能適用於其它所有生命系統。

syllabi.outline:
什麼是人體生物學及生物物理學？
    人體生物學及生物物理學是一門非必修主要課程，旨在探索人體形式和功能之間的基本關係。解剖學和生理學是生命科學中兩個最基本的術語和研究領域。解剖學是指身體的內部和外部結構及其物理關係，而生理學是指研究這些結構的功能。本課程旨在定義瞭解剖學和生理學，並解釋了為什麼它們對生物醫學工程很重要。主要器官系統的解剖學和生理學將在正常和疾病狀態的背景下進行研究。學生將學習關鍵的生物過程，如中心教條，膜擴散和運輸，細胞信號傳導，氣體交換，血流，營養吸收，血液pH平衡以及動作電位的產生和傳播。然後，學生將應用這些知識來瞭解器官如何對維持體內平衡的各種輸入做出反應。課程將納入實踐演示，為課程中提供的資訊提供實用框架:  
1.	根據位置，功能，關鍵成分和解剖命名法確定主要的人體系統。  
2.	展示對代謝功能和每個主要器官系統的生理控制的理解。
3.	認識並綜合體內平衡的原理，即主要器官系統在生理上如何相互關聯以維持人類健康。
在學期階段，學生將廣泛瞭解身體系統如何在細胞，組織和器官系統水平上發揮作用，並能夠將簡單的生理過程聯繫起來，以更好地了解社會中高度流行的疾病和對生物醫學工程重要實用框架。
人體生物學及生物物理學的課程目標：
1.	人體是一個實用的結構，它由四種主要類型的數十億個較小的結構組成：細胞，組織，器官和系統。
2.	器官是幾種不同種類的組織，如此排列，以至於它們可以一起執行特殊功能。
3.	系統是一個由不同數量和種類的器官組成的組織，它們如此排列，以至於它們可以一起為身體執行複雜的功能。
4.	十個主要系統包括骨骼，肌肉，神經，內分泌，心血管，淋巴，呼吸，消化，泌尿和生殖系統。
5.	身體功能是身體系統的生理或心理功能。身體的生存取決於身體維持或恢復其內部環境的體內平衡，這是一種相對恆定的狀態。
6.	人類的生命過程包括組織、新陳代謝、反應性、運動、繁殖、生長、分化、呼吸、消化和排泄。所有這些過程在微調的平衡中協同工作，以維護個人的健康和維持生活。 
7.	生命依賴於環境中的某些物理因素，包括水，氧氣，營養物質，熱量和壓力。
人體生物學及生物物理學課程的學習評估: 基於出勤以及課堂互動，每周提供一個帶回家的研究案例以突出所涵蓋系統的人體解剖學和生理學，每周測驗以及一個期中和期末測驗。  
人體生物學及生物物理學的課程實踐體驗 
如果人體解剖學和生理學的想法看起來很可怕，請不要擔心。本課程將通過以平易近人且相關的格式涵蓋這些主題來減輕您可能有的任何恐懼。本課程將使您對人體所有複雜的功能和系統如何協同工作更加自信，並將您從解剖學和生理學方面學到的知識與您已經瞭解的身體聯繫起來。將此視為人體使用者指南。有些人可能會說你不能沒有它！
本課程還將涵蓋身體的主要系統，並解釋它們是如何工作的，為什麼它們有時不起作用。此外，它還將檢查不同的疾病和紊亂，醫學的最新進展以及照顧身體的方法。課程包括現實生活中的例子和互動練習，讓你批判性地思考自己的經歷，並與課程建立聯繫。在整個課程中都使用全面綜合知識和理解，為您提供必要的學習材料，以便在您繼續接受教育或職業生涯時保留本課程及以後的內容。在本課程結束時，你將對人體的奇妙複雜性有更大的欣賞和理解。

name.en: Multimedia Service in Heterogeneous Network Environment

description.zh: 本課程介紹異質多網多媒體的特性與架構，包含：有線及無線網路的內容介紹，以及整合有線及無線網路成為異質網路的概念，其中將針對IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover (MIH)教導學生針對異質網路垂直切換的原理及技術。最後，對於多媒體服務技術及原理做介紹，包含：VoIP服務以及視訊串流服務的介紹，以及如何針對 多種異質網路整合多媒體服務的介紹，藉此提升學生對於新世代異質多網多媒體服務之認識。
description.en: This course introduces the characteristics and architecture of multimedia service in heterogeneous network environment. First, wired and wireless networks, e.g., 3G/3.5G/4G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and other popular wireless access techniques, would be introduced one by one. Then, by describing the theory and technology of IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover (MIH), this course would show how to integrate multiple different networks into heterogeneous network environments and how to handoff among them. Finally, regarding multimedia service, VoIP and video streaming services would be taken into consideration. This course would introduce how to provide multimedia services over heterogeneous network environment. Therefore, students can learn the next-generation techniques about multimedia services in heterogeneous network environment from this course.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹異質多網多媒體的特性與架構，在多媒體部分，介紹多媒體基本組成、編解碼(Codec)原理、串流(Streaming)協定；在網路部分，介紹常用之有線(Ethernet)及無線網路(Wi-Fi、Bluetooth、Cellular/Mobile)，以及針對多媒體設計之網路機制，最後，配合研究所性質，透過論文導讀方式介紹當下視訊串流(Video Streaming)的最新發展，藉此提升學生對於新世代異質多網多媒體服務之認識。

1. 修課學生可從本課程學習多媒體串流(Multimedia Streaming)。
2. 修課學生可從本課程學習異質化網路(Heterogeneous Networks)。
3. 修課學生可從本課程練習相關軟體實作(Software Implementation)技巧。

description.en: This course is concerned with the digital television (DTV) design, which includes Enhanced Definition Television (EDTV), High Definition Television (HDTV), Standard Definition Television (SDTV). Its purpose is to deal with the analysis and design of DTV system, emphasizing fundamentals as well as new paradigms that students need to master in today's industry. The course covers the following topics. 1. Introduction to Video; 2. Color space; 3. Analog video interfaces; 4. Digital Video Interfaces; 5. Digital Video Processing; 6. NTSC, PAL, and SECAM system; 7. H.261 and H.263; 8. MPEG ; 9. Digital Television (DTV).

syllabi.outline:
Engineering problems always involve complicated mathematics. Traditionally, solving mathematical equations requires elaborating process of derivation and induction of formula which require students to spend a long time to learn and master the skills and still not every student can achieve the level of expertise to solve these complicated equations. Moreover, many of these equations are not able to solve analytically. With the advance of computing technologies, an ordinary student, when helped by suitable software, can solve those equations which only gifted students could solve before. Not only that, those equations not solvable analytically can be solved today numerically. The purpose of this course is to train undergraduate students to solve engineering problems by using computers. Students will learn not only the theoretical background of numerical methods but also the popular engineering software MATLAB in this class. The choice of MATLAB instead of programming language like FORTRAN, C, or C++ is because MATLAB not only provides an abundant repertoire of programs for solving all kinds of engineering problems but also is a programming language that students use to create his own programs. This will equip students with a powerful tool no matter for higher study or an engineering career in the future. The contents include the following topics.
1.	Introduction to numerical method and MATLAB: give introductory examples, useful background material, identification of some basic issues and an introduction of computation and programming with MATLAB.
2.	Roots of Equations: deals with finding the zeros of a nonlinear function of one variable, as well as methods for minimization of such a function.
3.	Linear Algebra and Matrices: treat topics from numerical linear algebra. Include solving systems of linear equations, factorization of matrices and matrix inversion.
4.	Curve Fitting: deals with finding an equation that fits a set of points by linear least-square and nonlinear regression. Include polynomial regression, multiple linear regression, general linear least-square regression, QR factorization and the backslash operator, and nonlinear regression.
5.	Interpolation: include Newton interpolation, Lagrange interpolation and splines.
6.	Numerical Integration: give the formula for integrating a function that can not be analytically integrated. Include Newton-Cotes formula, the trapezoidal rule, Simpson’s rule, Romberg integration and Gauss quadrature.
7.	Ordinary Differential Equations: many engineering problems are solved in ODE form. This is always the most difficult parts of numerical methods. This chapter gives the technique for solving ODE. Include Euler’s method, Runge-Kutta method, multi-step method. 
8.	Eigenvalues: gives the technique for finding eigenvalues. Include polynomial method and power method.

本課程旨在講授互動式廣告的形式、影響及其未來可能發展，課程內容包括互動式媒體的特性、社群媒體廣告類型、互動式廣告的創意策略、互動設計科技如何融入互動式廣告，使用者的回饋預設等互動式廣告所需的相關概念。本課程亦將導引同學透過廣告主的策略需求分析，運用多媒體科技與技術，來製作符合行銷目標的互動式廣告並參與競賽。
This course is designed to teach the form and impact of interactive advertising and its possible future development. The course covers the characteristics of interactive media, types of social media advertising, creative strategies for interactive advertising, how interactive design technology is integrated into interactive advertising, user feedback presets, and other related concepts required for interactive advertising. The course will also guide students to analyze the strategic needs of advertisers and use multimedia technology and techniques to create interactive advertisements that meet marketing objectives and participate in competitions.

(2) 睡眠感測元件設計與製作課程模組規劃如下：
睡眠相關概念與其量測方法、可攜帶式睡眠監測硬體設計、演算法設計、睡眠感測後端資料整合系統開發
(3) 無線健康整合服務系統應用於失智老人之照護
RFID 室內安全監控系統、RFID戶外安全監控系統、GPS-GSM戶外安全監控系統、警急救援軟體平台

description.zh: 本課程旨在講授互動式廣告的理論、企劃與製作原理，包括互動式媒體的特性、廣告專案製作之掌握、發揮互動式媒體特性的方法，以及建置、設計、發展、與維護互動式廣告所需的相關概念、科技與技能。本課程透過課堂中關於互動式廣告原理的講授、相關的個案研究以及文獻導讀使學生能具備互動式廣告之企劃與研究分析能力。學生評量方式包含報告繳交以及分組討論與發表。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the theory, planning and techniques of interactive advertisement, which includes the characteristics of interactive media, project management of advertisement, techniques of developing the interactive media, and the way to construct, design, create and maintain the interactive advertisement. The course is preceded by means of lecturing related theory, case studies and literature review to allow students to be capable of interactive advertisement planning and analysis. Students are evaluated by reports, group discussion and presentation.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在講授互動式廣告的形式、影響及其未來可能發展，課程內容包括互動式媒體的特性、社群媒體廣告類型、互動式廣告的創意策略、互動設計科技如何融入互動式廣告，使用者的回饋預設等互動式廣告所需的相關概念。本課程亦將導引同學透過廣告主的策略需求分析，運用多媒體科技與技術，來製作符合行銷目標的互動式廣告並參與競賽。
This course is designed to teach the form and impact of interactive advertising and its possible future development. The course covers the characteristics of interactive media, types of social media advertising, creative strategies for interactive advertising, how interactive design technology is integrated into interactive advertising, user feedback presets, and other related concepts required for interactive advertising. The course will also guide students to analyze the strategic needs of advertisers and use multimedia technology and techniques to create interactive advertisements that meet marketing objectives and participate in competitions.

description.zh:
數位影像科技的硬體快速進步與影像分析演算法普及化，使得電腦視覺與影像量測技術在工程量測、安全監測，與自動辨識具有相當高的潛力。電腦視覺與影像量測結合影像分析、空間原理、測量原理、誤差分析、機器學習，與工程應用等不同領域，是一個多領域整合的應用科目。

本課程訓練學生在電腦視覺與影像量測的基本理論與案例實作的能力。在理論方面，本課程介紹影像原理、空間量測原理、誤差原理、機器學習，以及國內外的發展現況。在實作方面，本課程利用小型結構實驗室，讓同學自行設定小型結構實驗與量測方法，或進而改良或開發分析程式。配合實驗實作與期末專案研究，本課程培養理論認知、資訊技術、實驗實作能力、外語閱讀能力，與簡報與報告編寫熟練度。
description.en:
The rapid development and population of digital imaging hardware and algorithms bring high potential of computer vision and image measurement on practical applications. These applications can include but not limited to measurement, structural health monitoring, and safety identification. 

This course not only introduces the theory of computer vision and image measurement, but also guides students to operate and implement structural experiments and measurement projects. Students are encouraged to bring up the concepts and theories, programming skills, experimental design and implementation, oral presentations, as well as experimental documentation and technical writing ability.

1. Overview. Python installation. OpenCV installation. Tensorflow+Keras installation.
    Hands-on: Basic Python coding and rapid typing
2. Fundamental 2D single/multi-channel array of images. 
    Image file I/O. Color conversion. Geometric transformation. Edge detection.
    Hands-on: a basic picture-in-picture generator. 
3. General data types of images, matrices, and vectors: Row-wise format of matrix/vector. Channels of data. Memory operations in programming.
    Hands-on: an advanced picture-in-picture generator. 
4. Basic vector and matrix operations. Matrix multiplication/inversion. Fourier transform. Normalization. 
    Hands-on: Fourier transform GUI tool
5. Homogeneous coordinate transformation: Rotation. Stretch. Warping.
    Hands-on: Interactive mouse-control photo warping tool
6. Image tracking. Template match. Optical flow. Enhanced correlation. 
    Hands-on: Interactive mouse-control photo warping tool
7. Camera calibration. Intrinsic and extrinsic parameters.
    Hands-on: Calibration of your mobile phone cameras. 
8. Stereo triangulation. Multi-camera 3D positioning. Un-distortion. 
9. Midterm
10. Fundamentals of deep learning, tensors, gradient. 
    Hands-on: a nonlinear regression problem.
11. Convolutional based neural network (I)
    Hands-on: MNIST exercise
12. Pooling, dropout, overfitting/underfitting
    Hands-on: MNIST exercise 
13. Pre-trained models. Segmentation. Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)

15. Final project proposal.

知識管理是二十一世紀知識與學習型企業發展知識經濟最主要的技能，而營建與土木工程是一個需要專業知識的技術型產業，故亦應融入知識管理之理念。

syllabi.outline: The reliability analysis technique is a quantitative analysis tool for evaluating the influence of uncertain factors. Engineer reliability is an important index for evaluating engineering design results. Engineering reliability analysis provides necessary information for risk analyses and risk decisions. To facilitate students' understanding of the theoretical background, techniques, and engineering application of reliability analysis, this course reviews and introduces corresponding probability and statistic theories, reliability analysis techniques, limit state design approach, and risk analysis.

name.en: Biotechnical and Soil Bioengineering Slope Stabilization

description.zh: 生態工法的概念和原則近年來廣泛地引介和應用在各種的土木工程領域中，包括河溪、坡地、都市和交通建設等，而由於土石流和坡地災害的頻繁發生，因此在山坡地應用生態工法遂成為重要的課題，也逐漸成為應該提供給土木系學生，使其瞭解相關基礎知識的重要課程，因此在本導論課程中，我們將介紹如何將生物地工技術和土壤生物工程（Biotechnical and Soil Bioengineering）應用在邊坡穩定和侵蝕控制上，使學生認識並瞭解目前在邊坡保護上結合工程力學分析、植物學知識和實際案例應用的發展，並藉此介紹國內外常用的邊坡穩定工法，以及結合不同傳統擋土設施的可行方式。本課程無先修課程限制，建議研究所和大學部高年級同學選修。
description.en:
The concept and principles of ecological engineering has been widely adopted by various disciplines of traditional civil engineering,including hydraulic engineering, slope stabilization, urban infrastructures, and transportation engineering.  Among them, slope stabilization is a particularly important topic because of the
frequent occurrence of debris flows and landslides in Taiwan, and thus it becomes necessary to provide such a course to familiarize students with this important field.  In this introductory course, we will explain the fundamental concepts of biotechnical and soil bioengineering and how to apply them to the slope stabilization and
erosion control.  An interdisciplinary approach that combines the knowledge and understanding of both mechanical design and vegetation properties will be emphasized.  The results can be integrated with traditional retaining structures to create more economical and eco-friendly slope stabilization systems.  No prerequisite.

syllabi.outline: 由於台灣經常發生土壤沖蝕、水土流失、土石流和地滑等災害，所以邊坡相關問題是一個特別重要的研究領域。在本課程中我們將探討造成邊坡問題的兩個主要原因，即(1)土壤沖蝕和(2)邊坡滑動，並解釋如何使用土壤生物工程(生態工法)的技術來防治或減緩邊坡相關問題，兼顧理論與實務。本課程將以中文授課，不需要先修課程。

description.zh: 工程進度規劃與控制是營建工程進行專案管理時之重要知識與技術，此課程包含ADM 及PDM網圖、要徑分析、PERT分析、趕工計畫、及實獲值分析等理論知識，同時也會結合工程進度控管軟體應用技術。本課程目標意在培養同學具備工程進度規劃與控制觀念知識，並透過專案練習及軟體操作讓同學具備工程進度規劃與控制能力。
description.en: Construction project scheduling and control is necessary and important for effective management of construction projects. The course introduces the major concepts and methods for construction project schedule scheduling and control. The course includes plan and analysis of ADM and PDM networks, analysis of critical paths,, plan for catch-up, introduction of PERT and earned value analysis methods. The course will teach students the major concept and methods of construction project scheduling and control. Furthermore, the course will enhance students abilities and techniques integrated with project practices and project schedule software uses.

description.zh: 水文系統監測主要目的為了解水文過程，其所收集到的水質與水量資料可作為水資源規劃及管理的主要依據。本課程的主要目的為介紹水文系統中所需觀次之項目、監測方法及觀測儀器的原理及使用方法，因此主要的主題包含大氣監測(溫度、濕度、壓力、日照、降水、風速、蒸散、蒸發散)、地表水監測(水位、流速、流量計算、泥沙、率訂曲線)及地下水(土壤濕度、入滲、地下水)。此外，亦將介紹相關的水質監測。
description.en: Hydrological measurements are made to obtain data on hydrological processes. They are essential for the interpretation of quality and quantity data for water resource planning and management. The main topics include: measurement of atmospheric water (temperature, pressure, moisture, precipitation, wind velocity, evaporation, evapotanspiration), measurement of surface water (water stage, flow velocity, discharge computation, sediment, rating curve), and measurement of subsurface water (soil moisture, infiltration, ground water). The water quality monitoring will also introduced in this course.

description.en: The course introduces fuzzy theory and related models to improve the effectiveness of disaster management. The main content includes concepts of logic, fuzzy set, fuzzy relation, fuzzy math, fuzzy logic, calculation principles, and some important performance evaluation methods and application algorithms which are often used with fuzzy theory. The course may help students not only touching the key concepts of fuzzy theory, but also independently doing deeper research in fuzzy, evaluation, and management field.

syllabi.outline:
介紹模糊理論及其於方案評選、績效評估等相關研究方法之應用，並延伸簡介部分機器學習方法。內容包括戴爾菲法、集群分析、層級分析法、理想解趨近法、決策實驗室分析法、Q方法、資料包絡分析、決策樹與隨機森林、倒傳遞類神經網路等。期使學生能對模糊理論的重要觀念及應用技術有更深一層的認識，不僅提昇閱讀相關論文與期刊等文獻之能力，且對研究工作有所助益。
The course introduces fuzzy theory and related applications in program selection, performance evaluation and other related research methods, and introduces some machine learning methods as well. The content includes Delphi method, cluster analysis, AHP, TOPSIS, DEMATEL, Q method, data envelopment analysis, decision tree and random forest, backward transfer neural network, etc. I hope to help students having deeper understandings of the concepts and application techniques of fuzzy theory, and improving not only the ability of reading related papers but also the ability of research.

description.zh: 本課程主要教授大數據分析、機器學習與人工智慧於商業數據分析的理論與實務，在課程內容會包含深度學習的基礎知識，包含Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)等的架構與實作教學。這門課程將包含基礎程式實作，也會在工業4.0、智慧製造、數據資料分析多個實務應用中，藉由上機實作、課堂作業、小組專題、報告與討論各種方式，讓所有學生具備跨足大數據分析、人工智慧、機器學習等所需的資訊技術與應用領域知識。本課程除了學習大數據分析與深度學習理論，另藉由實例應用開發來建構同學們實作的能力。期望能將各種已經成熟的AI科技，應用於管理決策。
description.en: The course is to introduce the theoretical background of big data, machine learning and artificial intelligence in business analysis applications. The class participants should be able to learn the the basic knowledge of deep learning including the framework of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and its practical implementation. The course also contains the programming language teaching, and case study about industrial 4.0, smart manufacturing and open data analysis. Students could learn how to apply the AI technology in decision making.

description.zh:
本課程將由個人資料保護原則開始對個人資料保護作全面性的介紹，並說明《個人資料保護法》與《個人資料保護法施行細則》如何與個資保護原則互相呼應，期使學生瞭解目前個人資料保護的管理議題與實務考量，並且說明可參考的標準與指引，以強化學生對於個人資料保護的基礎概念。
藉由《個人資料保護法》及《個人資料保護法施行細則》的介紹帶入ISO/IEC 29100的個資保護框架、隱私衝擊評鑑(PIA)，接下介紹ISO/IEC 27701個資保護實作指引等相關國際標準，本課程以實際的案例以及國際標準讓學生這對於個人資料保護有更進一步的概念與瞭解。
description.en: This course will begin with a comprehensive introduction to personal data protection principles and explain in detail the "Personal Data Protection Act" and the "Enforcement Rules of the Personal Data Protection Act". Student will learn managerial and practical considerations of personal data protection. Relevant standards and guidelines, such as ISO/IEC 29100, ISO/IEC 27701, will be discussed to strengthen students' understanding of fundamental concepts of personal information management systems (PIMS). In addition, the process of a privacy impact assessment (PIA) and its related standard ISO/IEC 29134 will also be introduced in this course. All in all, this course aims to give students a solid understanding of personal data protection through cases studies and international standards.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將由個人資料保護原則開始對個人資料保護作全面性的介紹，並說明《個人資料保護法》與《個人資料保護法施行細則》如何與個資保護原則互相呼應，期使學生瞭解目前個人資料保護的管理議題與實務考量，並且說明可參考的標準與指引，以強化學生對於個人資料保護的基礎概念。
藉由《個人資料保護法》及《個人資料保護法施行細則》的介紹帶入ISO/IEC 29100的個資保護框架、隱私衝擊評鑑(PIA)，接下介紹ISO/IEC 27701個資保護實作指引等相關國際標準，本課程以實際的案例以及國際標準讓學生這對於個人資料保護有更進一步的概念與瞭解。

description.zh: 教學目標為幫助學生瞭解多國企業所面對的國際財務管理的議題、其理論及實務。內容包括外匯市場、國際套利、外匯衍生性商品、外匯風險暴露管理、境外市場及國際投資組合管理。
description.en: The goal is to help students understand the theory and practice of the international financial management issues faced by multinational corporations. The course includes the following topics: foreign exchange, foreign exchange arbitrage, foreign exchange derivatives, risk exposure management, offshore market, and the international portfolio management.

syllabi.outline:
本課程聚焦多國籍公司財務管理，介紹基礎的國際財務管理理論概念，以及相關財務管理的重要課題。授課內容由基礎的國際金融環境切入，循序漸進討論外匯市場與外匯理論、多國籍企業的財務管理，以及匯率風險管理等主題，同時結合豐富的理論和時事議題探討，希望使修習本課程的學生置身多國籍企業財務經理人的角色，學習運籌帷幄，制定妥善的國際財務管理決策。
The course emphasizes broad concepts and practices, and provides a clear conceptual framework for analyzing key financial decisions in multinational firms. This course intends to introduce theories and concepts about international financial environment, foreign exchange market, multinational financial management, and risk management of exchange rate. Through abundant theories and practical materials, students will understand how to play the role of multinational financial manager, and how to make appropriate decisions of multinational financial management. Topics include international financial markets; foreign exchange rate; the relationships among interest rates, inflation, and foreign exchange rates; management of foreign exchange risk; motives for direct foreign investment; multinational capital budgeting; country risk analysis; capital structure decision; and international cash management.

description.zh: 為因應瞬息萬變的金融投資環境，期許學生具備宏觀的投資管理知識，本課程主要本課程結合資訊工具與軟體運用、以深入淺出方式介紹投資決策之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫、與財金資訊網站的應用。藉由這些資訊工具與技術，將財務投資的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的投資決策。課程內容架構包括：(1) 財務與投資學原理；(2) 資料庫的使用；(3) 財務軟體的操作；(4) 財務與投資個案分析。透過本課程之學習，促使投資人能獲取合理的投資報酬或擊敗大盤，領先各基金之績效，以制訂出正確的長短期投資決策。
description.en: In response to the rapidly changing environment of financial investments, expecting that students have knowledge of macro investment management, this course combines information and software tools to use, the major goal of this course is to help students understanding the basic principles and theories of investments. By mixing explanation and implementation using financial software and database, it can give students the skills to conduct a sophisticated assessment on investment decisions. The major topics include the following: (1) principles of investments, (2) financial database, (3) financial software, and (4) case study in investments. Through the learning of this course, prompting investors to be able to obtain a reasonable return on investment or beat the market, ahead of the performance of each Fund, in order to work out the correct short and long term investment decisions.

Let students master the Solidity programming language, cultivate the ability to develop smart contracts, and use web3j, Ganache and other tools to set up a development and testing environment, and deploy smart contracts.
Combining front-end web pages and practical applications, innovative design or solving industrial problems, and developing DApp implementation solutions.

name.en: Overseas Management Practice and Cross-border Studies

description.zh: 本課程將安排學生組團由學院教授帶領到境外EMBA專班或國外（含中國大陸）大學交流學習，瞭解該國地域性的產業型態與國家經濟政策，另安排到當地企業廠商做實地觀摩與考察。返校後由領隊教授引導主持，進行綜合討論，學生必須在返台灣後一個月內提交心得報告及建議。

They will then conduct the tours of local businesses. Upon returning, a seminar, facilitated by the professors, will be held to exchange views and opinions. Students are required to submit a final report with recommendations within one month after their return to Taiwan.

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生在論文寫作以及企業研究方法上建立足夠的知識與技能。課程內容主要分為兩部分，第一部分將介紹論文架構，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力撰寫論文並了解使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in thesis writing and business research methods. The content of the course can be divided into two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin with the introduction of different quantitative methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussions, assignments, term-projects, and in-class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory, and some basic multivariate

syllabi.schedule:
本課程的目的為協助碩士論文的撰寫，從主體發想、文獻回顧方式到社會科學常用之量化與質性研究方法的資料收集、分析與結果報導與討論，採取漸進式的方法完成論文架構的設計與預期內容規劃。課程設計與規劃較適合企業與商業管理相關論文主題的同學，建議領域包括行銷、廣告、組織行為與心理等。

Topic 1	研究方法課程簡介：如何完成一本碩士論文、碩士學位論文應該要包含哪些內容、（不）適合的論文題目範例等。	

Topic 2	知識論(Epistemology)與方法論(Methodology)、研究假設制定、群體與樣本、概念的操作化定義、變數與資料、資料蒐集方法、資料的解釋與運用。	

Topic 3	量化研究方法1：統計軟體SPSS的功能介紹、量化資料類型與資料整理技巧。	

Topic 4	量化研究方法2：實驗法操作與資料分析方式；共變異數分析、假設檢定。	

Topic 5	量化研究方法3：問卷調查法操作與資料分析方式；相關分析、線性與非線性回歸分析。	

Topic 6	量化研究方法4：中介效果與干擾效果檢定。
	
Topic 7	質性研究方法1：歷史研究法、田野調查研究法。

Topic 8	質性研究方法2：民族誌、內容分析法。	

Topic 9	質性研究方法3：比較研究法、個案研究法。	

Topic 10	質性研究方法4：訪談研究法、焦點團體訪談法。
	
Topic 11	質性研究方法5：動態研究法、烏托邦研究法。
	
Topic 12	期末報告

description.zh: 公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。

name.en: Mindfulness for Leadership and Stress Reduction

description.zh:
現代人工作壓力大，許多上班族都有壓力、失眠、焦慮等問題。醫學也發現，身體許多疾病甚至癌症也都和情緒、壓力有關。
目前，已經證實正念減壓：可以降低壓力與焦慮，疲勞，降低員工的職業倦怠程度和離職率。提升睡眠品質，增強疫系統，提升專注力，提高領導效能，提升大腦功能與創造力，促進幸福感。滿意度，情緒管理能力、創造力、與人際溝通能力，提高工作績效。改善了個人健康、工作與家庭生活！因此，目前歐美和國內的各大企業紛紛引入正念課程，以提高員工和企業績效。
description.en:
There are so many people with the high stress in the workplace. It’s demonstrated that practicing mindfulness can bring improvements in both physical and psychological symptoms as well as positive changes in health, attitudes, and behaviors. 
The advantages of integrating mindfulness in the workplace including:higher brain functioning;reduced work-related stress, anxiety, depression, fatigue, and psychological distress .Improves job performance, greater job satisfaction, and decreasing turnover and burnout.

name.en: Special Topics in Electronic Materials and Devices

description.zh: 本課程探討電子材料性質、固態物理基礎、元件物理等相關內容，強化電子材料與半導體元件技術之關聯性，藉由剖析材料結構與元件電性，深入探討電子元件在實際應用時可能遭遇之材料議題。本課程將介紹多種半導體元件技術應用，內容包括p-n接面、發光二極體與太陽能電池等。
description.en: This course will introduce the material properties, the basics of solid-state physics, and semiconductor devices and physics to provide knowledge of electronic materials and modern semiconductor devices. To assess the material and device issues of electronics for practical use, analysis of the material structure and electrical performance are essential. The content will include various semiconductor device technologies, such as p-n junction, light emitted diodes (LEDs), and solar cells.

syllabi.outline:
This course enables the students know the fundamental concepts in materials science, semiconductor physics/Devices, and modern theory of solids. The introduction of electronic devices and semiconductor processing used in the current semiconductor industry are also included.

syllabi.outline:
人工智慧已在各個領域中影響人類生活，特別是在機器學習與深度學習技術的發展。本課程為人工智慧領域的入門課程，旨在提供學生關於機器學習的基本概念，其中包含了分類以及迴歸類演算法、神經網路和深度學習於電腦視覺的應用。課程亦提供實際人工智慧問題的Python程式給予學生練習。透過理論以及實作的訓練，本課程最終目標則是希望學生能夠將這些人工智慧技術應用在當前的工程以及工業問題中。

Artificial intelligence is now ubiquitous, in particular the machine learning (ML) subfield. This course is an introductory course to illustrate the basic principles of ML, including classification and regression algorithms, neural networks, and deep learning for computer vision, so that the students can apply ML techniques to solve practical engineering and industrial problems.

description.zh: 塑性加工概論、金屬變形機構、冷作加工、鈑金成形理論、塑性加工產品檢驗、塑性加工機械與模具、個案討論。
description.en: Introduction to plastic metal working, Metal forming mechanism and mechanics, Cold working, Sheet metal forming, Product inspection and quality control, Metal forming machines and tools, and Case study.

syllabi.outline:
塑性加工特論涵蓋金屬塑性變形之基礎、塑性力學之基礎、壓軋加工、擠壓加工、鍛造加工、沖壓與壓縮加工、彎曲加工、引伸加工、剪斷加工、抽拉加工，以及因應智慧製造而衍生的整合技術例如搭配伺服沖床與感測器而完成的智慧手機殼快速沖壓、搭配機械手臂上下料的熱鍛汽車活塞桿件以及利用嚴重塑性變形(severe deformation)而得到的高強度超細晶粒的冷擠製航太件，另也說明金屬微成形加工(metal microforming)的發展近況與未來展望等。
Introduction to plastic metal working, Metal forming mechanism and mechanics, Cold working, Sheet metal forming, Product inspection and quality control, Metal forming machines and tools, and Case study.

description.zh: 彈性力學為固體力學的重要分支，研究彈性物體在外力和其他外界因素（包括外力、溫度、電磁場等）作用下產生的變形和內力。彈性力學廣泛應用於建築、機械、化工、航太等工程領域，是學習有限元素法、複合材料力學、破裂力學和疲勞等的基礎課程，對於培養學生的專業基礎，思維方法和獨立工作能力有著重要意義。
description.en: Elasticity is a branch of Solid mechanics that deals with determination of the stress, strain, and displacement distribution in an elastic solid under the influence of external forces. This subject has applications in many engineering and scientific fields such as civil engineering, mechanical engineering, materials engineering, and aeronautical and aerospace engineering. The subject also provides the basis for more advanced work in finite element analysis, mechanics of composite materials, fracture mechanics.

The subject also provides the basis for more advanced work in finite element analysis, mechanics of composite materials, fracture mechanics.

description.zh: 顆粒物質充斥在日常生活且廣泛應用在許多工業問題中，例如筒倉、流體化床以及積層製造等等。本概論式課程將提供學生顆粒物質流的基礎概念以及模擬方法，並對其實際應用問題能有更深入的了解。課程將從顆粒物質的基本流動特性開始介紹，進而介紹顆粒物質流的離散模擬方法。此課程最後一部分將實際展示在工程上以及工業上所遇到的顆粒物質流問題。
description.en: Granular materials are ubiquitous in our daily lives and have attracted growing interest in many industrial applications, such as silo storage, fluidized bed, additive manufacturing, etc. This course is an introductory course to provide the general concepts and simulation methods of granular material flows, and a comprehensive understanding for its applications. The course will start from the basic flow characteristics of granular materials, and then move to the discrete simulation approaches. The final part of this course will demonstrate the practical engineering and industrial problems of granular material flows.

syllabi.outline: Granular material flows are commonly occurred in many industrial applications and nature hazards, such as fluidized bed, additive manufacturing, and debris avalanche. To provide a comprehensive understanding for granular materials flows, this course will be divided into three parts. We start from the basic flow characteristics of granular materials and its rheological models. Then, we will move to the simulation approaches for granular material flows in view of continuum and discrete description. Finally, the two-phase suspension system will be introduced, followed by the demonstration of practical industrial and geophysical applications for these complex flows.

syllabi.outline:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is a research field that studies how to realize the intelligent human behaviors on a computer. The ultimate goal of AI is to make a computer that can learn, plan, and solve problems autonomously. 
The main purpose of this course is to allow students understanding what the AI is, current theories and applications of AI.
The main topics of this course include: 
Uninformed and informed Search Methods
Local Search Methods
Game Playing
Neural Networks
Reasoning under Uncertainty
Artificial Intelligence applications in Engineering.
Artificial Intelligence applications in Management.
syllabi.schedule:
##Week 1-3
Introduction to Artificial Intelligence

Uninformed Search Methods – searching a state space graph, problem representation in terms of states, goal test, operators, state-space graph search formulation, expanding a node, frontier list, partial solution path, solution path, search tree, breadth-first search, depth-first search, chronological backtracking, uniform-cost search, iterative-deepening search, bidirectional search, completeness, optimality, admissibility, time and space complexity, detecting repeated states, explored list. 

Informed Search Methods – Understand heuristic functions, evaluation functions, best-first search, greedy best-first search, beam search, algorithm A, algorithm A*, admissible heuristic. 
(paper discussion and representation of Artificial Intelligence applications in engineering and management)


##Week 4-7
Local Search Methods – Local search problem formulation, operators, neighborhood, move set, hill-climbing algorithm, local optima problem, hill-climbing with random restarts, stochastic hill-climbing (simulated annealing) algorithm, escaping local optima, Boltzman’s equation, cooling schedule, genetic algorithms, particle swarm optimization. 

Game Playing –game playing as search, search tree, branching factor, minimax algorithm, alpha-beta pruning algorithm, best case and worst case of alpha-beta vs. minimax, iterative-deepening with alpha-beta. 
(paper discussion and representation of Artificial Intelligence applications in engineering and management)


##Week 8-9
Mid-term report & presentation


##Week 10-12
Neural Networks –input units, output units, weight space, multi-layer feed-forward networks, hidden units, sigmoid function, back-propagation algorithm, deep learning. 
(paper discussion and representation of Artificial Intelligence applications in engineering and management)


##Week 13-15
Reasoning under Uncertainty – Random variable, conditional probability, posterior probability, product rule, chain rule, Bayes’s rule, conditionalized version of Bayes’s rule, naïve Bayes classifier, Bayesian networks.
Fuzzy set theory, Fuzzy operations, Fuzzy control
(paper discussion and representation of Artificial Intelligence applications in engineering and management)


##Week 16-18
Final project workshop and presentation

description.zh: 本課程探討田口品質工程方法和智慧型參數設定，以提高產品品質和製程性能。各種產品設計和製程參數值需被決定，參數的設定應使其受製造環境的變化所產生的影響減到最小，即為穩健設計。運用本方法可顯著降低製造過程中的缺陷率，並減少生產成本，同時提高產品的品質和可靠性。
description.en: This class delineates Taguchi based quality engineering methods and computational intelligence approaches to improve product quality and process performance. The nominal values of the various dimensions and design parameters need to be determined. The parameters are chosen so as to minimize the effects on performance arising from variation in manufacturing g environment. This is called robustification. The defect rate during manufacturing shows noticeable improvement, the production cost is significantly lower, and the quality and reliability of products can be enhanced.

syllabi.outline: This course addresses Taguchi's quality engineering approach and intelligent parameter design to improve product quality and process performance. Using the method can significantly reduce the defect rate in the manufacturing process, reduce the production cost, and improve the quality and reliability of the product.
