description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在解析創業者在財務領域須具備的觀念與常識，教學內容係依據教師過去在金融業所看過的業界案例、及曾擔任投資公司財務長、與跨國集團投資與信用管理主管之職場經驗所設計。
透過了解企業財務領域之運作，期培養學生在創業時能運用相關的財務基礎觀念與常識，相關財務知識也可做為個人投資理財參酌。

description.zh: 台灣科技發展史將討論二十世紀前半（1900-1950）部份重要技術引入台灣後，造成的影響與社會變遷。依時間先後，先從農業技術的變革-綠色革命。其次研讀有關電力與水利的技術發展，然後進入工業化初期的台灣社會變遷，以及二次大戰期間軍需工業所引導出的初期重化工業。除了這些技術與產業變革之外，也將兼論及技術人物群像與職業教育的開端。
description.en: The main topics for class will discuss the important technology how to influence Taiwan society during 1900-1950. This class includes some important developments: Green revolution -it discuss about agriculture development; the technology development of electricity and water conservancy. In some topic we discuss about Taiwan society change in early days industrialization and chemical industry during world war II. Except those topics, technologists and the beginning of professional education in Taiwan will be introduced.

description.en: The feature of the course is that, through playing music, physical instrument display an demonstration of performances, the students come into contact with the usual musical instruments. Observing the instrument configuration and listening the sound in close distance lead to a true and a new understanding of the relationship between material mechanics and musical sound, and thus trigger and interest in music.

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.outline:
1、課程簡介：民法乃所有法律修習的基礎，但卻也是不好學的一門法律課程。民法除了與每個人的生活息息相關，更是所有法律思維的出發點，是一門理論及實用兼俱的法律。民法的體系龐大，正統法律系學生必需從大一開始修課，一直到大三、大四為止。本課程專為非法律系的同學所開設，期能在一個學期中，將整個民法體系有個全觀及實用的了解。
2、課程目標及授課方式：
讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺整個民法法律的架構內容。
從哲學、科學、歷史學、倫理學、心理學、社會規範等角度來觀察民法面貌。
建立法律學的嚴謹思維。
培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
培養同學面對生活法律問題的了解及解決能力。
法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
上課時雖不會點名同學回答問題，但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論，以期收教學相長之效。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：導論：民法課程基本介紹學習本課程之態度老師學經歷介紹。
第二週：民法之基本觀念：什麼是法律/什麼是民法現代民法的起源—民法的形成與發展民法在整個法律體系中的位置民法的繼受法性質。
第三週：法律的種類：公法與私法普通法及特別法實體法與程序法強行法與任意法固有法與繼受法國內法與國際法。
第四週：民法與其他法律的關係(1)：民法與憲法（大法官會議解釋）民法與刑法民法與行政法/勞基法民法與經濟法民法與智慧財產權法/著作權法。
第五週：民法與其他法律間的關係(2)-案例分享
第六週：普通民法介紹：民法總則債篇總論債篇各論物權篇親屬繼承篇。
第七週：特別民法介紹：土地法勞基法公寓大廈管理條例家庭暴力防治法智慧財產權法。
第八週：民法與民事訴訟法。
第九週：證據法（1）-民法之證據法則與刑法證據法則之不同。
第十週：證據法（2）-實務證據法之運用-證據能力/證明力。
第十一週：期中考。
第十二週：民法總則（1）-現在民法三大原則。
第十三週：民法總則（2）-兼論法律經濟學。
第十四週：債總篇（1）。
第十五週：債總篇（2）
第十六週：債篇各論。
第十七週：物權篇（1）
第十八週：物權篇（2）。
第十九週：親屬篇-結婚、離婚、親子關係。
第二十週：繼承篇-如何寫遺囑。

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

勞動法包括與勞動市場、個別勞動關係及集體勞動關係等方面有關勞工工作權益的法律規範，透過本課程可以學習正確的勞動法律觀念和知識，同時培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，來保障並維護自己或他人的職場權益。
The legal specialty called Labor Law can be define as “the legal regulation of the labor market , individual labor relations and collective employer-employee relations. “labor market” pertains to market in which employers and workers exchange labor . Through this course , students can not only get correct concepts of " Labor Law " , but learn to protect their / others' rights in work place.

description.zh: 人的身體一接觸自然界，便開始各個器官的功能，人不如機器，無法汰換零件，加上身體機能遇到問題之後，許多人往往不知如何處理應對，甚至身體出現徵兆也渾然不知。所以此科目最主要的目的是希望藉由對醫學的認識，讓大學生們更瞭解自己的身體，進而保護並時時自我偵測身體是否正常運作，要培養健全的大學生，而不是只會讀書的大病貓。
description.en: Once the human body contacts the natural environment, the organs of the body begin to function.  But the human body can not change it's organizational like machine.  So when our body's function is in trouble, we always have no idea how to solve it, either to find out.  One of these course's objection is to let college students understanding their own body by learning some important medical concepts.  We hope that our country both has excellent and healthy college students,  and not all sick.

syllabi.outline:
什麼是醫學和生活（健康管理）？
1.影響人們健康實踐變化以及與此類醫學變化相關的知識和態度的過程。 
2.教學過程提供健康的基本知識和實踐，以便被詮釋為正確的健康行為。
醫學和生活（健康管理）課程的目標 
1. 促進健康和預防疾病。
2. 早期診斷和管理。
3. 利用現有的醫學和生活服務。 
醫學和生活（健康管理）課程的內容
1. 個人衛生
2. 正確的健康習慣
3. 營養教育
4. 個人預防措施
5. 安全規則
6. 正確使用醫學和生活服務 
7. 心理健康
8. 性教育
9. 特殊教育(職業，....等)
醫學和生活（健康管理）課程的具體實踐 
1. 使健康成為學生重視的資產。
2. 增加學生對影響健康的因素的瞭解。
3. 鼓勵促進和保持健康的行為。 
4. 爭取對公共衛生措施的支援，並在必要時敦促學生採取適當行動。 
5. 鼓勵學生適當利用衛生服務，特別是預防性服務。 
6. 向學生宣傳醫學進步、用途和局限性。
醫學和生活的學習評估: 
基於出勤以及課堂互動，每周提供一個帶回家的研究案例以突出所涵蓋醫學和生活的內容，每周測驗以及一個期中和期末測驗。  
醫學和生活（健康管理）課程的想法或實踐 - 五個步驟  
1. 意識（知道）
2. 興趣（詳情）
3. 評估（優點與缺點）
4. 審判（實踐）
5. 行動（習慣） 
醫學和生活課程的動機和教育    
1. 意識階段 - 人們意識到醫學和生活新出現的問題，例如「Long COVID,   
   Vaccines…」。它如果被敏感化，那麼他們就會更容易接受健康教育資訊，並  
   圖尋求有關健康問題的更多資訊。  
2. 評估階段 – 在媒體和一切可能的宣傳廣告手段，向公眾提供資訊。接受的
   人會吸收並理解這種疾病的影響。這裡的想法是人們相互討論並變得更加知
   識淵博。
3. 教育階段 - 這是無利害關係和真正教育階段。
4. 態度轉變的階段
5. 動機和行動階段
6. 生活轉型階段（生活變革） 
教師學生課程的溝通障礙 
1. 發送方和接收方之間的社會和文化差距
2. 接收方的接受能力有限
3. 對人或事物的消極態度
4. 理解和記憶力有限
5. 教師強調不足 
6. 矛盾的資訊
7. 教師不確定“學生需求”的健康教育
教師學生課程中行為更改的變數  
    一個人頭腦中的想法和想法對個人的健康行為有重大影響。這些變數與社會和環境因素相互作用，正是所有這些影響之間的協同作用對行為起作用。
1. 知識：對通過視覺、經驗或報告獲得的事實、真理或原則的知覺認識。
2. 技能：從天賦，培訓或實踐中產生做好某事的能力。
3. 信仰：在沒有正面知識或證據的情況下，接受或相信所謂的事實或事實主體  
   是真實的或正確的;一個感知到的真理。
4. 態度：對人或事物的態度，性格，感覺或位置。
5. 價值觀：引起接受或反對它們的意識和情感反應的想法，理想，習俗。

透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

description.zh: 以視覺藝術為探討重點，研究藝術起源以及原始美術、民俗與大眾藝術分野。探究式覺元素和設計原理以及應用媒材、使用技巧，涵蓋素描、水彩、油畫、版畫、混合媒材、雕塑、建築，廣告、包裝、服裝設計、工業產品設計及攝影等。配合幻燈教學，使同學對於視覺藝術有整體性、概括性的認識，以奠定將來從事藝術鑑賞和研究創造之基礎。
description.en: The focus of this course is the exploration of visual arts.  Students will study the origin of art and the distinction among primitive art, folk and popular art. This course also provides students with visual elements, design principles, applied media material, and techniques including charcoal drawing, water-colored painting, oil painting, graphic art, compound material, sculpture, architecture, advertisement, packaging, fashion design, industrial design, and photography. Slide teaching is adopted to give students a comprehensive and general understanding on visual art in order to foster students to appreciate, study, and create art.

syllabi.outline: 課程理念為「美學素養」與藝術史，以奠定技職學生人文涵養為要點，從藝術起源為始，帶領同學領悟西方與東方藝術之美，並探究紙材於藝術創作中扮演的角色。最後探討美學及紙藝，以此累積學生的美學涵養。最終透過實作，以紙為基底，轉化深藏藝術史中「美」的價值。

name.en: The History and Culture of Taiwan

description.zh: 台灣位處東南亞與東北亞島弧的中介點，是亞洲大陸與太平洋的接點，因此，歷來有許多不同族群移居，因而形成多彩多樣的多元價值觀並容兼蓄的文化觀。本課程將論述介紹台灣南島文化、荷西殖民時期的基督教、漢人文化、日本文化和近代文明等在台灣社會產生的影響。
description.en: The island of Taiwan is located in the middle of the island arc of Southeastern and Northeastern Asia. Further, it is the intersection of the Asian continent and the Pacific Ocean. Since many different ethnic groups have migrated in together, a multi-dimensional view of value-colorful in itself has thus been formed. This course will make a first-step introduction and discussion on the impact over the Taiwan society processed by the cultural mix of the Austronesians, the Christianity under the occupation of the Netherlands and Spain, the Hans, the Japanese and the modern civilization.

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.outline:
課程大綱
1、課程簡介：憲法為一個之根本大法，實質的憲法精神更是法治國的體現。憲法一般雖定性為公法，惟其觸角及影響力更深入到每一個法律領域之中，不管是民法、刑法、行政法等領域，均與憲法息息相關，多需要透過憲法之角度來檢視其他法律的正當性與是否合憲性。故憲法之重要性，當然不言而喻。
2、課程目標及授課方式：
讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺憲法於整個法律體系中之定位及地位。
側重近幾年來的重大憲法爭議，將從大法官會議解釋來探討同性婚之違憲與否、通姦除罪化之憲法觀點、罷權等之公民權行使、言論自由與憲法之保障及界線等等，建立法律學的嚴謹思維，培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
上課時雖不會點名同學回答問題，但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論，以期收教學相長之效。
syllabi.schedule:
第一周：導論：憲法課程基本介紹學習本課程之態度老師學經歷介紹。
第二周：憲法之基本觀念：什麼是法律/什麼是憲法憲法在整個法律體系中的位置憲法的繼受法性質。
第三周：憲法發展史國外發展法我國發展史。
第四周：憲法的法律性質公法或私法？憲法普通法及憲法特別法
第四周：憲法與其他法律的關係（1）：憲法與民法（大法官會議解釋）憲法與刑法憲法與行政法/勞基法憲法與經濟法憲法與智慧財產權法/著作權法。
第五周：外國憲法簡介（一）美國憲法
第六周：外國憲法簡介（二）德國憲法
第七周：我國憲法之基本結構（一）概論
第八周：我國憲法的基本結構（二）國體及人民基本權利。
第九周：基本權利（一）生命權、財產權。
第十周：基本權利（二）自由權。
第十一周：期中考。
第十二周：言論自由專論。

name.en: Cross Strait Relations and International Politics

description.zh:
本課程由全球化框架來檢視兩岸關係的演進、現況、及發展趨勢。
由政治、經濟、乃至社會心理層面分析海峽兩岸錯綜複雜的互動關係。
並檢視國際政治經濟體系中，美國與日本兩大國對兩岸關係的影響。
description.en:
This introductory course on the complex cross-strait interactions will examine
Taiwan’s role in the intricate web of international power politics; as well as the structure of hegemonic power rivalry, particularly Sino-US-Japan triangle, and its impact on cross strait relations. The material will cover the evolution, status quo, and developmental path of the cross strait relations in a global framework.

description.zh: 現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
description.en: More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline: 本課程之目的在使同學對於創業財務管理之專業知識產生一概略的認識，期望同學能瞭解資金之運用、籌措及管理之一些觀念及技巧，並做為未來進行相關財務決策或進一步研究財務理論之基礎。本課程會將攸關財務的主題加以介紹,包含：1.財務報表分析2.時間價值，債券與股票3.投資決策與折現分析4.風險、報酬與資金成本5.公司融資政策6.資本結構與股利政策7.財務規畫8.合併與購併。

name.zh: 創業之品牌管理與行銷
name.en: The Brand Management and Marketing of Entrepreneurship

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，同時須考慮新創事業之品牌建構，如果能在創業之初建構一個定位明確的品牌，可使新創事業立即享有良好的品牌權益，提高創業成功的機會。品牌建構完成後，須設計行銷方案，對消費者進行行銷活動，向消費者推銷新創公司之品牌，以塑造良好的品牌權益。此時，消費者對新創公司之品牌會有良好形象之認知，進而提升顧客對新創公司品牌忠誠度，增加創業者創業成功之機會。
description.en:
When entrepreneurs are building a startup company, they also need to consider its brand building. If they can construct a clear positioning of the brand in the beginning, they are able to have their new business with a better brand equity immediately, and improve entrepreneurial chances of success.
After the completion of construction of the brand, entrepreneurs need to design marketing programs for consumer marketing activities, and promote its brand to create good brand equity. In the meantime, consumers will have a better brand awareness of these new companies, enhancing customer loyalty and increasing opportunities for entrepreneurs’ entrepreneurial success.

description.zh: 本課程將透過性別相關之電影和紀錄片進行媒體融入教學，引領學生認識影片中的性別意涵，進而開啟性別視野、培養性別意識和探討多元性別與社會意義之能力，並將邀請國內導演至課堂，闡述其創作歷程並與學生進行映後座談，進而激發北科學子對台灣社會性別議題的討論、性平三法內涵的認識，並提升性別敏感度與多元文化素養。
description.en: This course is aimed at leading students to understand the gender implication by watching gender-related films and documentaries, thereby opening up their gender perspectives, fostering gender awareness and raising the ability of exploring gender diversity and social significance. In addition, domestic film directors will be invited to explain and share with the students about their thinking and making process after film screening. It is expected that this course can inspire students’ discussion of gender issues in Taiwan society and raise their gender sensitivity and multiculturalism literacy.

name.en: Start to APP Design and Application

description.zh:
學習相似於Microsoft Power Point 的「拖-拉-點-選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 !
本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP的邏輯流程與UI(使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的APP!
課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:
「由經入史」:先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。
嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的Homework(實作型作業)。
經此系統化訓練，在APP的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。
「讓不懂IT(資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

syllabi.outline:
This is a history course of western classical music, of which the definition, according to The New Harvard Dictionary of Music and The Oxford Dictionary, is "art music” or "serious music", that written in a Western musical tradition, using an established form. "Classical music is generally considered to be serious and to have a lasting value.”
The styles of various periods will be introduced, from the Medieval, Renaissance, Classical, Romantic, to the Contemporary eras. The goal of this course is helping students to equip a general comprehension of Classical Music in terms of basic elements of musical art, technical theory, historical, social and cultural background extends to related arts and humanities. 

In order to pursue the most accurate references and info, the major key-points and terminology used in this course will be in English or original European text.

音樂欣賞為西洋藝術音樂史，即古典音樂歷史的課程。根據「新哈佛音樂辭典」 ( New Harvard Dictionary of Music) 與 「牛津字典」 的詮釋，所謂古典音樂為「嚴肅藝術」音樂，以嚴謹成型的作曲公式創作音樂，經過歷史洗練的時間藝術。透過此課程學生對西洋古典音樂會有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及社會人文背景，從音樂美感構成與相關人文藝術和文化歷史的議題作連結。
syllabi.schedule:
1. 古希臘藝術與人文, 信仰: 古歐洲在基督教傳入前的文化, 音樂, 文學, 戲劇, 跟人文背景	
1st week: Introduction to Western Art Music—Greek origin as the foremost culture before Christianity entered Europe

2. 從基督教傳入, 到中世紀: 古歐洲承襲希臘時代以來的傳承, 展現於壁畫, 以及基督教傳入歐洲後對文化及藝術的影響; 音樂記譜方式, 表演方式,天主教會對社會的影響; 拜占庭建築到哥德式大教堂, 中世紀歐洲社會與歷史
2nd week: The Medieval Period--folk music, church music in relation to arts and culture

3. 中世紀到文藝復興音樂的演變(舞蹈與民謠): 庶民文化與音樂
3rd week: From Medieval to Renaissance period--Madrigals, church music, dance music.

4. 文藝復興時期: 宗教音樂由單一旋律演化為複音音樂, 作曲家 雕塑家. 畫家介紹. 以義大利為首的時代. 此時期受歡迎的樂器介紹; 源於德, 法, 蘇格蘭宗教改革與英國王室的關聯
4th week: Renaissance period--from Monophony to Polyphony; Introduction to Italian composers, artists, and some of the most popular musical instruments; the Reformed Church and Martin Luther that not only changed the society and belief system but also aethesticism in arts. 

5. 巴洛克時期: 法國巴洛克--英國巴洛克與法國巴洛克比較, 王室音樂跟庶民音樂介紹; 法王路易十四世與凡爾賽宮
5th week: Baroque--Louis XIV and his influence on French music,in comparison to English Baroque

6. 巴洛克時期:	義大利式協奏曲介紹; 巴洛克時代小型管弦曲; 宗教信仰不同形成南歐與北歐教堂建築文化迴異
6th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends--Corelli, Lully and Couperin, Introduction to Concerto Grosso

7. 巴洛克時期:	基本舞曲, 組曲形式--宮廷舞步與巴洛克芭蕾
7th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends continues--Vivaldi, Scarlatti, and Rameau--Court Dance and French Ballet

8. 巴洛克時期: 德意志巴洛克--韓德爾, 泰雷曼, 巴赫
8th week: Baroque--Comparison among Handel, Telemann, and J.S.Bach

9. 巴洛克時期: 深度探討巴赫生平與作品
9th week: Baroque--J.S. Bach in-depth--his string works, orchestral music, choral music, keyboard music, and Fugues.

10. 	期中報告	
10th week: Midterm Report

11. 古典時期: 啟蒙時代崛起, 腓特烈二世 (普魯士) 對德意志音樂藝術的影響. 波次坦忘憂宮介紹; 盧梭之民約論, 丹麥王室實現其理念; 俄羅斯凱撒琳大帝對藝術的貢獻—聖彼得堡冬宮博物館介紹
11th week: Classical period (Classicism)--The Age of Enlightenment--Frederick the Great as a passionate patron of music and art; Danish royal house contributing Jean-Jacques Rousseau's ideology in Denmark; Catherine the Great and The Hermitage

12. 古典時期: 德奧樂派 (第一代維也納樂派); 葛路克與哈布斯堡家族及其小公主,後來為法國波旁王朝最後的皇后瑪麗．安東尼; 海頓, 莫札特, 貝多芬(前期)
12th week: The First Viennese School; Gluck and Habsburg family; Marie Antoinette

13. 浪漫派時期: 從貝多芬中期開啟德奧浪漫派
13th week: Romantic period--Beethoven and the beginning of Romantic era; how Schubert was influenced by Beethoven 

14. 浪漫派時期: 法國, 北歐, 波西米亞--區域性的不同風格
14th week: The pinnacle of Romantic era--Chopin, Schumann, Brahms, Liszt, Tchaikovsky, to the late Romantic period

15. 浪漫派時期: 國民樂派, 俄羅斯音樂與十九世紀俄國芭蕾
15th week: A counterpart of Romantic style with Naionalism--Music by Bohemian and Russian composers; 19th Century Russian ballet and music

16. 二十世紀現代樂派: 法國印象樂派, 第二代維也納樂派; 法國印象畫派與樂派的相輔相成; 包浩斯學院, Art Deco (裝飾風藝術) Art Nouveau (新藝術運動) 介紹
16th week: Impressionist Music, The Second Viennese School and related art styles in the period
後現代主義: 音樂學界的實驗性音樂;	Phillip Glass獨創的極簡樂風; 電腦與傳統樂器結合
The Contemporary Music--from Twelve- tone music (The 2nd Viennese School) to Existentialism, music of Minimalism, and experimental music.

17	期末考
17th week: Final Exam.

指標對應授課內容: 科學家經過十幾年的研究發現，古典音樂是治癒身體與精神創痛的良藥，可提升心智。

description.zh:
法學概論，顧名思義是在介紹法律原理，以啟發學生法學研究的興趣。然而，法學涵蓋的層面甚廣，法學緒論的課程，只能大略介紹各種法律的共通原理，就繁駁的法律現象，作綜合的引說，俾使初學法律的人，不僅能粗知「實定法」的共通原則，還可藉此原則來培養法律見解和修養，執簡馭繁，因而體會法律的性質、內涵和理念。
有關本課程的教授方式，擬先介紹法律的基概念及原理，並以答問之方式訓練學生邏輯反思的能力，同時輔以日常屢見之法律實例問題。如此，學生不僅可以可以學習正確的法律觀念和知識，並可培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，以達保障並維護自己及他人權益之目的。
description.en: Introduction of Law is to introduce the theory of law and to promote students' interest to study law. Since the field of law is very broad but the time is limited, this course can briefly explain common principles of law, complex phenomena of law, etc. The main purpose of this course is to let students catch the concept of common principles of "lex scripta."  Also, this course aims to promote students' knowledge about law, thus cultivating their spirit of abiding by law.  This course will introduce the basic concept and theory of law first. Then students will be given logical training through discussion.  Besides, the general cases and problems of law will be covered as well. Through this course, students can not only get correct concepts of law, but learn to protect their/others' right.

syllabi.outline: Law is the rules for social life. Focusing on real-world cases, the course of Law and Social Life aims to help non-law students have a clear view of the Taiwanese legal system. Also, this course aims to help the students comply with the law and understand the ways in which they can secure their rights. Professors teaching this course make use of a series of judgments to make students be familiar with the legal rules. This course covers the fundamental concepts and knowledge of a number of law subjects, ranging from civil code, criminal code, administrative law, and business law to intellectual property law and procedural law.
syllabi.schedule:
Introduction to Law provides an overview of the law and the legal system.  This course covers 
1-3 weeks . Concept of law (concept of criminal)
4-5 weeks  Global law/ legal system  (ciminal justice)
6 week     . Introduction to Taiwan legal system
7-8 weeks  Selected Specific topical laws (international law, labor law, trading law, taxation law and human right law, etc.)
9 week guiding students to prepare the presentations presented after midterm exam
10-18 weeks. each student has to prepare a presentation to introduce to the legal system of the country he or she comes from.

class performance 40%
presentation 60%

description.zh: 本課程講授工業電子相關之原理，包含:1.基本元件簡介、2.電晶體開關裝置及其應用、 3.電子元件及其應用、 4. SCR 與TRIAC、 5.感測器原理與應用。本課程並包含下列實習單元:R-L-C 元件, 諧振電路, 濾波電路與變壓器, 零件運用與電路檢修, 感測器應用。

description.zh: 本課程介紹電磁之基本原理及定律，並講解各種電機、變壓器之特性、理論、及控制方法，透過實習課程使同學明瞭機器驅動所用之動力其電功與機械功之轉換原理與控制進而可自行操作及維護。

description.zh: 商用冷凍系統電路元件介紹、商用冷凍冷藏設備電路裝配、冷媒管路系統裝配、故障判斷及排除。
description.en: Introduction of electric circuits of commercial refrigeration systems, electric circuit of commercial refrigeration facilities, installation of refrigerant piping system and trouble shooting.

description.zh: 箱型空調機電路裝配、冷卻水管路施工安裝、冷媒管路系統裝配、故障判斷及排除、冷媒更換。恆溫恆濕空調系統控制電路配線、中央空調系統試陣調整、水量與風量平衡調整、TAB操作。
description.en: Electric circuit of air handler, installation of coolant piping, installation of coolant pipe system, trouble shooting, refrigerant replacement, constant electric circuit of air-conditioner control for constant temperature and humidity, test and balance of central units, test and balance of water and air flow.

description.zh:
本課程介紹如何使用python來分析目前因為web2.0盛行後的商業資料大數據。
數據資料種類分為結構化資料，與非結構化資料等2種。
課程將使用python來進行各種商業數據範例的分析探討。
數據來源包括上述的各種結構化資料，與非結構化資料，包括網頁資料的數據爬取。
根據數據的特性，再選擇上述的四種數據分析模組，來進行數據解析。
最後將分析結果做視覺化顯示，並將分析後的數據回存原始資料檔案。
description.en:
This course introduces how to use python to analyze the big data of commercial data after the prevalence of web2.0. There are two types of data: structured data and unstructured data.
The course will use python to analyze and discuss various business data paradigms. Data sources include the above-mentioned various structured data and unstructured data, including data crawling of web data. According to the characteristics of the data, select the above four data analysis modules to analyze the data. Finally, the analysis results are displayed visually, and the analyzed data is returned to the original data file.

syllabi.schedule:
第1週：chp1.課程簡介，與安裝使用python，python基礎
第2週：Pandas基礎入門練習
第3週：Pandas一維資料結構：Series
第4週：Pandas二維資料結構：DataFrame，DataFrame的5個屬性
第5週：查缺值NAN，DataFrame取值，三種格式，新增一欄/一列
第6週：用軸axis來輔助函數計算(mean,sum,max,min)，
第7週：篩選資料2種方法(條件查詢，query)，DataFrame的3種合併：concat，append，merge
第8週：DataFrame的常用函數，chp6-11.函數處理日期資料型態
第9週：期中考
第10週：map,applymap,apply迴圈函數計算每個資料格,輸出到excel，建立sheet
第11週：分群分析groupby，建立交叉分析表/樞紐分析表
第12週：二層列索引鍵，跨層級的資料索引
第13週：商業數據五大分析型態
第14週：各種資料清理方法：字串處理，正規表達式，日期處理
第15週：各種資料清理方法：電話處理，Email處理，分割字串
第16週：實例：系所生源分析
第17週：實例：業務銷售分析
第18週：期末考

作業（大多參考自課本範例）

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh: 近代以降，由於戰爭的影響，臺灣歷經不同的政權和政體，諸如大清帝國、日本帝國及中華民國等。國際局勢、殖民統治、捍衛國土等緣由引發各式各樣的戰爭，戰爭促進臺灣的政治、社會、經濟、文化等層面的變革。因此以戰爭為主軸，認知臺灣在世界地緣位置的重要性，及其引起的各種戰爭類型，呈現戰爭在近現代臺灣各時期的各種風貌。臺灣是個位於西太平洋海陸交接地區的島嶼，在世界局勢變動的潮流之中，塑造其特有的戰爭型式及內涵。再者，臺灣各地有諸多戰爭遺址，不乏國定古蹟，可以藉由戰爭史的脈絡得知戰爭遺址的歷史空間及其文化資產的重要性。
description.en: Since modern times, due to the influence of wars, Taiwan has experienced different regimes and political systems, such as the Qing Empire, the Japanese Empire, and the Republic of China. The international situation, colonial rule, and defense of the country have triggered various wars. Wars have promoted changes in Taiwan’s politics, society, economy, and culture. Therefore, taking war as the main core, understanding the importance of Taiwan's geopolitics in the world, and the types of wars it caused, presents the various features of wars. Taiwan is an island located in the land-sea junction of the Western Pacific Ocean. In the changing tide of the world situation, Taiwan has shaped its unique war style and connotation. Furthermore, there are many military relics throughout Taiwan, and there are many national historical sites. Students can learn about the historical space of military relics and the importance of their cultural assets through the context of war history.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生成為具有深度文化視覺的科技人。從認識本土文化為起點，進而認識世界文化。引導學生如何探究文化現象，並且深入文化的精神境界，物質境界，瞭解文化價值與文化傳統，讓文化觀點充分融入個人的思維內涵。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to develop the cultural cultivation of our technology majored students. Starting with the culture of our own land and extending to world-wide culture. The teachers would guide the students to explore the phenomena of the culture, and try to find out both the spirit and the material of the culture. Through the understanding of the worth and the tradition of the culture, the students might merge the cultural cultivation into their personal thinking.

name.en: Information and Communication Technologies for Industrial Engineering

description.zh: 智慧手機、智慧車、智慧家電、智慧電網、智慧化控制系統等，一場科技革命正熱鬧展開。看似單一產品的創新，背後其實有著更大的驅動力，那就是當行動通訊與網際網路結合後，催生出來的Mobile Internet新領域，所有資料都上網、所有物品都連網、所有人都掛網，個人到企業都必須做好準備，因此，當企業在邁向資訊化與自動化的同時，工業工程系責無旁貸的需將行動運算納入考量。本課程的目標在幫助學生瞭解雲端運算在工廠上的應用，學習建構所謂服務導向的企業，以及提供進階之程式開發知識，與跨入3G最新手機開發平台，培養未來開發手機程式設計之技術實力，使學生具備獨立開發手機應用程式的能力。
description.en: This is an introduction course of mobile computing. The course is designed principally to provide the Followings topics: 1. fundamentals of mobile technology; and applications, 2. Location-based service 3. Could-based computing 4. Mobile applications; 5. Mobile programming

description.zh: 課程以培養泰語溝通能力、激發學習泰語興趣，以及跨文化理解為宗旨。課程架構包括泰國語言教學及元化議題討論，使其在具備泰語溝通實力之外，更能對泰國各方面情勢與文化、思想、禮節、風俗習慣、宗教禁忌等，都具有深度認識。
description.en: This course aims to help students build the foundation of speaking Thai, and arouse students’ interests in learning Thai. Also, it helps students get to know cross-cultural differences. In addition to learning Thai, students have to discuss the issues related to Thai culture. Accordingly, students are not only able to make conversations, but have further understanding of Thai culture, thinking, manners, customs and religious taboos etc.

description.zh: 本課程著重冷凍系統和空調系統能源的分析，探討構成系統的主要元件－壓縮機、蒸發器和冷凝器的耗能，和各泵、冰水盤管、空調箱及風／水管路系統的能源耗損，進而對整個系統運轉時的效率予以檢討。最後提出各種改善方法，節約能源和減少電力契約容量的技術，以使學生具有節能省電的正確理論觀念和實務技術。
description.en:
This lesson is focused on the energy analyses of refrigeration systems and air-conditioning systems. The operating defects of compressors, evaporators and
condensers are to be investigated. Also the energy consumption's of pumps, fan coils air-handling units and duct/water systems are studied. The over all performance of the entire system is thus discussed. Several methods to improve the shortages and the techniques to energy conservation and electricity demand cut-down will be proposed.
The students should understand correctly the theory of energy conservation and the
technology to improve the systems.

description.zh:
本課程使學生對燃料電池的基本原理、關鍵技術、以及商品化發展與應用過程，有所瞭解並加以分析及探討。
燃料電池是一種電化學的發電裝置，其運作原理係利用電化學反應將燃料內之化學能直接轉換為電能，因其在能量轉換過程中並不經過熱機過程，因此能量轉換效率較高。本課程之授課綱要可分為以下幾項：
燃料電池簡介、燃料電池之效率、質子交換膜燃料電池、磷酸燃料電池、鹼性燃料電池、直接甲醇燃料電池、固態氧化物燃料電池、燃料電池的燃料供應、燃料電池之計算實例。
description.en:
This course enables students to fully understand the basic principles of the fuel cell, key technologies, and the commercialization of the development and the application process, and to analyze and discuss the design of fuel cell system.
Fuel cell is an electrochemical power generating device. It can directly convert the chemical energy of fuel into the electrical energy via the electrochemical reaction. Because it does not go through the process of thermal engine in the energy conversion process, and therefore a higher energy conversion efficiency. Teaching outlines of the course can be divided into the followings:
Introduction to fuel cell, Fuel cell efficiency, Proton exchange membrane fuel cell, Phosphoric acid fuel cell, Alkaline fuel cell, Direct methanol fuel cell, Solid oxide fuel cell, Fueling fuel cell, Calculation example of fuel cell.

Teaching outlines of the course can be divided into the followings:
Introduction to fuel cell, Fuel cell efficiency, Proton exchange membrane fuel cell, Phosphoric acid fuel cell, Alkaline fuel cell, Direct methanol fuel cell, Solid oxide fuel cell, Fueling fuel cell, Calculation example of fuel cell.

description.zh: 培養學生主動發現問題，或由企業所提出的問題，訓練學生思考如何運用專業知識與技能解決實驗問題。目前針對電子陶瓷相關的產業，對於具有產品的陶瓷製程與性質改良法的專業知識人才，急迫需要，故利用企業命題的問題導向課程方式，訓練學生具有解決產業實際問題與需求的能力。

description.zh: 本課程引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。
description.en: This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. Essential topics include communication, techniques of negotiation and presentation, applied reading and writing, strategies for developing listening skills and language learning across cultures.

description.en:
Course Description：
    This course provide a platform to generate between student and creativity. It could students to build the temperament of human arts, and experience practical process of cultural life creativity. Through the invitation of the cultural life creative expert in production, official, education to have a speech. By the way of sharing and passing down, it could stimulate the learning creative develop possibility of students in their daily life, and develop the potential of creativity.

想加選的同學，請出席第一節課，如果還有名額，則以線上加選順序遞補。

暫定課程內容：
2/22 課 程 說 明
3/01 林啟瑞校長：成功的關鍵要素:健康、經驗、專業與智慧
3/08 蘇華院：數位語言產業新創之路
3/15 曾志朗部長：新雙腦說：問世間，智為何物？
3/22 運動會(停課)
3/29 蘇瑞琴：影視翻譯面面觀
4/05 清明節放假
4/12 謝承諭助理研究員：學術英語力大補帖：出國留學、上EMI課必備的學習資源與讀書技巧
4/19 期 中 考 試
4/26 汪世旭董事長：擁抱運動 遇見更好的自已
5/03 廖益宏主任：增肌減脂的實務策略
5/10 洪聰敏講座教授：運動與大腦
5/17 陳迪(網球職業選手)：職業運動員的人生挑戰
5/24 陳宗與教授：運動表現-水分補充的重要性
5/31 吳牧恩主任：數學世界的好野人
6/07 吳柏翰處長：運動的過去、現在與未來
6/14 期 末 考 試
6/21 繳交問卷心得報告
END
syllabi.assessment:
出缺席  40%
期中測驗  30%
期末測驗  30%
END

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

description.zh:
本課程介紹如何使用python來分析目前因為web2.0盛行後的商業資料大數據。
數據資料種類分為結構化資料，與非結構化資料等2種。

最後將分析結果做視覺化顯示，並將分析後的數據回存原始資料檔案。
description.en:
This course introduces how to use python to analyze the big data of commercial data after the prevalence of web2.0. There are two types of data: structured data and unstructured data.
The course will use python to analyze and discuss various business data paradigms. Data sources include the above-mentioned various structured data and unstructured data, including data crawling of web data. According to the characteristics of the data, select the above four data analysis modules to analyze the data. Finally, the analysis results are displayed visually, and the analyzed data is returned to the original data file.

name.zh: 物件導向程式設計與資料庫應用

description.zh:
物件導向程式設計以類別與物件為核心概念，輔以靜態的屬性及動態的方法，能夠直覺並且系統化地描述真實世界的事物，再輔以封裝、繼承、多型、介面等機制，能夠有效率地達到程式碼的共享及再利用，因此物件導向程式設計的功能不但被各式各樣的程式語言所廣泛支援，亦已形成了一門獨立的學問。

而資料庫是重要、普遍且實用的資訊管理核心技術。但在另一方面，資料庫的開發與實作過程對於理解物件導向程式設計更是一個良好的契機與範例。本課程將以土木營建領域的範例出發，教導修課同學開發輔助工程資訊管理之資料庫系統，並在資料的分析處理及使用者介面的實作上導入物件導向程式設計的概念。
description.en:
Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm based on the concept of class and objects. With properties and methods that can describe the features of classes, a programmer can model the real world objects in an systematical way. In addition, the three important mechanisms of OOP, which are encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism, also enable a programmer to reuse and share their code easily and efficiently. 

Base on the Architecture/Engineering/Construction applications, this course aims to train the enrolled student for developing the basic OOP concepts, analyzing the database schemas, as well as implementing the OOP skills on information systems developments.

description.zh:
為使土木營建背景的學生具備跨域學習與創用能力，本課程扣合當前重要時趨(如SDGs, ESG, LCA, USR等)於民生基礎建設之因應；擇採相關物聯網數位科技作為課程編排，介紹內容如無線感測、低工耗遠域網路邊緣運算、雲端管理、數位平台、綠能蓄電、人工智能、低/無代碼等專案開發的理與例，以符綠智營建之踐履，以臻永續經管之倡議。

description.en:
To achieve interdisciplinary learning and Innovative creativity for civil engineering students, this course presents the Internet of Things (IoT) to social infrastructure development including green-intelligent construction/maintenance and resilient adaptation briefly. To aim at the initiate of sustainable development goals (such as SDGs, ESG, LCA, USR) applied to civil engineering, some vital issues in this course would be focused as follows,
WSN (Wireless Network), LPWAN (Low Power Wide-Area Network),
Edge Computing, e-Cloud Management, Digitized Platform (PaaS/IaaS/SaaS), Green Energy and Cell, Artificial Intelligences, Low- & No-code techniques, etc.
Meanwhile, Systems Thinking (ST) and Problem-based Learning (PBL) , which are crucial for philosophy of science, would be introduced for this holistic approach.

name.zh: 資訊檢索與人工智慧應用

description.zh:
資訊檢索（Information Retrieval）是搜尋引擎背後的技術基礎，以給定的查詢詞彙找出帶有相關資訊的文件，能夠處理與比較未結構化或半結構化的文字資料。在人工智慧與機器學習技術飛越成長的當代，自然語言處理（Natural Language Processing）及文本探勘（Text Mining）輔助人們在散亂的文本當中發掘有意義的資訊。傳統的資訊檢索理論在文本探勘的任務當中則扮演了重要的輔助角色，其賦與將文件以向量表達的基礎，亦即使諸多人工智慧應用能夠順利的與文本探勘任務接軌。

本課程將教導修課同學資訊檢索、自然語言處理與資料探勘的理論基礎，以及各種新穎的人工智慧與機器學習應用如何取代傳統方法。並且訓練修課同學使用現成的程式語言套件來分析自己手邊的文本資料。
description.en:
Information Retrieval (IR) is the process that retrieves the information which is relevant to a specific information need from a data collection. Search engine systems provides a famous example of IR applications. In recent years, with the growth of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing (NLP), many of the AI applications can help discover useful information in unstructured or semi-structured text collections, such a process is called Text Mining. The traditional IR technique also play an important role to support the AI applications. It can vectorize the texts and make it possible to compare the similarities between different pieces of text.

This course aims to train the enrolled students to learn the basic concept of IR, NLP, and AI applications which are relevant to Text Mining tasks. In addition, this course also trains the enrolled students to use existing tools and software packages which can support the AI applications.

The traditional IR technique also play an important role to support the AI applications. It can vectorize the texts and make it possible to compare the similarities between different pieces of text.

This course aims to train the enrolled students to learn the basic concept of IR, NLP, and AI applications which are relevant to Text Mining tasks. In addition, this course also trains the enrolled students to use existing tools and software packages which can support the AI applications.

description.zh: 建築資訊塑模（Building Information Modeling, BIM）在臺灣近年的營建產業蓬勃發展，已逐漸取代傳統的3D繪圖方式而成為土木建築領域的顯學。其能進行2D圖面出圖、3D展示，並且可透過客製化的API程式進行各種應用諸如數量計算、衝突檢測及施工模擬，使協同作業能夠充份的發揮效率，以提升工程的施工品質、效率與安全，減少設計錯誤，並降低施工成本。本課程透過課堂講授與案例實作，讓學生理解BIM技術的發展與應用潛力，並能熟習Autodesk Revit軟體之基礎操作，實際應用BIM技術於工程案例當中。
description.en: Building Information Modeling (BIM) is an innovative process in Architecture/Engineering/Construction industry. It can integrate various   information into a 3D model. With such a characteristic, to compare with a traditional 3D model, a BIM model can achieve more possible applications, such as quantity takeoff, clash detection, and 4D simulation. In addition, the characteristic of BIM also enables parametric modeling, which make modeling process easier and more efficient. This course aims to introduce the basic concept of BIM, and train the enrolled students to develop the basic skills of BIM modeling and applications.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

The course contents include tips of interview, self-marketing in the workplace and the planning of the career life etc. By the topics, students will be equipped with a variety of presentation skills that needed in the workplace to raise the employment rate.

name.zh: 設計思考-生活醫學知能

description.zh: 醫學影像在醫療過程扮演重要的角色，以影像訊號處理輔助臨床診斷，為亟待發展重要技術。在本課程中，我們將聚焦在如何使用設計思考方法解決醫學影像處理所遇到的問題。課程採用工作坊模式，希望能培養跨領域背景間的溝通與協調能力，運用設計思考激發問題解決能力，培育跨領域人才。
description.en: Medical imaging plays an essential role in the medical process. Using image signal processing to assist clinical diagnosis is an important technology that needs to be developed urgently. This course will focus on using design thinking to solve prob-lems encountered in medical image processing. The course aims to cultivate com-munication and coordination skills between different backgrounds, stimulate problem-solving skills based on design thinking, and cultivate interdisciplinary talents.

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

syllabi.schedule:
一、國防與政治
上課週數：1
單元主題：國防與政治基本概念、國防與政治的關係、國防政策制定與政治
二、我國國家安全政策與法制
上課週數：1
單元主題：國家安全的本質與威脅、我國國家安全戰略與政策、我國國家安全法治與運作
三、我國大陸政策與國防
上課週數：1
單元主題：我國大陸政策的發展、大陸政策與國防
四、我國國防政策
上課週數：2
單元主題：我國國防政策主軸、我國國防戰略目標、我國軍事戰略構想、我國重要國防施政
五、我國國防轉型與改革
上課週數：3
單元主題：國防轉型的分析指標、國防組織的變革、軍事戰略準則的演變、我國武器系統的建構與研發、綜合評估
六、測驗
上課週數：1
七、國防政策與軍事戰略
上課週數：3
單元主題：我國國防政策、我國國防戰略與軍事戰略、國防轉型、國防武力、國防資源與災害防救
八、兵役實務與募兵制生涯規劃
上課週數：2
單元主題：我國兵役制度沿革、徵兵作業程序、國軍志願役班隊簡介
九、愛國教育
上課週數：3
單元主題：國軍使命與軍人信念的意含與實踐、辛亥革命與舞動國旗-革命先烈捨身成仁精神與現代青年愛國行動
十、測驗
上課週數：1

syllabi.outline: 說明我國國防政策內涵，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針及軍事戰略構想，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制、危機管理機制、兵役實務及募兵制、愛國教育，使學生體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。軍事訓練課目：國防政策與軍事戰略、兵役實務及募兵制生涯規劃、愛國教育。
syllabi.schedule:
一、國防與政治
上課週數：1
單元主題：國防與政治基本概念、國防與政治的關係、國防政策制定與政治
二、我國國家安全政策與法制
上課週數：1
單元主題：國家安全的本質與威脅、我國國家安全戰略與政策、我國國家安全法治與運作
三、我國大陸政策與國防
上課週數：1
單元主題：我國大陸政策的發展、大陸政策與國防
四、我國國防政策
上課週數：2
單元主題：我國國防政策主軸、我國國防戰略目標、我國軍事戰略構想、我國重要國防施政
五、我國國防轉型與改革
上課週數：3
單元主題：國防轉型的分析指標、國防組織的變革、軍事戰略準則的演變、我國武器系統的建構與研發、綜合評估
六、測驗
上課週數：1
七、國防政策與軍事戰略
上課週數：3
單元主題：我國國防政策、我國國防戰略與軍事戰略、國防轉型、國防武力、國防資源與災害防救
八、兵役實務與募兵制生涯規劃
上課週數：2
單元主題：我國兵役制度沿革、徵兵作業程序、國軍志願役班隊簡介
九、愛國教育
上課週數：3
單元主題：國軍使命與軍人信念的意含與實踐、辛亥革命與舞動國旗-革命先烈捨身成仁精神與現代青年愛國行動
十、測驗
上課週數：1

description.en: Fundamental theory of statically indeterminate structures;analysis of indeterminate beams,frames,and trusses by stiffness and flexibility methods;study of influence lines for beams,frames,and trusses.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要教授學生：(1)結構分析原理、(2)結構物穩定度判別、(3)靜定結構的分析、(4)虛功法、(5)靜定結構影響線的分析與(6)共軛梁法。

This course provides the students an insight into structural analysis. Some essential classical analysis methods are described. The purpose of this course is to make the students a better understanding of analytical principles of structures. The practical applications to structural engineering are also discussed.
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：課程介紹 (Introduction) 
第二週：結構分析原理 (Background of Structural Analysis)
第三週：結構物穩定度判別(一) (Justification of Stability Degree of Structure I)
第四週：結構物穩定度判別(二) (Justification of Stability Degree of Structure II)
第五週：靜定結構反力的分析 (Analysis of Reactions of Statically Determinate Structure)
第六週：靜定梁剪力與彎矩的分析 (Analysis of Shear Force & Bending Moment of Statically Determinate Beam)
第七週：靜定剛架軸力、剪力與彎矩的分析 (Analysis of Axial Force, Shear Force & Bending Moment of Statically Determinate Rigid Frame)
第八週：靜定桁架軸力的分析(一) (Analysis of Axial Force of Statically Determinate Truss I)
第九週：靜定桁架軸力的分析(二) (Analysis of Axial Force of Statically Determinate Truss II)
第十週：靜定桁架軸力的分析(三) (Analysis of Axial Force of Statically Determinate Truss III)
第十一週：期中考試 (Midterm)
第十二週：虛功法 (Virtual Work Theory)
第十三週：靜定梁與剛架影響線的分析 (Analysis of Influence Line of Statically Determinate Beam & Rigid Frame)
第十四週：靜定桁架影響線的分析(一) (Analysis of Influence Line of Statically Determinate Truss I)
第十五週：靜定桁架影響線的分析(二) (Analysis of Influence Line of Statically Determinate Truss II)
第十六週：共軛梁法(一) (Conjugate Beam Method I)
第十七週：共軛梁法(二) (Conjugate Beam Method II)
第十八週：期末考試 (Final)

syllabi.outline:

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生創新創業的實務，讓學生實際組成團隊進行創業，並有老師全程指導實踐創業，學校並提供基本創業基金與創業場地，輔導學生實際體會創業的過程。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、經營模式建立、創業財務、創業專題進行、創業競賽等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students to practice the entrepreneurship and innovation. Students will form an entrepreneurship team. Teacher will guide the students throughout the entrepreneurship processes. University will offer students initial funds and incubation assistances. Students will gain practical experiences on how to establish entrepreneurship. The contents include entrepreneurial thoughts and actions, design thinking, self-understanding, team formation, business model development, entrepreneurship finance, entrepreneurship practices, entrepreneurship contests, and so on.

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。本課程開授之目標，是希望修課學生能夠瞭解現今整個鐵道通訊及資訊系統與行控中心的架構、配置、功能及目標。前瞻資通訊技術（Information and Communication Technology, ICT）的發展與創新應用，將定義了整個鐵道產業的未來。由於鐵道通訊及資訊系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與資訊等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是針對選讀學程之學生，邀請鐵道通訊及資訊技術應用專家，以業師的身份共同參與授課。 本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊及資訊三部分提出通訊系統與行控中心之創新想法規劃與評估報告，並邀請學者與產業專家共同擔任評審及評比分數。
description.en: This course is the elective subject of Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is to provide the students an overall understanding of the structure, configuration, function, and the objective of the domestic railway industry and operation control center (OCC). The course will be composed with advanced development and innovative application of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), and will dictate the future of railway industry. ICT of railway industry is interdisciplinary which involves management, communication, and information, etc. This intercollegiate course will invite industrial instructors, i.e. ICT experts from some relevant fields in intelligent railway industry to our course. In the final project and report, students are required to plan and assess the communication system and OCC focused on advanced management, communication, and information, and evaluated by qualified experts.

syllabi.schedule:
第1週 課程介紹與學習方向說明
第2週 類比與數位
第3週 數位無線通訊發展與原理概論
第4週 資通訊(ITC)改論與應用
第5週 雲端通訊平台架構
第6週 電話、無線電、廣播系統、標準時鐘、不斷電系統
第7週 自動收費系統(一)
第8週 列車控制與監視系統(TCMS)
第9週 期中考週
第10週 鐵道或捷運公司參訪
第11週 智慧型系統概論
第12週 智慧型系統於鐵道業的應用與實務
第13週 閉路電視(CCTV)，網路影像系統。
第14週 車載通訊系統
第15週 旅客資訊系統(PIDS)
第16週 自動收費系統(二) 多元支付技術
第17週 現代鐵道資通訊與智慧化發展趨勢(或參訪)
第18週 期末考週
syllabi.assessment:
期中與期末皆以心得寫作方式評分
心得內容包括
1. 對於有線及無線通訊方式的理解。
2. 對於現代鐵道通訊應用的心得。
3. 對於相關通訊應用於大眾運輸的構想。
4. 與課程主題相關的自由發揮。

description.zh: 本課程規劃透過專業之人格特質分析方式，提供學生瞭解自我屬性於未來職場上之可能角色定位與認知感受，並針對學生畢業後進入職場將面臨的挑戰，提供應對進退之教戰策略與技巧傳授，包括壓力調適方式、溝通協調技巧、團隊合作注意事項、履歷撰寫方式、面試臨場技巧、以及職場倫理規範等，以提升學生爭取工作機會與進入職場後之適應能力與競爭實力。課程最後並安排整體課程之履歷健檢與模擬面試實作教育訓練，提供學生檢視學習成效並對未來職涯規劃預作準備。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with a professional personality analysis to understand the possible roles and perceptions of their attributes in the future workplace, and to teach them strategies and skills to cope with the challenges they will face when they enter the workplace after graduation, include stress adjustment, communication, and coordination skills, teamwork, resume writing, interviewing skills, and workplace ethics, etc. This course will also help students to enhance their adaptability and competitiveness when they enter the workplace. At the end of the course, a resume review and a mock interview will be provided to prepare students for their future career planning.

syllabi.outline:
本課程規劃透過專業之人格特質分析方式，提供學生瞭解自我屬性於未來職場上之可能角色定位與認知感受，並針對學生畢業後進入職場將面臨的挑戰，提供應對進退之教戰策略與技巧傳授，包括壓力調適方式、溝通協調技巧、團隊合作注意事項、履歷撰寫方式、面試臨場技巧、以及職場倫理規範等，以提升學生爭取工作機會與進入職場後之適應能力與競爭實力。課程最後並安排整體課程之履歷健檢與模擬面試實作教育訓練，提供學生檢視學習成效並對未來職涯規劃預作準備。
This course is designed to provide students with a professional personality analysis to understand the possible roles and perceptions of their attributes in the future workplace, and to teach them strategies and skills to cope with the challenges they will face when they enter the workplace after graduation, include stress adjustment, communication, and coordination skills, teamwork, resume writing, interviewing skills, and workplace ethics, etc. This course will also help students to enhance their adaptability and competitiveness when they enter the workplace. At the end of the course, a resume review and a mock interview will be provided to prepare students for their future career planning.

description.en: This course aims to develop and reinforce students' strengths to create unified and coherent pieces of composition in a variety of styles--narrative, descriptive,  argumentative, reflective, and expository.  Students will be guided to write in response to readings, pictures, events in their daily lives, and discussions from the class.  Thought-provoking topics dealing with current issues are used to stimulate and foster critical writing strategies. This course enables students to write and discuss logically and clearly; they also need to incorporate grammatically newly-built vocabulary into their writing.

description.zh: 本課程將專注於創新產品與混合實境的設計研究實務，期望透過虛實整合與使用者經驗的核心概念，應用研究方法深入探究設計問題與使用者經驗中的痛點，探討實體端產品設計和虛擬端的服務設計之各種實務應用，進而透過設計方法與軟硬體技術落實創新概念，最終達到設計出符合與滿足使用者在未來生活中的各種設計服務與體驗。
description.en: This course will focus on the design research case study of innovative products and mixed reality. It is expected that through the core concepts of virtual-real integration and user experience, it will apply research methods to deeply explore design problems and pain points in user experience and explore physical product design and virtual reality. We will integrate various possibilities of service design with industry case study. Then, we intend to utilize the implemented innovative concept by design methods, software, and hardware technologies to achieve the design services and experiences that meet and satisfy users in future life.

name.zh: 企業數位轉型與優化研討

description.zh: 世界各區域經濟快速發展，面對高度競爭的趨勢，數位轉型是項關鍵議題。本課程將使EMBA學生了解數位轉型與優化相關趨勢，並透過一些成功案例探討數位轉型對企業產生之效益，希望透過本課程之研討，EMBA學生可以將成功案例經驗及所學應用至所屬公司或企業。
description.en: With the expeditious development in regional economic activities and more competition across countries, enterprise digital transformation is an important topic. The aim of this course is to comprehend the latest digital transformation issues and potential benefits to enterprise. Case studies and experience sharing are critical in this course.

description.zh: 年來，在世博和花博兩大活動的帶動下，讓跨領域整合的「展示科技」成為新的研究焦點；新型態的展示手法，可以被應用在博物館及展場、商業空間、互動式機台、行銷活動和數位藝術。依照需求的不同，可以把展示科技分成『會場環境』和『觀眾體驗』兩類，前者就像是基礎建設、活動系統和周邊系統，而後者則是為觀眾創造全新體驗。而本課程則是為了掌握產業界相關的技術新知、學術界的專業研究與藝文界的脈動，本課程將廣邀展示科技的專家或學者，參與專題討論，就展場設計、互動技術、視覺呈現等面向，翻轉你與展示物的關係，體現創意展現的軟實力。
description.en: The promotion of Expo and Flora Expo in recent years makes the display technology a new focus in study. New pattern of display techniques can be applied to museum, exhibition, commercial space, interactive machinery, marketing and digital art. Depending on different needs, the Display Technology can be divided into two categories, which are "the environment of exhibition" and "the experience of audience". The former is like fundamental constructions, movable system, and peripheral system; the latter is like building a new and fresh experience for the audience. To understand science and technological information from business field, researches from academic field and issues from arts field, this course should be invited the expertise and scholars to participate the topic discussion.

syllabi.outline:
年來，在世博和花博兩大活動的帶動下，讓跨領域整合的「展示科技」成為新的研究焦點；新型態的展示手法，可以被應用在博物館及展場、商業空間、互動式機台、行銷活動和數位藝術。依照需求的不同，可以把展示科技分成『會場環境』和『觀眾體驗』兩類，前者就像是基礎建設、活動系統和周邊系統，而後者則是為觀眾創造全新體驗。而本課程則是為了掌握產業界相關的技術新知、學術界的專業研究與藝文界的脈動，本課程將廣邀展示科技的專家或學者，參與專題討論，就展場設計、互動技術、視覺呈現等面向，翻轉你與展示物的關係，體現創意展現的軟實力。
The promotion of Expo and Flora Expo in recent years makes the display technology a new focus in study. New pattern of display techniques can be applied to museum, exhibition, commercial space, interactive machinery, marketing and digital art. Depending on different needs, the Display Technology can be divided into two categories, which are "the environment of exhibition" and "the experience of audience". The former is like fundamental constructions, movable system, and peripheral system; the latter is like building a new and fresh experience for the audience. To understand science and technological information from business field, researches from academic field and issues from arts field, this course should be invited the expertise and scholars to participate the topic discussion.

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:. Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members. This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright. In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt. In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

description.zh: 本課程所定義的文化產業包括音樂產業、電視產業、電影產業、劇場產業和其他表演藝術有關的產業。這些產業區塊都存在相關的智慧財產權議題，例如所有權、權利轉讓、合理使用、侵權行為、契約爭議等等。本課程將透過法院判決的選讀與產業案例研究來讓學生認識文化產業的智慧財產權議題。學生將被要求參與討論。評分方式包括課堂參與和報告。
description.en: The scope of the cultural industry covered by this course includes the music industry, film industry, television industry, theatre industry, and other industries related to performing arts. Intellectual property issues do exist in these industrial sectors. The issues include ownership, title transfer, fair use, infringement, contract dispute, and so on. This course is intended to expose students to various IP issues in the cultural industry through studying court decisions and discussing industrial case studies. Students are required to participate in discussion. The grading policy is based on class participation and essay paper.

name.zh: 原民傳智創作保護專題研究
name.en: Protection of Indigenous People Traditional Intellectual Creation

description.zh: 「原住民族傳統智慧創作保護專題研究」將協助學生理解原住民族的文化自治理論下、原住民族傳統智慧創作保護的法規架構; 並由原住民族傳統智慧保護的案例出發，透過個案引導學生了解原住民族傳統智慧保護的理論與實務。最後安排可供具體探討與模擬練習的原住民族傳統智慧保護標的，幫助修課學生從歷史與文化自治的座標出發，建立原住民族傳統智慧保護的法律概念與實務基礎，增加智財法律訓練的文化視野。
description.en: This course will equip students with both theoretical and practice knowledge about the Indigenous People Traditional Intellectual Creation Protection Act. The Act is anchored in the autonomy theory in the cultural context but share many characteristics with other IP laws. By learning this Act, it opens the gate for students to explore the history and culture developments of indigenous people, also help students explore more cultural aspect of intellectual property laws.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh:
近年來企業為面對市場的競爭與快速改變，其多以大型專案方式同時來執行幾個專案，如：產品研發、行銷規劃、生產製造及教育訓練等專案活動。大型專案管理要如何才能在企業統一的願景和策略下展開，來提升企業的競爭優勢與創造價值。因大型專案的時程較長且範圍較多，其不確定性和混淆性也較高，以致其成功的關鍵除須具備專案的執行的效率外，還須具有在於對變化的反應能力。
本課程內容將著重於介紹大型專案規劃流程中所使用的技能與工具說明外，並安排學生企業內大型專案實務案例做為課堂內探討。其目的在訓練學生如何面對高混淆性和高不確定性的大型專案，使企業內大型專案管理有系統的方法執行與圓滿完成。
description.en:
Recently, in order to face the challenges and rapid changes of the competition, enterprises often need have a large-scale project to execute several projects at the same time, such as product development, marketing planning, manufacturing, and education and training. How can large-scale project management be carried out under the unified vision and strategy of the enterprise? New capabilities and cultural consensus are needed to enhance the enterprise's competitive advantage and create value. Due to the long duration and large scope of large-scale project, its uncertainty and confusion are also high, so that the key to its success must be not only the efficiency of project execution, but also the ability to respond to changes.

syllabi.outline:
近年來企業為面對市場競爭的挑戰與快速改變，其經營管理活動多以專案方式來執行，以致企業各部門工作皆與專案管理息息相關，如：產品研發、行銷規劃、生產製造、教育訓練及企業經營管理等活動，多以專案方式來執行。 本課程將對於企業內全方位專案管理流程做一概述，並安排企業實例做為案例探討。課程針對研發、採購、行銷及行政專案管理等之五大流程 (起案、規劃、執行、監控、結案)及十大知識領域 (整合、範圍、時間、成本、品質、人資、溝通、風險、採購、關係人) 與各流程中所使用的技能與工具做說明與介紹。此課程之內容包含全面專案管理觀念知識的建立與應用，並著重企業全方位的相關專案實務案例講解。使其瞭解專案管理在產業界重要性，企業研究發展的正確方向，以達產學合一，並分享最新觀念與實務。
Recently, facing the marketing challenges and rapid changes, the company's business management activities are mostly carried out in a project-based manner, all departments are closely related to project management and carried out on a case-by-case basis. This course will provide an overview of the full-scale project management process within the company, and arrange enterprise practice as a case study. The course covers five major processes and ten areas of knowledge (integration, scope, time, cost, quality, human resources, communication, risk, procurement). The content of this course is based on the concept knowledge and focuses on the company's comprehensive (product R&D, marketing planning, manufacturing, and training program) case study. To make attendants understand the importance of project management in the industry to achieve the unity of production and learning, and to share the newest concepts and practices.

description.zh: 本課程將使學員熟習各項品質管理的理論基礎與發展趨勢，強化理論研究與實務應用能力。首先，課程涵蓋基礎統計使學員具備研究方法與分析技術能力，了解收集、統整和分析資料。其次，討論量化的六標準差管理相關工具及專案推行流程，以系統化思維探討問題並提出有效可行的解決對策，持續提升品質及客戶滿意。最後，介紹制度面及組織管理面的全球品管概念，闡述創造魅力品質之重要理論模型及影響服務品質關鍵因素。課程中以實務模式介紹為基礎，並配合個案分析以實例討論加強同學分析及解決實際問題的能力。
description.en: This class will help students familiarize themselves with the trend of theoretical basis of the quality management and strengthen their ability in both theoretical research and practical application. First, the course covers basic statistics so that students will be acquainted with research methods and analysis techniques. Second, the six sigma management tools will be reviewed and the process for its implementation will also be addressed. Finally, the system- and the organization-level quality as well as the Kano Model for attractive quality will be discussed. The curriculum of this class includes the introduction of empirical models integrated with case study so that the students will be strengthened in the capabilities of real world problem solving and quality improvement.

Students will have opportunities to further understand the legal practice in IP area by taking part in solving real cases with the help of the course tutor. It is recommended for those who are equipped with a general understanding of IP laws or are strongly interested in this subject.

description.zh: 本課程介紹人工智慧的基本概念與發展，並激發學生在人工智慧領域的創新應用。課程內容包括: 人工智慧基礎、機器學習、大數據技術、深度學習、生成對抗網路、創業家思維、設計思考、商業模式、人工智慧與現代科技、人工智慧的製造業應用、人工智慧的服務業應用。
description.en: This course is to teach students the basic concepts and applications of artificial intelligence and to inspire students for innovative artificial intelligence applications. The course includes: artificial intelligence basics, machine learning, big data, deep learning, generative adversarial network, entrepreneurial thoughts, design thinking, business models, artificial intelligence and modern technologies, industrial applications of artificial intelligence, and services applications of artificial intelligence.

syllabi.schedule:
週次及單元主題:
第一週 人工智慧概述
第二週 人工智慧的發展現狀和未來趨勢
第三週 人工智慧求解問題的原理
第四週 啟發式演算法
第五週 自然語言處理
第六週 自然語言處理的基本原理
第七週 自然語言處理的應用案例，如情感分析、語音識別、機器翻譯等
第八週 圖像識別
第九週  期中評量
第十週 圖像識別的應用案例
第十一週 圖像識別的工具和框架
第十二週 機器學習的基本概念和種類
第十三週 監督式學習、非監督式學習、強化學習的基本原理
第十四週 機器學習的應用案例
第十五週 深度學習的基本概念和種類
第十六週 深度學習的應用
第十七週 期末專題報告
第十八週 期末專題報告

description.zh: 設計是一個相當多元的領域，是技術的化身、美學的表現和文化的象徵。它是社會、經濟、技術、藝術、心理學和生理學的結合。本課程旨在構建學生對設計原理和理論的認識，提高學生對美感和設計作品的鑑賞能力，並為他們提供專業術語。這些知識構成了幫助年輕從業者實現其藝術目標並在高專業水平上執行項目工作的核心。本課程基於對現代設計行業的概述，期望建立一個關於設計思維主題的全景視角。
description.en: Design is a quite multiplex domain, technical incarnation, esthetics performance and cultural symbol. And it is the union of the social, economics, technology, arts, psychology, and physiology. The course aims to structure students’ knowledge about the principles and theories of design, improve their abilities to appreciate the aesthetic sense and design works, and provide them with professional terminology. This knowledge constitutes the core which helps young practitioners to attain their artistic objectives and perform project work on a high professional level. This course is based on an overview of the modern design industry, expect to establish a panorama perspective on the subject of design thinking.

syllabi.outline: 講授透視圖的基本原理、種類與方法及透視陰影,並以設計實例透視圖練習應用,培養靈活應用透視圖法於設計表達。
syllabi.schedule:
1.(一週)透視圖學在室內設計的全境位置.
2.(二週)透視圖基本形式簡介。.基本圖法、用語與練習。
3.(三週)1消點基本圖法。練習說明。
4.(四週).1消點基本圖法作品構圖發展。
5.(五週).1消點基本圖法作品(一)發表。((評一))
6.(六週).2消點基本圖法。練習說明。
7.(七週).2消點基本圖法作品構圖發展。
8.(八週).2消點基本圖法作品(二)發表。((評二))
9.(九週).期中考。綜合練習測驗。
10.(十週).綜合練習(一)與發表.((評三))
11.(十一週).3消點基本圖法。練習說明。
12.(十二週).3消點基本圖法作品構圖發展。
13.(十三).3消點基本圖法作品(三)發表。((評四))
14.(十四週).綜合練習(二).
15.(十五週).綜合練習(二)作品發表.((評五))
16.(十六週).綜合練習測驗.
17.(十七週).作品發表期末展.
18.期末考.
syllabi.materials:
1.基本透視實務技法，山城義彥 著，吳宗鎮 譯(1991.08)，台北 新形象出版。
2.表現技法，蔡光明 著(2000.01)初版，台北  矩陣出版股份有限公司。
3.透視圖與表現技法，李薦宏 譯，銀來圖書出版有限公司發行。
4. 建築透視圖學及其模型製作，楊顯祥 譯(1991,05)，茂榮圖書有公司。
5.建築設計教室，三宅敏郎 等著(1993,04)，台北斯坦出版有限公司。
6.透視圖原理及圖解法.

description.zh: 本課程目標旨在介紹計算智能、軟性計算與演化計算的相關演算法與進階應用。內容包括：爬山法與模擬退火、基因演算法、粒子群優演算法、蜂群演算法等相關內容。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the computational intelligence, soft computing, evolutionary algorithm, relative algorithms and their applications. The course covers the subjects on Hill-Climbing Algorithm, Simulated Annealing, Genetic Algorithm, Particle Swarm Optimization, Artificial Bee Colony and so on.

syllabi.outline:
自然界的進化行為一直人類賦予計算機智慧學習的對象，但仿效自然界中生物間的適應性過程，建構出的龐大模型，一直是在一項艱鉅的挑戰，但不諱言的他的回報也是巨大的。進化計算便是基於生物遺傳學、自然選擇和出現的適應性行為等進化機制，建立出來的智慧型模型，以利智慧系統的建立。本課程將介紹各項演化計算方式，並以實作的方式實際了解彼此間的差異。
The evolutionary behavior of nature has always been the object of learning that man has endowed computer intelligence with. However, the construction of huge models that emulate the adaptive processes among organisms in nature has been a difficult challenge, but the rewards have been enormous. Evolutionary computation is an intelligent model based on evolutionary mechanisms such as biological genetics, natural selection, and emergent adaptive behaviors to facilitate the establishment of intelligent systems. This course will introduce the various evolutionary computation methods and provide a practical understanding of the differences between them in a hands-on manner.

1. 數學搜尋問題(Mathematical search problems)
2. 遺傳演算法(Genetic algorithms)
3. 模糊系統(Fuzzy system)
4. 模擬退火法(Simulated annealing method)
5. 粒子群優化(Particle swarm optimization)

期末報告(Final report) 40%

description.zh: 專注於戰略和機構的國際層面，並提供了一個框架，在日益複雜的全球經濟裡制定戰略。本課程旨在為學生提供對跨國公司經營裡的文化，政治，競爭，技術，法律和人口環境的理解。然後，它通過在國際背景下獲得成功的全球產業和戰略來探討全球競爭的性質。還涵蓋了跨國公司管理中的組織設計與戰略控制相關問題。
description.en: Focuses on the international dimensions of strategy and organization and provides a framework for formulating strategies in an increasingly complex global economy. The course seeks to provide students with an understanding of the cultural, political, competitive, technological, legal, and demographic environments in which multinational firms operate. It then examines the nature of global competition by exploring the characteristics of global industries and strategies that have been successful in an international context. Also covered are issues related to organizational design and strategic control in the management of multinational enterprises.

syllabi.schedule:
本課程由台積電訓練中心(位於台中)提供課程設備，實際授課內容視該期可用設備由台積電調整。每一梯次受訓四天，每天課程範例如下：
Day 1
1.System overview
2.Mainframe configuration
3.Process module
4.Utility connection
5.Sub system
6.Safety
7.Tool on site inspection

Day 2
1.RF delivery system
2.Gas delivery system
3.Pressure servo system
4.ESC system
5.Backside He system
6.Temperature system
7.Chamber design evolution
8.EPD system introduction
9.Software operation overview

Day 3
1.S/W operation main platform
2.S/W operation processmodule
3.S/W operation data access
4.Mainframe outline
5.Mainframe service function
6.Mainframe maintenance
7.Maintenance practice and certification

Day 4
1.Chamber outline and PM preparation
2.Process kits disassembling
3.Process kits cleaning and inspection
4.Process kits installation
5.PM practice

原則上周六早上6點由本校出發，課程結束約六點由台中出發返校。統一提供交通運輸。遲到無法等待，視同缺課。

syllabi.outline:
當高解析度的數位微波影像以成趨勢後，下一世代各國之間在遙測影像的競爭上已經不再局限於光學影像中。然而無論是光學或微波影像，都是以傳統的影像處理為基礎，然後再根據彼此間的數位訊號間的差異，而有不一樣的處理方法。在國際上，越來越多實務上的應用不再只局限於傳統的數位光學影像。利用更多輔助的數位影像資料，例如數位微波影像，能獲取更高效能、更高精度的結果。本課程會以數位微波影像發展趨勢與應用介紹起，並說明影像的特性、訊號模型與處理方法，並搭配實務上的操作，達到理論與實務兼具的目的。
When high resolution digital microwave image becomes the trend, the competition of remote sensing image among countries in the next generation is no longer limited to optical image. However, both optical and microwave images are based on the traditional image processing, and then have different processing methods according to the difference between digital signals. Internationally, more and more practical applications are no longer limited to traditional digital optical imaging. The use of more complementary digital image data, such as digital microwave images, can lead to more efficient and accurate results. This course will introduce the trends and applications of digital microwave imaging, explain the characteristics of the image, signal model and processing methods, and provide practical operation to achieve both theoretical and practical purposes.
syllabi.schedule:
1. 微波影像發展與趨勢(Microwave image development and trends)
2. 基礎微波影像的判釋與應用(Interpretation and application of basic microwave images)
3. 微波影像重要參數說明(Important parameters of microwave imaging)
4. 訊號模型與特性(Signal model and characteristics)
5. 都卜勒特性於訊號上的意義與估算方法(Doppler parameters and estimation methods)
6. 匹配率波器(Matching filter generation)
7. 高斜視角下的訊號特性與處理方法(Signal processing for oblique observation environment)
8. 深度學習在數位微波影像上的應用(Deep learning in microwave image)
9. 影像辨識應用(Object recognition in microwave image)

description.zh: C語言為開發作業系統、嵌入式系統、通訊協定等程式最常使用的程式語言，本課程主要教導C程式語言於實務上之應用，課程內容主要包括：進階指標使用、指標與陣列、指標與資料結構、Pointer-to-pointer、指標函式、Callback function、Bitwise operation應用等，除了於PC上撰寫程式練習之外，亦會有case study來輔助教學以及了解C語言的使用技巧，期末亦會要求學生利用所學習到之技巧來模擬CPU排程與記憶體管理等相關作業系統底層程式。
description.en: The C programming language is commonly used to implement operation systems, embedded systems, and communication protocols. The object of this course is to teach how to apply the C programming language to develop real application systems. The contents of this course include advanced pointer usage, pointer and array, pointer and data structure, pointer-to-pointer, function pointer, callback functions, bitwise operations, and so on. In addition to practice on PC, this course also offers case studies for better understanding. Students will also be required to implement emulators to simulate OS lower level operations, e.g., CPU scheduling and memory management.

syllabi.outline:
C/C++語言是廣泛能與硬體溝通的高階程式語言，無論是在傳統UNIX系統、3D影像虛擬視覺化設計、中介語言等應用上，是新一代程式語言開發的基石。C/C++語言的跨平台的通用性和深層的記憶體管理機制，透過進階的C/C++語言的學習，使其更靈活地發揮在各項專案設計中。本課程會以基礎C/C++語言的回顧為開始，並將C/C++語言帶入位元操作與物件化內容，最後導入電腦圖學與高效能平行化計算等應用。
The C/C++ language is a high-level programming language that can communicate with a wide range of hardware, and is the basis for the next generation of programming language development, whether in traditional UNIX systems, 3D image virtualization design, intermediary languages, etc. The cross-platform versatility and deep memory management mechanism of the C/C++ language make it more flexible for various project designs through advanced C/C++ language learning. This course will begin with a review of the basic C/C++ language, move on to bit manipulation and object-based content, and finally lead to applications such as computer graphics and high-performance parallel computing.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

syllabi.outline:
本課程的特色是希望藉由管弦樂音樂的播放，與實體樂器的展示、示範演出，互相結合，使同學在欣賞高水準的音樂之餘，更能實際接觸到平常接觸不到的實體樂器，實際的觀察樂器的構造，近距離的欣賞到樂器，能聽到實際上發出的聲音，從而對材料機械，科技與樂器聲響之間的關係，有一個真實而全新的認識，進而引發對音樂的認識以及興趣。
The feature of the course is that, through playing music, physical instrument display an demonstration of performances, the students come into contact with the usual musical instruments. Observing the instrument configuration and listening the sound in close distance lead to a true and a new understanding of the relationship between material mechanics and musical sound, and thus trigger and interest in music.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.
