name.en: Measurement and Analysis for Business Decision Making

description.zh: 本課程為學生提供商業決策背景下財務報告、分析和衡量問題的全面概述。學生將了解財務報表及其基本衡量標準。然後，他們將利用這種理解來使用財務比率進行分析。然後，學生將探索成本衡量、分配等在確定組織各部分的績效衡量方面的作用，以及它們與在各種商業環境中選擇和評估戰略的相互關係。他們將涵蓋諸如匹配策略與績效衡量、選擇和評估關鍵績效指標和平衡計分卡等問題。
description.en: This course provides students with a comprehensive overview of financial reporting, analysis and measurement issues in the context of business decision making. Student will gain an understanding of financial statements and their underlying measurements. They will then use this understanding to conduct analyses using financial ratios. Students will then explore the role of cost measurements, allocations, etc. in determining the performance measures of parts of the organization and their inter-relationship with both choosing and evaluating strategies in various business contexts. They will cover issues such as matching strategies to performance measures, choosing and evaluating key performance indicators and balanced scorecards, etc.

description.en:
The course introduces nanomaterials and their preparation processes (wet method and dry method). The future development and applications are also discussed.This course will cover the following topics:
1. Introduction of nanomaterials and nanochemistry
2. Nanomaterials: structure and analysis
3. Nanomaterials: processing
4. Nanomaterials: self-assembly
5. Nanomaterials: simulation
6. Carbon nanotubes
7. Synthesis and sintering of mesoporous nanocrystals
8. Growth and application of semiconductor nanoparticles
9. Prospective vision of nanomaterials

syllabi.outline:
Nanomaterials are materials with a single unit small sized between 1 and 100 nm.  They have unique optical, electronic, thermo-physical or mechanical properties. Since some nanomaterials have properties of enzyme-like characteristics.They are artificial enzyme, which can be used for many applications in such as biosensing, bioimaging, tumor diagnosis and so on.  We will also discuss about the safety issues, regulation and public percpetin on nanomaterials. 
Students are expected to learn the types, the basic theory, unique properties of nanomaterials, the syntehsis and characterization of nanomaterials. This class is for upper level undergraduate students, with interested on material science and nanotechnology.
syllabi.schedule:
Week        Title
1      Introduction on nanomarterials- nanotechnology in the ancient days and nature
2.     Different types of nanomaterials - OD, 1D, 2D and 3D
3.     Bulk nanomaterials - nanocrystalline materials, nanocomposites, nanoporous material
4. Bulk nanomaterials- metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), inorganic-organic hybrid nanocomposites
5.    Quantum mechanics and Jellium model
6.    Electrical properties - ballistic transport, Coulomb blockade
7.    Magnetic nanoparticles and superparamagnetism
8.    Surface properties
9.    Midterm Exam
10.  Mechanical properties & Stabilisation 
11.  Optical properties 
12.  Core-shell nanoparticles and gold nanoshells
13.   Carbon nanoworld - fullerenes, graphenes and carbon nanotubes
14.   Synthesis of nanomaterials - vapour and solution phases
15.   Characterization of nanomaterials - SPM, STM, AFM, SEM, TEM, XR
16.    Applications of nanomaterials and nanotechnology
17.    Safety Issues, Regulations and Public Perception
18.    Final exam

Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. description.en:
This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it. 
 
In this course, students are required to draw up self-learning plans based on their own interests and capabilities and then submit their plans to the departmental office for approval by the beginning of the semester.

description.en: To help students cultivate the ability of self-learning, this course allows students to engage themselves in developing course content, to plan and to execute a real-world project. "Active learning" encourages students to learn by interaction, communication, collaboration, critically analyzing arguments, and problem-solving. Instructors will assist to guide and to support in the process of learning. Students are expected to develop a process to solve real-life problems collaboratively. Written reports and oral presentations are required for course evaluation.

description.en:

(3)	Teachers act as mentors and guide students to learn and grow from practice
(4) Students set up learning plans according to their own interests and abilities, and apply before the school starts. They are supervised by full-time teachers to review and evaluate semester performance.

description.zh: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。
description.en: Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.

syllabi.outline: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用整學年至材料及資源工程相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生每學期必須撰寫實習心得報告以便評分。
description.en: The course is developed to enhance the on-job practical capability of students. Students are trained for an academic year in corporative company or organizations of materials and Mineral Resources Engineering related fields. A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to meet the course requirement for each semester.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh:
(1) 培養學生在職場中的溝通技巧與自我管理能力。
(2) 學習與同事之間的溝通、協調的能力。
(3) 學生利用一學期的時間至校外企業實習，參與合作企業所提供之訓練。
(4) 實習期滿後，實習企業須提出實習證明及成績考核。
(5) 學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交到科辦公室保存。
description.en:
(1)	Develop students' communication skills and self-management skills in the workplace.
(2)	To learn the ability to communicate and coordinate with colleagues.
(3)	Students spend one semester of time internships with companies and participate in the training provided by the partner companies.
(4)	After the internship period, the intern company must submit the internship certificate and performance assessment.
(5) Students must write an internship report and submit it to the office for preservation.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至相關機構連續實習18週，每週不得低於2.5天。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work at an engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks (20 hours per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得短期體驗光電產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 建築物勘測、負載計算實例實做、風管製圖、水管路系統製圖、冷凍空調配電設計實例實做、設備安裝－位置選定、基礎、避震及噪音控制、工程估價實例。
description.en: Building's survey, case study- load calculation, air duct system schematic drawing, water piping system schematic drawing. HVAC & R electric power system design & drawing, equipment installations-layout, foundation, vibration & noisy control planning. Engineering cost estimation practices & analysis.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期或寒假至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之同一校外研發機構的累計研究時數不得低於320小時，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究報告予指導教授，指導教師依據研究生之實務研發紀錄及心得報告，指導研究生撰寫成實務研究成果報告，彙交所屬系所保存，並作為成績核定之依據。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents - which will thus be collected and deposited in the individual departmental or graduate institute office. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organizations or agencies (50%), respectively.

description.zh:
(1)	參加「學期制校外實習」的學生，必須同時加選本課程。
(2)	學生在企業實習的期間，必須訂出專題的題目。
(3)	訓練學生閱讀研討會論文、期刊論文，以及相關的技術論文。
(4) 學生必須撰寫「專題報告」交到辦公室保存。
description.en:
(1) Students who participate in the off-campus internship must add this course at the same time.
(2) During the internship of a company, students must formulate topical topics.

description.zh: 國際合作專題特論乃透過國際大師的講課，讓學生學習材料科學或資源工程相關領域的重要知識及了解最先進之研究成果或最新開發成品。
description.en: This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application in the materials science and mineral engineering. Speakers being invited are well-known international scholars in the related area.

syllabi.outline:
國際合作專題特論乃透過國際大師的講課，讓學生學習材料科學或資源工程相關領域的重要知識及了解最先進之研究成果或最新開發成品。
This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application in the materials science and mineral engineering. Speakers being invited are well-known international scholars in the related area.

The course will emphasize the interplay between crystallography, bonding, and properties. In particular the physical origin of a number of properties, including thermal expansion, thermal conductivity, the refractive index, optical activity, piezoelectricity, and a variety of magnetic and electrical properties will be discussed.  In each case, the tie will be made to the underlying structural features which control the magnitude of the property coefficients (not just the existence of the response as defined by Neumann’s law). Emphasis will be placed on the systematics of designing the response of materials. In addition, several of the fundamentals of crystal chemistry beyond Pauling’s rules, including bond valence sums and crystal field theory will be introduced. Throughout the course the lecture material will be augmented by crystal structure building to illustrate the fundamental concepts.
syllabi.schedule:
(1)	Introduction (05/30; 2 hr)
(2)	To describe the crystal structure of important materials and to be able to build their atomic models (e.g. calcite, corundum, cordierite, rutile, tridymite and cristobalite with their stuffed derivatives, spinels, β-silicon nitride, perovskite, wurtzite, quartz). (05/30-05/31; 6 hr)
(3)	To understand how physical and chemical properties are related to crystal structure and microstructure. (05/31-06/01; 6 hr)
(4)	To appreciate the engineering significance of these ideas. (06/02; 4 hr)
(5)	Conclusions (06/02; 1 hr)
